data.value: I-port API yendzawo ayisiyo ye-server lekhetsiwe. Hlola i-port yayo yemdlalo; kute i-token leyatfunyelwa ku-API.

data.name: Satisfactory.NotConnected
data.value: Kucocisana lokungakhetsi: landzela iConnect API ngemuva kwekufaka nekucalisa iseva. Kulawula lokujwayelekile kwe Synix kusasebenta ngaphandle kwethokheni.

data.name: Satisfactory.StartFirst
data.value: Cala i-server lefakwe nge-Synix, bese uyifaka ku-Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager. Buyela lapha utohlanganisa i-API.

data.name: Satisfactory.ConnectedHint
data.value: API lehlangene ne {0}. Vuselela kute utfole lwati lolusha.

data.name: Satisfactory.SetupSteps
data.value:
Gcwalisa luhlelo lwekucala ku Satisfactory's Server Manager bese ugcina iseva isebenta nge -NewConsole.
Chafata ngephansi. I-Synix itfumela umyalo, ifundze le-token lensha, iyicinisekise bese iyigcina kahle. Kute kukopa nobe kunamatsisela.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.AmbiguousToken
data.value: I-console yabuyisela emathokheni lehlukene. Kute kuchumana lokwagcinwa.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleUnavailable
data.value: I-Synix ayikwati kufinyelela kukhonsoli ye-Unreal yaleli seva. Kucala nge -NewConsole bese usebentisa imvumo lefanako ye Windows ku Synix kanye ne server.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleTokenMissing
data.value: Lomyalo watfunyelwa, kepha Synix akakhoni kufundza lithokheni lelisha leliphelele kusuka kuloku lokuphuma kule server. Hlola kutsi i-server iyaphendvula yini nekutsi libhuku layo lingabhalwa yini. Konkhe kuchumana lokulondvolotiwe kugciniwe; umyalo awuzange uphindze wetanywe.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleBusy
data.value: I-console ayiphendvuli nobe kuchumana sekuvele kuyachubeka. Linda, bese uyazama futsi. Lomyalo awuphindzi wentiwe ngemphumelelo.

data.name: Satisfactory.TokenSafety
data.value: Loku kunika Synix kufinyelela kwebaphatsi. I-token i-encrypted ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Windows futsi ayizange yengetwe kumalungiselelo emdlalo nobe ekucaleni kwetimpikiswano. i-Satisfactory iyikhombisa kukhonsoli yayo kanye nelog yayo; tigcine tiyimfihlo. Kususa kuchumana lokulondvolotiwe akuyihocisi le-token.

data.name: Satisfactory.SecurityHelp
data.value: Ngemuva kwekusungula ku Satisfactory, cala i-server nge -NewConsole. Ku Synix: Kukhetsa kwe-Server → Satisfactory Control Center → Xhuma i-API → Xhuma ngekutitsandzela. Lokuchumana lokungakhetsi akukaze kuvimbele kusetjentiswa kweseva lokuvamile.

data.name: Satisfactory.AddAfterInstall
data.value: Kwengeta ngekusebentisa i-Control Center ngemuva kwekufakwa

data.name: Satisfactory.Connected
data.value: I-token icinisekisiwe futsi igcinwe ngekuphepha. Kulalelwa kwebadlali nyalo sekuxhunyiwe.

data.value: Susa Synix's logciniwe kanye nesitifiketi salolucingo? I-server itawuchubeka isebente. Letinye ticelo angeke tihociswe.

data.value: Kucala le-server ngekusebentisa i-Synix? Uma ingakafakwa, i-Synix's normal installation workflow itawusebenta.

data.value: Vimbela le-server nge-Synix? Labadlali batawuyekela kudlala. I-Synix itawuphawula loku njengekumisa lokwentiwe ngenhloso kute umgadzi angacali kabusha.

data.value: Vuselela kufundza lokulungiselelwe ngulomlayeto. Hlela emagugu bese usebentisa kuphela loko lokushintjile. Emakhodi emdlalo nemibandzela yawo kufanele kube ngesiNgisi. Emazinga lasembili angadzinga kucalisa kabusha nge Synix.

data.value: Vuselela luhlu lwema-server lagciniwe. Kulayisha kucala kulondvolota luhlelo lolusebentako. Tintfo letilayishiwe atilayisheki ngalokuzenzekelako. Emafayela lagciniwe kanye nemagama eseshini akahumushiwe.

data.name: Satisfactory.ConsoleHelp
data.value: Sigaba lesisetulu: Faka umyalo munye we-Satisfactory ngesiNgisi. Imiyalo yekumisa isebentisa i-Synix yekumisa indlela yekusebenta. I-token/password imiyalo kanye nemibhalo iyavinjelwa. Lokukhicitwako kuhlala kulelowindi, hhayi kudeshibhodi nobe kumafayili emarekhodi.

data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Kucala Lokusheshako 1. Faka leligama lalomdlalo kanye nenombolo Steam ye-AppID yeserver. 2. Faka indlela yekusebenta ye-server lehlobene nelifolda leseva lefakiwe. 3. Faka kuphela umbhalo walomyalo lotfolakala ngemuva kwencwadzi lecondzisako. Sebentisa lamathegi langentasi lapho khona i-Synix kufanele ifake indlela yekusebentisa. 4. Khetsa indlela lomdlalo lotfola ngayo lifayela layo lekuhlela. Imodi lelawulwayo idzinga i-configuration file legcwele, lekhonako kusebenta - hhayi sibonelo lesitsite. 5. Khetsa Validate & Preview. Lungisa tonkhe tinkinga letibikiwe ngaphambi kwekulondvolota. 6. Gcina, wakhe kabusha i-Synix, usebentise luhlolo lolutimele, bese uhlola kufaka/kucala/kuyekela/kulandzelela lomdlalo.
Emasimu LAFUNELEKAKO • Ligama lemdlalo: ligama lebasebentisi labalibona ku Synix. • Definition ID: unique lowercase ID; I-Synix ikwakhela yona ngeligama lalomdlalo. • Steam AppID: i-AppID ye-server lekhetsiwe, hhayi ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi i-AppID yemdlalo weklayenti. • Luhlelo lwekusebenta lwe-SteamCMD: ngalokujwayelekile alunalutfo. Imidlalo ye-GoldSrc AppID 90 isebentisa lifomu lelicinisekisiwe lelitsi '90 mod folder', njenge '90 mod cstrike'. I-Synix yemukela kuphela loluhlobo loluphephile. â€¢ I-executable: sibonelo Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. ayifaki i-folder yekufaka. • Emachweba: emachweba labekiwe lacinisekisiwe emdlalo nemibuto. • Emabalave kanye netindlela temidlalo: faka linani linye lelicondzile lemdlalo emgceni ngamunye. Loku kugcwalisa kukhetsa lokuboniswa ngesikhatsi kwakhiwa nobe kuhlelwa kweseva.
TINKHOLO LETIKHULULWAKO Ungayifaki i-executable. Gcina timphawu temdlalo njengembhalo lowetayelekile bese ufaka emathegi kuphela kumazinga lalawulwa yi-Synix. Sibonelo: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
I-ARGUMENT LESEKELWE ngemagama [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE (Kudla lokunongotelako) Beka i-{rcon} kuletintfo tekusungula lapho khona umyalo longakhetsi i-RCON. Ku-syntax ye-RCON, sebentisa: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Sibonelo RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
KULUNGISELWA KWEKUTIPhatsa â€¢ Akukacinisekiswa kwanyalo: i-Synix ayilawuli i-config file. • Umdlalo uyakha ngemuva kwekucala: sebentisa i-config lephelele njengesifanekiso sekuhlela nekulungisa. • I-Synix iyakha kusuka ku-template: I-Synix ibeka i-config lephelele ngaphambi kwekucala. â€¢ Tintfo tekusungula kuphela: umdlalo awudzingi luhlelo loluphetfwe ngaletintfo.
I-TEMPLATE TAGS CONFIGURATION (Emathegi etitfombe) {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} I-{HasPassword} ibhala linani lelicinisekisiwe lalenchazelo uma kuneluphasiwedi yesiphakeli bese ibhala leliphasiwedi lelingilo nangabe leliphasiwedi lite lutfo. Sebentisa i-Add configuration files uma i-server idzinga emafayela langetulu kwalinye. Khetsa onkhe emafayili laphelele, bese uhlela indzawo yawo le-Installled kulelithebula kuze kutsi indlela ihlobane nelifolda leseva. I-Synix icinisekisa, ifaka, ibhala, ilungisa, iphindze ivuselele onkhe emafayela labhalwe ndzawonye.
Emafayela LAFUNDZISWA NGUMKHULUTSI Faka indlela leyodvwa lephephile emgceni ngamunye, macondzana nelifolda leseva lefakiwe. Emafayela ladzingekako avimba kucalwa kwanyalo; emafayela langakhetsi ayangeniswa uma atfolakele kepha akavimbeli kucala. Nangabe lamafayela ladzingekako avela emdlalweni lowetayelekile, chaza tonkhe tinyatselo temsebentisi kuletindlela tekusebentisa. I-Synix ayikaze ilandze, igweme bunikati, nobe ihambise emafayela emdlali lanelayisensi. Lifolda ledatha yangaphandle ligama lefolda Synix lingafuna ngaphansi kwemafolda emiculu yemsebentisi. Yishiye ingenalutfo nangabe umsebentisi kufanele akope lamafayela ngesandla.
Secwayiso Sekucala Sekusebenta Kanye ne-ICON Vumela secwayiso uma basebentisi kumele bagcwalise kulungiswa ngaphambi kwekucala kwekusebenta. Bhala tinyatselo leticondzile bese ukhomba nobe ngabe yini umsebentisi ladzinga kuyitfola ekufakweni kwemdlalo wakhe. I-URL ye-icon ayikhetsi futsi kufanele isebentise HTTPS. I-Synix ibuyela emuva kulesitfombe se-server lesifakiwe uma singenalutfo.
KULUNGISELWA KWEMIKHILA KANYE NEKUPHEPHA Cala tinchazelo letinsha kanye netitemplate ku-revision 1. Khulisa lizinga lekuguculwa kwenchazelo njalo nje uma kunekugucuka kwenchazelo yemdlalo. Kwandzisa luhlelo lwekuhlela kuphela uma luhlelo lwekuhlela loluphetfwe lushintja. I-Synix ayivumi kubhalwa ngetulu kwemandla ngaphandle kwekubuyeketwa lokukhulu futsi igcina ema-backups ekuvuselela.
KUKHETWA KWAKHO NGEMVA KEKUFAKWA Vumela i-Steam runtime copying kuphela uma i-server icinisekisiwe kutsi iyayidzinga. Lendzawo lekucondziswe kuyo kufanele ibe yifolda lengekhatsi kulokufakwa kweseva. I-Synix ikopa kuphela lama-DLL ayo lamatsatfu avumelekile ekuhambeni kwe-Steam.
Tidzingo te-Runtime Faka sisindvo lesincane se-RAM ku-0 uma umdlalo ute sisindvo lesincane lesicinisekisiwe. Luhlelo lwekuhlola lolwentiwa ku-Hardware kanye ne-Windows luchaza tidzingo letingasekho ngaphambi kwekusungulwa futsi luvimbe kusetjentiswa lokungakaphephi; Atishintji kusetjentiswa kwe Windows. Khetsa i- .NET Framework nobe i-Visual C++ runtime kuphela nangabe tidzingo temdlalo tiyayiveta. I-Synix ihlola i-registry ye-Windows kepha ayikaze ifake nobe ilandze tintfo letidzingekako ngekuthula. I-Hyper-V idzinga i-Windows Professional nobe ngetulu, ngako kukhetsa i-Hyper-V kuphindze kukhetse le-Windows.
KUKHULUMELEKA NGESIKHATSI Sekucala Sebentisa kulandzelela inchubo lokujwayelekile kumaseva laniketelwe. Kusetjentiswa kwangaphandle kwentiwa kuphela ku-launcher, i-virtual machine, nobe kusetjentiswa lokunye lokungumnikati we-server lifecycle; ikhubaza kulandzelela imibuto ngalokuphelele. Vumela i-Required visible manager yemidlalo lapho i-official server manager kufanele ihlale ivulekile. Loku kwenta kutsi umsebentisi angakhoni kuvala i-hide-console yakhe. Kusungulwa lokuphakanyisiwe kusekelwa kuphela kumafayili ekucala .exe, .bat, kanye .cmd. Vumela i-launch-file export kuphela uma umsebentisi angakha aphindze asebentise i-launch file ngaphandle kwe Synix. Umlayeto wekutsi kulungele uboniswa ngemuva kwekutsi luhlolo lolukhetsekile lwekulungela lomdlalo luphumelele. Letindzawo tikhetsa indlela leyakhelwe ngekhatsi, i-Synix leyemukelwe futsi angeke isebentise imibhalo nobe ema-plugins.
KUTFUNYWA KWELUHLELO Faka tindlela letiphephile letihambelana nelifolda leseva lefakiwe. Sebentisa * kuyinye incenye yendlela nobe ligama lefayela bese usebentisa ** kumafolda lahlanganisiwe. Tintfo tekugcina tindzawo letisekelwa nguleti: {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, na {QueryPort}. Sibonelo: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix ifunisisa letindlela kuphela uma umsebentisi afuna kuvula libhuku lemdlalo lelisha.

data.name: Text.ED08E4C207A6FC2493D7
data.value: ◇ Emasimu labukene netintfo letitsite kufanele alandzele indlela yekusebentisa imfihlo (Synix Privacy Mode).

data.name: Text.4234688FB477D9CF1421
data.value: ◇ Tindlela tekulawula letisebentiselwa kukhetsa titfombe: Tintfo letingasetjentiswanga tivalwa ngalokucondzile emdlalweni lokhetsiwe.

data.name: Text.1B0142C80D27A3442046
data.value: ⚠ Kuntjintja lendzawo angeke kususe ema-backups ku-folder lendzala.

data.name: Text.A9B62C4456D11AE0550C
data.value: 🔒 [REQUIRED] Faka ligama leseva bese ukhetsa i-Game Template.

data.name: Text.1A759326BD5A56996BF1
data.value: I-1 idatha yakho ihlala yehlukanisiwe Ema-server, tikhungo, ema-backups, sikhatsi sekusebenta, kanye ne-SteamCMD kugcinwa ngaphansi kwe-C:\Synix ngako-ke tinhlelo letinsha atiwafaki esikhundleni sawo.

data.name: Text.CD33F03B524794FFF78C
data.value: 2 Kwengeta i-Server Khetsa umdlalo, ungene ku-friendly settings, bese uvumela i-Synix kutsi iwuhlele. I-login ye-Steam iyadzingeka kuphela uma umdlalo uyidzinga.

data.name: Text.61A00FCEB996AF15FF21
data.value: 3 QALA, YIMA, FUKA KANYE UHLOLISE I-Synix ikhombisa imicondvo lecondzile yekucala, icinisekisa kucala, isebentisa indlela yekumisa lephephile lapho kusekelwa khona, futsi igcina emalogi lakamuva latfolakalako.

data.name: Text.CA9A7AA7C8AF17BABA8C
data.value: 4 KUKHONA KUFIKELELA ENTJINI Windows imvumo ye-Firewall kanye nekwendluliswa kwechweba le-router kwehlukile. I-Synix ihlola kungcubutana kwasendzaweni, kepha ayikaze igucule i-router yakho.

data.name: Text.C638A97009ED3C9CCB29
data.value: I-5 KULANDZISWA NEKUBUYELISWA Kwetintfo Letitsite Sebentisa i-Settings > Advanced > Troubleshooter kute ucinisekise kuhlolwa kwekuphepha kanye nekulungisa. Sebentisa i-Backups ngaphambi kwekuhambisa i-Synix nobe wente tingucuko letinkhulu.

data.name: Text.74ECEE4668229DC04361
data.value: Ligama le-akhawunti, hhayi ligama lakho lekubonisa le-Steam

data.name: Text.C404A6A32FD8F56893D3
data.value: Faka onkhe lamanye emathempulethi ledzingeka kulomdlalo. Hlela indzawo leyakhiwe kute indlela ngayinye ihlobane nelifolda leseva leyakhiwe.

data.name: Text.3E1844F80A694282E164
data.value: Tincwadzi letitfutfukile Discord Tindzawo letiyiwa kuto

data.name: Text.8F2ED817BE8BBE23D64C
data.value: Bufakazi lobutimele buvela etentweni te-Synix; tinkhulumo tidzinga luhlolo lwe-real-server.

data.name: Text.BC489FF2DAD82D69C258
data.value: Luhlu lwekuhlola lolutintile kanye netinyatselo letilandzelako

data.name: Text.A8BC53DE427A5E93DAED
data.value: Yakha i-Games/server lephephile ngephansi kwalendlela ye-Games.

data.name: Text.1232008495CAD0B69745
data.value: Emabhulokhi acala ngekukhombisa kucondziswa kwe Microsoft uma sikhatsi sekusebenta singekho.

data.name: Text.AAFE71EF1584DE2CA4E2
data.value: Kuvimbela kusetjentiswa kwemilayeto lecacile uma iprosesa ingasekeli i-AVX2.

data.name: Text.95E3AA6BFFB7545B20EF
data.value: Hlola sikhatsi sekusebenta, emafayela e-server, tinhlelo, emachweba, i-Windows Firewall, sikhala sediski, tinchubo letiphazamisekile, imiculu yakamuva, ne-Synix update health endzaweni yinye.

data.name: Text.37923AD83E636BE4C27F
data.value: Hlola i-SteamCMD kute utfole lwati lolusha ngaphambi kwekucala kusetjentiswa kweseva.

data.name: Text.6B1DD744008E1B4658A6
data.value: Hlola i-SteamCMD, tikhatsi tekusebenta, emafayela e-server, luhlelo, emachweba, i-Windows Firewall, sikhala sediski, tinchubo letiphutfumako, imilandvo yakamuva, nekutfutfukiswa kwemphilo.

data.name: Text.1DF3BE2046D08A780F73
data.value: Kuhlola lokuphuma kwekushicilela ngaphandle kwekwakha kabusha i-Synix, kucala kukhulula, noma kungena ku-C:\Synix.

data.name: Text.52A32013E2D94B00DBF7
data.value: Kuhlola i-Windows .NET Framework leyakhiwe ngaphambi kwekucala kweseva.

data.name: Text.445F89C824FEC1E5E372
data.value: Kuhlola kutsi kusekelwa kwe-virtualization kuvunyelwe futsi kuyatfolakala ku-Windows.

data.name: Text.58ECD5D931201294DE1E
data.value: Khetsa luhlobo lweseva kute ubonise umlandvo wekucinisekisa wendzawo.

data.name: Text.C9F72F8A6A3B6CC20F72
data.value: Khetsa kuphela indlela yekusebenta leyakhelwe ngekhatsi lecinisekisiwe kule-server lekhetsekile.

data.name: Text.22FCE0291808752AD7BC
data.value: Khetsa i-backup lefanele kutsi itsatse indzawo yemafayela lakhona ku-server.

data.name: Text.30F3BBCB43AC48EBFD1C
data.value: Khetsa lulwimi lolusetjentiswe ngu-Synix. Tintfo letisetjentiswako kanye nemigomo yekuhlela ihlala ingesiNgisi.

data.name: Text.54FE09AF7E87A247A21A
data.value: Khetsa kutsi Synix kufanele yente nini kusetjentiswa kabusha kweseva lokuhleliwe.

data.name: Text.B09F5332EE858BE57F71
data.value: Imiyalo ihlala kule khompyutha ngaphandle uma ngabe uhlele i-Java i-RCON kutsi ikhone kufinyelela khashane.

data.name: Text.82A8EB3A96D059596D55
data.value: Gcwalisa lifayela lelidzingekako ngaphambi kwekutsi i-dedicated server icale.

data.name: Text.F0CDBB393CA93D39DF05
data.value: Indlela yekuhlela lehlobene nefolda leseva lefakiwe

data.name: Text.1315F512F1E9EDAD63BC
data.value: Cinisekisa kususa imitsetfo lebhalwe ephepheni lemlilo

data.name: Text.C2BD3BDCD4926716C67B
data.value: Chubeka kuphela ngemuva kwekuhlola tinyatselo letidzingekako tekulungisa.

data.name: Text.07754DEE7F94A6CA31B1
data.value: Kopisha i-Steam runtime file levumelekile ngemuva kwekufakwa

data.name: Text.DA14A0D982E06E70BB06
data.value: Kopa i-Steam lefayili yekusebenta leyemukelwe ngemuva kwekufakwa

data.name: Text.A388F0CE16C067DFA8C5
data.value: Kuhlanganisa sikhatsi sekusebenta se-Microsoft lesisetjentiswe kumaseva e-2015, 2017, 2019, ne-2022.

data.name: Text.2196E21E8E2F8ABE522B
data.value: Yakha i-backup leseva levikelekile ngaphambi kwekucala ngakunye.

data.name: Text.5D45286D0F2A822299E8
data.value: Yakha inchazelo yemdlalo lecinisekisiwe ngaphandle kwema-plugins nobe imibhalo. Tinchazelo tigcinwa kulephrojekthi bese titfolakala kuphela ngemuva kwekwakhiwa kabusha kwe Synix.

data.name: Text.1F9D51EC4BA893F84146
data.value: Ema-Argument ekucala lacondzile (konkhe lokulandzelako ngemuva kwe-executable)

data.name: Text.9F67BB0F58790841820E
data.value: Kukhubateka ? umsebenti lohleliwe usebenta kuphela uma i-Synix ivulekile.

data.name: Text.84A9F83EFC6F8A9F3401
data.value: Discord ivulekile. Khetsa i-New Post kuleforamu yekubika emaphutsa bese unamatsisela lombiko lowakopishwa.

data.name: Text.0BB9D8B879FB1885FD71
data.value: Unganamatseli emaphasiwedi, ema-webhooks, emakheli e-IP, luhlelo lolutimele, nobe imiyalo lephelele yekucala. I-Synix isusa timfihlo letatiwako ngaphambi kwekutfumela.

data.name: Text.89BF7052C30A2A455D98
data.value: Umtsetfo ngamunye ukhomba ku-executable ngaphansi kwe C:\Synix\Games\[Game]\[Server], kepha leyo folda ye server ayisekho futsi kute i-server ye-Synix lefakwe lenendlela.

data.name: Text.46D0E2FA44635045064B
data.value: Hlela serverconfig.xml ngekuphepha ngaphandle kwekugucula sakhiwo sayo se-XML.

data.name: Text.947BC568AF81FE33EC61
data.value: Vumela kuphela uma kufakwa kwe-SteamCMD kungaphumeleli futsi kudzingeka i-akhawunti ye-Steam.

data.name: Text.2F7C7C280CF67E40627A
data.value: Vumela kuphela uma i-server ingeke isebente kahle ngaphandle kwekuphakama kwe Windows.

data.name: Text.615A691F61191EE9C393
data.value: Vumela i-RCON kuphela kuma templates emidlalo lasekela imiyalo lephephile lesuka khashane.

data.name: Text.59AD73A66B0E19C3759F
data.value: Vumela uma i-server inemibuto lecinisekisiwe nobe luhlolo lwenethiwekhi lolungalandvwa yi-Synix.

data.name: Text.518F7A1D974E46AED149
data.value: Faka ema-ID ngekulandzelana kwawo. Sebentisa ema-comma, tikhala nobe i-ID yinye emgceni ngamunye. I-Synix ayidzingi i-database yemagama emamodeli.

data.name: Text.E486E8326F69B31FB7D5
data.value: Faka lwati lwemdlalo, bese uyalucinisekisa ngaphambi kwekulugcina.

data.name: Text.E83F8984B15353372DF8
data.value: Sibonelo: I-server iyavalwa ngemuva kwemizuzwana lembalwa i-Start

data.name: Text.6F9406E668F812A49DBB
data.value: Kusetjentiswa kwangaphandle kwentela kwetfulwa kwemishini nobe imishini lesebentako futsi kuvimbela kulandzelela imibuto.

data.name: Text.0078A1C33BF28B41D89B
data.value: Kutfola imitsetfo lebeyichutjwa ngaphansi kwe C:\Synix\Games\[Game]\[Server], kepha leyo server ayisekho futsi ifolda yayo seyiphelile. Tikhungo kanye nemaphepha ekufaka langasiwo emtsetfosisekelo akuhlolwa.

data.name: Text.3BE6A898F14F4D050AF5
data.value: Tindlela tekudlala (linani linye lelicondzile emgceni ngamunye)

data.name: Text.88ED3B522C4F0A8BD740
data.value: I-GitHub ayihlanganiswa. Lokukhetsiwe kwe-Copy ne-Discord kusasebenta.

data.name: Text.9942D957346A0E83C15C
data.value: GitHub utfumela imilayeto ngaphandle kwekuvula i-browser ngemuva kwekuhlanganiswa kwe-akhawunti.

data.name: Text.4E4DEFAC10984CADF571
data.value: Fihla emakheli e-IP, emaphasiwedi, kanye nalokunye kwatiswa lokubucayi ngesikhatsi uhlanganyela sikrini.

data.name: Text.A8578B710044B649B2CD
data.value: Indlela umsebentisi latfola ngayo bese ufaka emafayela emdlalo ladzingekako

data.name: Text.4E469076738CB74F0877
data.value: Ngiyacinisekisa ligama leseva lelikhonjisiwe, emachweba, umkhawulo webadlali, kanye nalamanye emagugu lasetjentiswe ngulenchazelo, kufaka ekhatsi emaphasiwedi, i-RCON, imodi, nelibalave/umhlaba lapho kufanele khona.

data.name: Text.13F02AECB00BE9833629
data.value: Imininingwane lemayelana ne-Identity, umhlaba, umdlali kanye nenethiwekhi

data.name: Text.5D385B4C5044DA97B77C
data.value: IMPORT Akukho liphasela lelikhetsiwe Khetsa liphasela kute ukhone kubala indzawo nesikhatsi.

data.name: Text.44D7882A1ADBECC9092C
data.value: Faka lomdlalo ku-Synix ngaphambi kwekucala kuhlola indlela lesebentako.

data.name: Text.70CAC3F03884A4946236
data.value: Kufakwa, kucalwa, kumiswa kanye nekulandzelelwa kwemisebenti yekuhlola kubhalwa ngemshini. Kucinisekiswa kwetimphawu kusebentisa i-server mbamba lefakiwe kanye nekuhlola kwekulawula lokuhlantekile; kulungiswa kuhlala kungumsebenti wekuhlola emafayela.

data.name: Text.D3F2BA487FAA0A74E4A4
data.value: Ivumela umsebentisi kutsi akhe i-reviewed launch file. Khweshisa imiyalo yekusebenta lekumele ihlale ngekhatsi kwe Synix.

data.name: Text.2FD27154D5938042C2FF
data.value: Nciphisa linani letincwadzi tekulondvolota letigcinwe nge-server ngayinye.

data.name: Text.E749931070B84A1593D2
data.value: Umsebenti wekusebenta ngekushesha kuto tonkhe tinchubo temaseva emidlalo.

data.name: Text.F31BBCEE0082BEEE372A
data.value: Kukhetfwa kwemephu nemodi kutfolakala ngco kulethempulethi yemdlalo lekhetsiwe.

data.name: Text.FDA8F741D724B426C343
data.value: Emabalave nobe simo (linani linye lelicondzile emgceni ngamunye)

data.name: Text.A5C1D46A9B2A472DF537
data.value: Umlayeto uboniswa ngemuva kwekuphumelela kweluhlolo lwebulungiswa lobukhetsekile (akukhetsiwe)

data.name: Text.71F9139AF2A58247E590
data.value: Luhlelo loluncane RAM ku GB (0 kusho kutsi alukho loluncane)

data.name: Text.0F38AC5E2C273A4B6642
data.value: Hlola emachweba e-server lasebentako kute utfole emaphakethe langenako bese utfola kwatiswa mayelana nekwehla kwe-traffic lokungakajwayeleki.

data.name: Text.1C310A469AD1721A3E91
data.value: Hlola uphindze uphatse onkhe ema-server emdlalo kusuka endzaweni yinye yekusebenta.

data.name: Text.A6D637EAA965641CEB00
data.value: Bita lendzawo lotawuya kuyo, ufake i-webhook yayo ye-Discord, bese ukhetsa kahle kutsi ngutiphi tintfo te-Synix letitawutfolwa.

data.name: Text.8DDA097844BB6EDCFA10
data.value: Akukashintjwa: emafayili emdlalo, ema-server lagciniwe, imitsetfo ye-port kuphela, emafolda ekufaka lakhetsiwe, nemitsetfo ye-firewall ngaphandle kwe-C:\Synix\Games.

data.name: Text.4DC50DE227F1D75CFF26
data.value: Kuphela kwe-identifier ye-webhook lefihliwe lekhonjisiwe. Vula i-Server Settings kute ubuke noma uhlele indzawo lotawuya kuyo.

data.name: Text.A8796566765C1117B49C
data.value: Kuphela linani lolishintjile litawuguculwa; kuphawula, tigaba, kuhlanganisa, ticashunwa, tikhala, kanye nekuhleleka kwemagama kuyachubeka kungasebenti.

data.name: Text.8736DCB51A77046719F5
data.value: Vula i-console yemdlalo nawuyicala. Vimbela loku kwentela kusebentisa emaseva ngekuthula ngemuva.

data.name: Text.656F6C1DD0569874658F
data.value: Emafayela ekungenisa langakhetfwa (tindlela letihambisanako, linye emgceni ngamunye)

data.name: Text.CB904327966ABA4B8621
data.value: i-syntax ye-RCON lengakhetsiwe kusetjentiswa kwetimphawu kumele kufake ekhatsi i-{rcon}

data.name: Text.36B18A6020F2CE06DF28
data.value: Kuvala i-Synix's hide-console preference kumaseva laphetfwe ngelifasitelo lawo.

data.name: Text.F2492B6E06AE47BEB928
data.value: Kutfolakala kweticheme kuhlolwa ngekutivocavoca uma kucatsaniswa netinchubo letisebentako kanye nalamanye emaseva e-Synix.

data.name: Text.F13396A9BD6FFF26191D
data.value: I-Privacy Mode iyayifihla lemvumo yekufinyelela. Faka ikhodi yakho, noma uyishiye ingenalutfo ekufakeni kwekucala kute uvumele i-Windrose kutsi ikhiphe ikhodi.

data.name: Text.82F665628E2402225B0F
data.value: Kusetjentiswa kwe-identity kanye nekusetjentiswa kwemitfombolusito lesebentako kuwo onkhe ema-server emdlalo.

data.name: Text.517D0391800FC8C55AD3
data.value: Ivikelwe ku Synix futsi ifihlwe kumalogi ayo. Emafayela e-batch lakhicitwako afaka ekhatsi i-token lengasetjentiswa embhalweni lofundzekako.

data.name: Text.49CDA0DED2FDB6421A49
data.value: Kukhetfwe lifolda lekushicilela. Hlola nangabe sewulungele.

data.name: Text.EC423125FB2CAF05C95B
data.value: Imiyalo lephutfumako Khetsa munye uwulungiselele, bese uyawubuyekeza bese uyutfumela

data.name: Text.15599B0016F3C3591CF5
data.value: Emagugu lafundvwa kuphela angakhetfwa aphindze akopishwe kwentela kuhlola

data.name: Text.69EDD9A74D913D8F77D6
data.value: Kucinisekiswa kwekubhalwa kuphela kwesakhiwo selithempulethi, kuguculwa, nemagugu lagcinwe ku-Server Settings. Ema-password awakaze aboniswe.

data.name: Text.D4BEB0C27C58D53CCFA7
data.value: Kufundza nekuhlola umtapo wetincwadzi we-project game definition...

data.name: Text.54C8BBF4B91A6012A87B
data.value: Kulungela Windows icela imvumo yebaphatsi kuphela nangabe imitsetfo idzinga kususwa.

data.name: Text.2B2FF7B1710C1AE35612
data.value: Lilungele kuhlola emafayela lashicilelwe kanye nekutfola luhlolo lolwakhiwe ngesikhatsi sekushicilela.

data.name: Text.FD866259C3EE73E57510
data.value: Silungele kuvivinya umtapo wetincwadzi lotakhele wona.

data.name: Text.C0BAAF3EA26A1A69CE63
data.value: Silungile. Kunconywa kutsi kusetjentiswe i-30 yemaminitsi kanye ne-30 yemasekhondi kwentela kuhlola lokusheshako.

data.name: Text.0C10BD130731730DDC5C
data.value: Vuselela kute ulayishe imininingwane yemdlali kusuka kumseva wendzawo.

data.name: Text.4CB636A73FAD7D71BC94
data.value: Luhlolo lwekwetsembeka luyehla. Kute kusetjentiswa kwe-server lokwashintjwa.

data.name: Text.FE3F7B0A38B0EEDF20EB
data.value: Kukhombisa ngekuphindzaphindza inkhumbulo ye-Synix, tibambo, ema-threads, nekuhlola imphilo ye-read-only server. Ayicali, ayimisi, ayifakeli, ayivusetele nobe igucule i-server.

data.name: Text.D320B9FEE80C1B53C8BD
data.value: Kudzingeka kutsi kube nelifasitelo le-server manager lelibonakalako

data.name: Text.88E68081C6F4A7C6EEE2
data.value: Kudzingeka kutsi iwindi lemcondzisi we-server ihlale ibonakala

data.name: Text.9E09BE4B90E9259491DD
data.value: Imikhakha ledzingekile ivusetelwa ngalokwetayelekile kulomdlalo lokhetsiwe.

data.name: Text.AD654849FC9CF1C6D997
data.value: Emafayela ladzingekile kanye netitemplate letentiwe yi-Synix tivumela secwayiso.

data.name: Text.B0DAEADE1B96AB9F8EB5
data.value: Kufunwa ngetintfo letifana ne Hyper-V letingatfolakali ku Windows Ekhaya.

data.name: Text.5BA4DAF696F2453133A8
data.value: Ema-argument ekucala ladzingekako afakwa ngemandla ngemininingwane yakho ngaphambi kwekucala. Ungafaka nobe ngutiphi timphawu temugca wemyalo letingekho kulelinani lelibekiwe endzimeni letsi Extra Arguments.

data.name: Text.5DC5CE2CCFBCC1F3AE31
data.value: Emafayela ladzingekako laniketwa ngumsebentisi (tindlela letihambisanako, linye emgceni ngamunye)

data.name: Text.A95511418E3B85D2CCA6
data.value: Kucala kabusha li-awa ngekusebentisa iwashi le-24

data.name: Text.2D41AABA41C2EF3FED5C
data.value: Cala kabusha emalanga lakhetsiwe ngesikhatsi lesibekiwe ube ulondvolota idatha yekuhlela yanyalo.

data.name: Text.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Bukisisa kutsi Synix uwakha njani umyalo losetjentiswa ekuvuleni le server.

data.name: Text.FC0C7D5D72BB74B7579E
data.value: Hlola imiculu yelayisensi ngaphambi kwekuvumela kusetjentiswa kweseva kwekucala.

data.name: Text.A2CBC7E3EEB055BE8AFC
data.value: Hlola letimfuneko tekusungula ngaphambi kwekutsi uchubeke.

data.name: Text.B38F7F9752C285B4B90B
data.value: Kusebentisa luhlaka lwephakeji, i-SHA-256, nekuhlola i-antivirus...

data.name: Text.5D719633D44DEE05A861
data.value: Cwaninga ngemdlalo, i-executable, nobe simo sekusekela...

data.name: Text.4CDDB86B34725DFF943D
data.value: Kuhlolwa kwekuphepha kwavimbela leliphasela. Kute emafayela lashintjiwe.

data.name: Text.8C5A71A792CF70840F4B
data.value: Buka kahle kutsi yini i-Synix lengayifaka, ilungise, ibuke, iphindze ibute ngaphambi kwekwakha iseva.

data.name: Text.339761CAC4ADD79725CB
data.value: Kubona kutsi nguyiphi indzawo ye-Discord letsatsa luhlobo ngalunye lwesatiso se-Synix salomphakeli.

data.name: Text.FFF9C013BFE465B863CB
data.value: Khetsa umdlalo kute uvuselele bufakazi bekucinisekisa.

data.name: Text.F576F35548B3364CBEDB
data.value: Khetsa i-server lefakiwe bese ucinisekisa umyalo wayo.

data.name: Text.DA03B7F52F79500329AF
data.value: Tfumela simo, ema-backups, kulondvolota, netinkinga kutiteshi letehlukene te-Discord.

data.name: Text.A50A426E7FA853DA7584
data.value: Tindzawo temarekhodi e-server (indlela yinye lehlobene nobe indlela ye-wildcard emgceni ngamunye)

data.name: Text.D72917FA7B697BD4F0E1
data.value: Kuboniswa kwentela kucacisa kute ucinisekise kutsi umyalo wekucala awunato tintfo letifihlekile.

data.name: Text.20C57F23AC717E8E040D
data.value: Kucala kusetjentiswa kwe-server nge Synix. Kulindzele kutsi umlaleli wayo aphendvule...

data.name: Text.091C22C7EE122D76DAE4
data.value: Kucala kulandzelela ngemuva uma ungena ku Windows. Kuvala ideshibhodi ye-Synix ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi kucedza i-Synix ngalokuphelele kweseshini lekhona.

data.name: Text.AFC6E98203B42710D6D2
data.value: Gcina ema-archives lasetjentisiwe kanye nalawo langasetjentiswanga ngekwendalo efolda lekhetsiwe.

data.name: Text.A03EE332F98F4733802C
data.value: Shintsha ideshibhodi ye-Synix emkhatsini wetitfombe letikhanyako naletimnyama.

data.name: Text.1263E823649071566AFC
data.value: I-Synix yakha umyalo mbamba ngekusebentisa luhlelo lolugciniwe lwale-server, ifihla yonkhe i-password, iwucale ngalokwetayelekile, bese ilindzela bufakazi bekutsi le-server iyemukele le-launch.

data.name: Text.030EBC77E93FA53151CE
data.value: I-Synix ayivuli i-web-control port yemphakatsi. Emaphasiwedi lagcinwe yi-Synix avikelwe endzaweni yakini, futsi emagugu laneluvelo ayafihlwa kumalogi emsebenti.

data.name: Text.69B1390848A4F53A80A2
data.value: I-Synix ifaka i-server loader lekhetsiwe kanye ne-Java lehambisanako. Yengeta imodi yakho ngemuva kwekufakwa.

data.name: Text.93F24BC2C28FEF1DDC28
data.value: I-Synix yakhelwe kwenta kusetjentiswa kwe-server yemdlalo kube lula ngaphandle kwekufihla loko lokushintjako kukhompyutha yakho.

data.name: Text.DB74849CCDF411527A63
data.value: I-Synix icinisekisa ema-backups ngekwemukelwa kwebucotfo, ngekuphepha ihlela i-archive lekhetsiwe, bese ibuyela emuva uma kubuyiselwa kwehluleka. Kufakwa kwe-Synix leseva lokulondvolotiwe kanye netisetjentiswa takhona akukaguculwa.

data.name: Text.F283ABEE58C3C5919882
data.value: I-Synix icinisekisa sento ngasinye ngalokuphelele ngemuva kwekuphumelela kwaso kule-PC.

data.name: Text.7083BACCFEE1C7E3CC47
data.value: Sitjele kutsi ukuchofoze kuphi, yini i-Synix lebonakele, nekutsi singakwenta njani loko kuphindze kwenteke.

data.name: Text.D25BF1DE94C6CFCB40D4
data.value: Kuhlola tonkhe tinchazelo letakhelwe-ngekhatsi netitfombe ngekuphepha...

data.name: Text.91657E9737A951B3ADA2
data.value: Kuvivinya wonkhe umdlalo lowakhelwe kuwo, kubopha indlela yekusebenta, luhlelo loluphelele lwekuhlela, kubuyeketwa, indlela, indzawo yelog, kanye netinyatselo letivumelekile ngemuva kwekufakwa. Ema-server lafakiwe akaze ashintjwe.

data.name: Text.849FF4D03C300A88F143
data.value: Lokuchumana kwasendzaweni kwacedvwa. Vuselela i-Synix kulelikhasi le-GitHub lelivulekile.

data.name: Text.199AA28C30C28597C6E2
data.value: Lombiko lohlongotwa ngemfihlo wakopishwa futsi ulungele kunamatsiselwa ku-forum yetinkinga ye-Discord.

data.name: Text.0117F5327FA39CD0DABB
data.value: Luhlolo lwekukhululwa lwahociswa. Kute emafayela lakhicitwako lashintjiwe.

data.name: Text.AB89F96B667CE80E48CB
data.value: Umbiko wekwetsembeka utawuphuma ngemuva kwekuphela kwaloluhlelo loluceliwe.

data.name: Text.44D8326D9590F71F8B1B
data.value: Leseva lekhetsiwe idzinga i-akhawunti ye-Steam kutsi ifakwe. Faka ligama le-akhawunti lekufanele lisetjentiswe ngu-SteamCMD.

data.name: Text.D305131EE6798E1D30FA
data.value: I-server kumele ihlale imile ngesikhatsi sekubuyiselwa

data.name: Text.BCB4E85BFE366942E9D4
data.value: I-server yema ngaphambi kwekutsi kuvulwe. Hlola imibhalo yayo yakamuva kanye nenchazelo.

data.name: Text.946FF9E0EB0FA926E2AF
data.value: I-server yekuhlola imisiwe. Bufakazi lobuphelele balenkhulumo buyagcinwa.

data.name: Text.7B3AC1F3AD7BA73ED0CC
data.value: Lamagugu ayavunyelwa kuphela uma i-template leseva lekhetsiwe iyawasekela.

data.name: Text.7CB94F75343DF207439A
data.value: Lendlela yekubonisa lemininingwane ikhombisa ema-default arguments lasetjentiswa ngu-Synix nakakha umyalo wekucala.

data.name: Text.6440A1A6AB337CD371BA
data.value: Yivule onkhe emalanga ngesikhatsi lesihleliwe sekucalisa kabusha.

data.name: Text.348C3C8FD21539135DB5
data.value: Lokwatiswa lokusha mayelana nekuphepha kuvela lapha.

data.name: Text.A8142050CBD33EE95F3F
data.value: Sebentisa litubane leliphelele nobe unciphise kusetjentiswa kwemaseva emidlalo, kuvuselelwa, kulungiswa kanye nekucinisekiswa.

data.name: Text.60ADFA0715E4E83522DF
data.value: Sebentisa i-webhook yinye kule-server bese ukhetsa imilayeto lekumele iyitfole.

data.name: Text.4910EE68C0A14BD4AF19
data.value: Sebentisa kuphela uma kuhlolwa kukhombisa kutsi iseva idzinga emafayela e-DLL avunyiwe Steam. Umgomo kumele uhlale ngekhatsi kwelifolda leseva.

data.name: Text.1433E221238B95E942F7
data.value: Sebentisa kuphela uma i-server isetjentiswe nge-Hyper-V nobe Windows.

data.name: Text.F2029FAFB53EFFEE6890
data.value: Isebentisa sikhatsi sendzawo ye-computer kanye nesikhatsi se-24.

data.name: Text.229193F097F563A43177
data.value: Kulandzelana kwekucinisekiswa kwavusetelwa kusuka kulobufakazi lobugciniwe be-Synix.

data.name: Text.A7678DBAFBD9E2842236
data.value: I-Hardware lecinisekisiwe kanye netidzingo te-Windows tiyahlolwa ngaphambi kwekutsi i-Synix ifake nobe icalise iseva.

data.name: Text.16FB4FBCA9A11AC839AE
data.value: Kucinisekiswa kwetindlela temlandvo kanye nekwetsembeka kwe SHA-256...

data.name: Text.29CAE0D1FFE7D67CA266
data.value: Kulindza i-sample yekucala • Kuvuselela lokuzenzakalelayo njalo ngemizuzwana lengu-1

data.name: Text.9B1DF515009197F7B731
data.value: Lokwatiwa ngu-Synix kwanyalo kutsi ungayifaka njani, uyilungiselele, uyicale, uyihlole futsi ubute ngayo lomdlalo.

data.name: Text.C29162E9E78CEEA6A66B
data.value: Uma kuvunyelwe, kususa i-server kucela imvumo yekususa imitsetfo yayo ye-Windows. Vimbela loku kute unciphise kuhlanta ngesikhatsi ususa.

data.name: Text.9D352A1132C068237394
data.value: I-Windows icela imvumo yebaphatsi. I-Synix ibese isusa kuphela imitsetfo ye-firewall lefana netindlela leticondzile tekusebenta letingenhla bese iphindze ihlola kucinisekisa kuhlanta.

data.name: DynamicText.C0DC4B8E2D0B8558D8E2
data.value: • Lesinyatselo sibhaliwe ngekuhamba kwemsebenti we server.

data.name: DynamicText.F36B8F89A6A8DD2ACEF1
data.value: Cinisekisa emagugu labonakalako emdlalweni ngaphambi kwekubhalisa kucinisekiswa.

data.value: emafayela). Khetsa lelinye lifayela lelingetulu kuloluhla lolungenhla.

data.value: tinhlelo letingaba khona telusito. Khetsa umdlalo lofanele ngentasi.

data.value: Beka emachweba etinsita uphindze uvikele nekuphatsa lokukude.

data.value: Kuhlola le-PC kanye nawo onkhe ema-server lafakiwe...

data.name: DynamicText.B74B06EC6EEB1F159449
data.value: Khetsa lifayela lelibhaliwe nobe lelijwayelekile lelicuketse konkhe lokuku-C:\Synix, nobe ulibuyisele kukhompyutha lensha.

data.name: DynamicText.CB565F94960FAEEC9A40
data.value: Khetsa lifolda leselivele likhona kute uchubeke.

data.name: DynamicText.793006985DD52D518C6D
data.value: Khetsa siteshi sekulondvolota bese ulungisa ema-argument ekucala.

data.name: DynamicText.A621C06C3B84375BB5BD
data.value: Khetsa indzawo lapho i-server itawufakwa khona. I-Synix iniketa imitsetfo yekucalisa lephakanyisiwe.

data.name: DynamicText.36A6C5ECE85999A4BE81
data.value: Kwehluleka kwekucinisekisa umyalo. Kulungisa emaphutsa ngaphambi kwekucala luhlolo.

data.name: DynamicText.99916B9A2D79AE0044D5
data.value: Kucinisekiswa kwemyalo sekwendlulile. Cala loluhlolo kute ucinisekise kutsi i-server sibili iyalwemukela.

data.name: DynamicText.7ECD8218EFACE24753CD
data.value: Lungisa ludzaba loluvaliwe ngaphambi kwekutsi uchubeke.

data.value: Kusetjentiswa kwe CPU • Kuvuselelwa kabili ngemzuzwana

data.name: DynamicText.4477A4C46D66B4C3CDD3

data.value: Inchubo ye-server icalile. Kulindza umlaleli wakhe lohleliwe (

data.value: I-Synix itawuchubeka nekuhlola i-server ngalokwetayelekile ngesikhatsi icala.

data.name: DynamicText.4135714A2CE40AC94577
data.value: I-Synix ibhala lelithempulethi leliphelele ngaphambi kwekucala futsi iphatse emagugu alo lasekelwako.

data.name: DynamicText.7DA57FD83E46D2A235A5
data.value: Lomdlalo ucala ngekwakha lelifayela. Faka lifayili leliphelele lelibanjiwe kute Synix ikhone kusebentisa emagugu lagciniwe bese iyalungisa ngekuphepha ngemuva kwekusebenta kwekucala.

data.value: Lenchubo iyachubeka. Silindzele kuhlolwa kwekucala kwemzuzwana we-30 (

data.name: DynamicText.B83EC0A78559E32C96D2
data.value: Lomdlalo sewuvele unetinkhulumo letivela ku Synix noma kuletinye tinhlobo letinsha.

data.name: DynamicText.2B2D90F9562301F0CDFF
data.value: Lenchubo ingatsatsa sikhatsi lesitsite ngekuya ngekutsi kungakanani lokudzingeka kuhlanganiswe.

data.name: DynamicText.957B6227F5D5D371C582
data.value: Sebentisa ligama lekungena lelakhiwe ngesikhatsi iphakethe ye-Synix itfunyelwa ngaphandle.

data.name: DynamicText.521C1B97737D7230C110
data.value: Sebentisa umdlalo lokhutsatako kanye nemiculu yekuphenya. I-Advanced mode yengeta kulawula kwe RCON.

data.name: DynamicText.6D2A0FB0BA7193CDCA30
data.value: Silindzele kwemukelwa kwe-GitHub. Lelikhodi liphelelwa sikhatsi nga-

data.name: MessageText.44318E7F273C4C1CC8A3
data.value: Uyafuna kuchubeka bese wakha iphaswedi yekudlulisa?

data.name: MessageText.FEEC1973C8CB7222A750
data.value: Uyafuna yini kuchubeka nekutfumela imiculu lengabhalwanga ngendlela levamile?

data.name: MessageText.D20BD1679795C8D719A6
data.value: Ucinisile yini kutsi ufuna ku-Update the

data.name: MessageText.23CBCB62E27C0309918E
data.value:
Lifayela le-batch lakhiwe ngemphumelelo!
Kugcinwe ngalokucondzile ku:

data.name: MessageText.248D89E27FEDE5EBBB31
data.value: Ayikhonakali kuvala Synix ngalesikhatsi i-server ifaka, ivuselela, igcina, ibuyisela nobe isusa!

data.name: MessageText.2022398CDE720D78BF2A
data.value: Khetsa lifolda lelicuketse emafayela e-Synix lashicilelwe kucala.

data.name: MessageText.C09ACD8E3F4CBB979723
data.value: Chubeka kuphela nangabe lonkhe lwati luvela kumuntfu lometsembako.

data.name: MessageText.53B01E5FCFDE56675C9A
data.value:
Susa i-GitHub ku-Synix?
I-Synix itawususa kuchumana lokufihliwe lokulondvwe kule khompyutha, bese uvula i-GitHub kute ukhone kuhocisa imvumo ku-akhawunti yakho.

data.name: MessageText.FD1FB8A609DE5750E995
data.value: Bufakazi be-Install, Start, Stop, ne-Monitoring butfolwa ngekwe-othomathikhi ngekusebenta kwe-server ye-Synix lengiyo futsi angeke ibekwe ngesandla.

data.name: MessageText.51513CCC80231973A886
data.value: Kutfunyelwa Kwemave Angesheya Lokwetayelekile Akusiyo Imfihlo

data.name: MessageText.D2D13D1289F04B27E55E
data.value: Sekufanele yini ngivule lifolda lekuchaza nyalo?

data.name: MessageText.9B6050841590FD1BB10A
data.value: Sicela umise i-server ngaphambi kwekulungisa imicondvo yayo.

data.name: MessageText.8A7D73F831BD8606CF92
data.value: Setha kabusha i-Config ibe yi-Synix Defaults?

data.name: MessageText.D955BE724373ACFC3AD2
data.value:
Vuselela luhlelo lolusha lwe Synix lwekusekela?
I-Synix itawucala ngekulondvolota lelifayela lekhona kwentela kutsi naloku kubuyisela kungentiwa.

data.name: MessageText.A36A8AE6C94D6549F743
data.value: Gcina nobe unciphise tingucuko ku-editor ngaphambi kwekubuka emagugu lagcinwe kudiski.

data.name: MessageText.3AA26503CC8EA0B171F1
data.value: Sicwayiso Sekuphepha: Lenye yetintfo leniyitfumele inetimphawu letingekho emtsetfweni.

data.name: MessageText.9E4EAF41685A751D0C5D
data.value: Faka indlela yekuhlela umdlalo bese ufaka imininingwane ledzingekako ngaphambi kwekumaka luhlelo lwawo njengalolucinisekisiwe.

data.name: MessageText.37D35536B29E5D04935F
data.value: Vimbela leseva ngaphambi kwekumisa kabusha luhlelo lwayo.

data.name: MessageText.96B14861829C994EDBFF
data.value: Vimbela le-server ngaphambi kwekubuyisela i-backup yekuhlela.

data.name: MessageText.713E1363B1176FB2ABCE
data.value: Vimbela leseva kucala. Loluhlolo kumele lubuke kusetjentiswa lokusha lokwentiwe ngekusebentisa letintfo letibonisiwe.

data.name: MessageText.6B5EDE5E1A10BF24CA11
data.value: Synix akakhoni kutfola lelifolda lemklamo. Sebentisa loluhlelo lwekuhlola kusuka ku-Visual Studio Build nobe Rebuild yephrojekthi ye-Synix.

data.name: MessageText.4AE453C9E5CBA09BFB92
data.value: I-Synix ayikhoni kuvula lwati lwe-webhook leligciniwe le-Discord. Vula i-Server Settings bese ugcina ema-webhooks futsi.

data.name: MessageText.1D7E8CD37BFCD097E6DA
data.value: I-Synix ayinayo i-template lephelele yekusebentisa kabusha lomdlalo.

data.name: MessageText.AA9402AAA45447FCB9A8
data.value: I-Synix itawakha kabusha lonkhe luhlelo kusuka kulesitfombe sayo lesetsembekile, isebentise emagugu lasindzisiwe esiseva, bese igcina i-backup. Kuchubeka?

data.name: MessageText.3679B9A889A4F6F470DA
data.value: Lokwengetelwa kwafakwa futsi kwahlolwa. Cala kusebentisa i-server uma sewulungele.

data.name: MessageText.F23CB309225C503B6D8A
data.value: Lokwengetelwa kwafakwa futsi kwahlolwa. Loluhlaka luvame kulayisha kabusha ngaphandle kwekucala kabusha ngalokuphelele.

data.name: MessageText.21619FB57FA1E3D42E43
data.value: Umyalo kumele uphumelele kuto tonkhe tindlela tekuhlola ngaphambi kwekutsi i-Synix icale luhlolo lwetimphawu.

data.name: MessageText.EA2CD9B6AE3E2608F49E
data.value: I-Game Definition Builder itfolakala kuphela ku-development builds.

data.name: MessageText.2A2FCD5BFFF42E6401AE
data.value: Luhlu lwe-ID ye-mod loluhleliwe selulungile. Umdlalo utawutsatsa nobe uvuselele lokucuketfwe ngumnikati ngesikhatsi i-server icala.

data.name: MessageText.A570646762EA80624E34
data.value: Liphakethe lekudlulisela lelikhetsiwe alizange litfolakale. Khetsa futsi.

data.name: MessageText.313E93838C2B67200EAB
data.value: Lencwadzi yekulondvolota inelipheshana le-SHA-256 lelingasebenti futsi angeke libuyiselwe. Khetsa lenye indlela yekusekela.

data.name: MessageText.379C1CF1A5975C5E0C37
data.value: Lelifolda alikagcwali. Kufaka lapha kungavala emafayela. Kuchubeka?

data.name: MessageText.F94014E8EAE83ED1AC43
data.value: Lomdlalo uphatfwa ngalokuphelele ngemaphuzu ekucala, ngako-ke akudzingeki kutsi kwentiwe luhlolo loluhlukene lwelifayela lekuhlela.

data.name: MessageText.AC3B07BB575D129E2A12
data.value:
Loku kutakwakha kabusha luhlelo lwemdlalo kusuka ku Synix lesisekelo se template bese kusebentisa emagugu lagcinwe ku Server Settings.
Nobe ngabe ngutiphi letinye tindlela tekuhlela titawususwa.

data.name: MessageText.BA03F2AB291E808BE95A
data.value: Linda kuze kufakwa kwanyalo, kuvuselelwa, kusekela, nobe kuntjintjwa kucedvwe ngaphambi kwekucinisekisa liphasela.

data.name: MessageText.D08D6AB01BF21D6FCB08
data.value: I-Windows ayikwazanga kuvula likhasi lekukhishwa le-GitHub.

data.name: MessageText.663E3E2D227DB51428B7
data.value: Une tingucuko tekuhlela letingakagcinwa. Utawatilahla yini bese uyavala?

data.name: MessageText.19580FB3CF2A0F82762D
data.value: Kumele umise leseva ngaphambi kwekucinisekisa emafayili aseva.

data.name: ModManager.Error.LinkedPath
data.value: Lomsebenti wekwengeta usebentisa lifayela lelihlanganisiwe nobe lifolda. Khetsa lifolda lelijwayelekile; I-Synix angeke ilandzele lelikheli.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileMissing
data.value: Lifayela le-add-on langaphambilini lelidzingekako ekubuyiseleni lilahlekile. Kute emafayela lashintjiwe. Buyisela lelifayela lelilahlekile noma usebentise i-backup leseva lecinisekisiwe ngaphambi kwekususa lolokwengetiwe.

data.name: ModManager.Error.RecoveryRetained
data.value: Umsebenti wekwengeta wehlulekile futsi letinye tingucuko atizange tikhone kubuyiselwa emuva. Emafayili ekubuyisa bekagcinwa ku {0}. Gcina i-server ime futsi ubuyisele lamafayela nobe i-backup lecinisekisiwe ngaphambi kwekuyicala.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchValue
data.value: Lendzawo yekwetfula {0} angeke ikhone kudlula ngekuphepha kulenkhululeko yekwetfula Windows. Kufaka ticashunwa letimbili, kuphuka kwemigca, nobe emagama lagucukako akusekelwa lapha. Linani lawo alizange lishintje.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchArguments
data.value: Umyalo we-batch lophelele ucuketse i-syntax yemyalo lengakaphephi nobe kukhuliswa kwe-variable. Kubuyeketwa kwemagugu ekucala kanye netimphawu letengetiwe; kute lokwacala.

data.name: Configuration.Editor.Error.YamlUnsupported
data.value: YAML umugca {0} ayisebenti nobe isebentisa intfo lengeke iguculwe ngalokuphephile. Kusekelwa: umculu munye lonemabalave/luhlu lwema-indent nemigca leminye. Tincwadzi tekuhlanganisa imiculu, emagugu emigca leminyenti, emathegi, ema-anchor kanye nemagama langatiwa awasekelwa. Kute lokwasindziswa.

data.name: GameInput.WorldSeed.RequiredNumber
data.value: Imbewu yeMhlaba iyadzingeka ku {0}: sebentisa inombolo lephelele kusuka ku {1} kuya ku {2}. Kulungisa ku-Server Setup > World Generation.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.RangeHint
data.value: Linani leliphelele kusuka ku-{0} kuya ku-{1}. Kute kube nelive lelikhona, gcina inhlanyelo yalo yekucala.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.Hint
data.value: Khulisa inhlanyelo yemhlaba lomusha, nobe ungene eveni lakho. Kute kube nelive lelikhona, gcina inhlanyelo yalo yekucala.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Profile
data.value: Lendlela yekuhlela emaphakheji isekelwa kuphela kumafolda e-Empyrion lafaka imiculu.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.FolderName
data.value: Sebentisa ligama lalelifolda lelinetinhlamvu letitsi 1–80, ngaphandle kwemagama lamadze, emagama lagodliwe latsi Windows, nobe tikhala. Ligama lesimo angeke libe yinombolo yeWorkshop kuphela.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Layout
data.value: Khetsa luhlelo loluphelele lolutfoliwe nobe i-server mod package lehlanganisiwe, hhayi umdlalo lofakiwe, liqoqo le-Workshop, i-blueprint, nobe i-source-code archive.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioLayout
data.value: Umlandvo kumele ube ne-gameoptions.yaml kanye ne-Content yayo, Playfields, Sectors, nobe Prefabs ndzawonye, kungaba ngasemphandzeni we-ZIP noma ngekhatsi kwemfolda yemlandvo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioCode
data.value: Lephakeji yetindzaba icuketse iDLL, C#, nobe ikhodi yeJAR. Ngenisa ikhodi ye server ngekwehlukana nge Empyrion server mods ngemuva kwekubuka imiyalo yemlobi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ModLayout
data.value: Khetsa liphakethe leliphelele lelihlanganisiwe: emafayili e-DLL nemafayela awo ekusekela kumele abesemphandzeni wephakheji nobe ngekhatsi kwemafolda lahlukene. Emafolda langetiwe kanye nemarekhodi laphelele esiseva akemukeleki.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.MissingScenario
data.value: Leso simo asitfolakali. Tfumela i-scenario lephelele kucala, bese uyikhetsa kuloluhla loluhleliwe.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ConfigurationChanged
data.value: Tintfo letisetjentiswako nobe tilungiselelo tekulondvolota tishintjile ngalesikhatsi lelifasitelo livulekile. Livale bese ukhetsa lesimo futsi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ExistingSave
data.value: Lensindziso seyivele ikhona. Lenye indzaba idzinga ligama lelisha, lelingasebentiswa. I-Synix ayizange itsatse indzawo yelive lelikhona nobe ilisuse.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Configuration
data.value: I-dedicated.yaml ayikho, inkhulu kakhulu, noma ayikhombisi i-GameConfig.CustomScenario ne-GameConfig.GameName. Cala ngekulungisa i-server.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.SaveFailed
data.value: I-Synix ayikwati kulondvolota kungena kweseva. Kubuyiswa kwekwakheka kwesimo sendzaba lendzala; i-backup iyagcinwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ProtectedScenario
data.value: I-Synix angeke isuse lesimo lesikhetsiwe nobe tintfo letitfolakalako ngalesikhatsi kunemhlaba logciniwe. Kungenteka kutsi lemitfombo isetsembele kulamafayili. Kute ema-scenario lakhishwe.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.ImportedScenario
data.value: Emafayela e-scenario atfunyelwe. Umhlaba lokhona nyalo kanye nekukhetfwa kwesimo akukashintjwa. Sebentisa i-Choose Scenario kute ukhetse simo kanye neligama lekugcina. Gcina ligama lelifolda lelifanako nawungenisa lwati lolusha.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ScenarioHelp
data.value: Bhalisa ku-Steam bese uvumela kulandwa kutsi kuphele, bese ukhetsa lifolda lesimo ngaphansi kwe-steamapps\workshop\content\383120, nobe ukhetse i-ZIP yesimo lesiphelele. Loku kungenisa ikhophi yendzawo; I-Steam angeke ivuselele lelikhophi leseva ngalokuphelele.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ModHelp
data.value: Khetsa i-ZIP nobe lifolda leliphelele lelihlanganisiwe lesisetjentiswako kusuka kumbhali lometsembako. Gcina ema-DLL, _Info.yaml (uma aniketwa), tintfo letitsembele kuwo kanye nemagugu ahlangene. I-Synix ayilayishi tintfo letitsite nobe icalise ikhodi ye-mod.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.FolderName
data.value: Ligama lalelifolda le-scenario leseva (lisebentise futsi leligama uma ulungisa)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Confirm
EmpyrionMods.Selection.Saved
data.value: Umlandvo kanye nekukhetfwa kwekulondvolota kugciniwe. Cala i-server uma sewulungele, bese uhlola i-game log yayo bese uchumana ne-client. Emafolda emhlaba wonkhe labekhona agcinwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Help
EmpyrionMods.Selection.SaveName
data.value: Ligama lekugcina (GameConfig.GameName hhayi ligama lekukhombisa leseva)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.NewSaveNotice
data.value: Umfanekiso lowehlukile udzinga kusindziswa lokusha. I-Synix iveta ligama lelisha futsi ayikaze isuse nobe ibhale ngetulu kwemhlaba lokhona.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Scenarios
data.value: Kungenisa lifolda lelilayishiwe nobe i-ZIP. Sebentisa i-Choose Scenario ngemuva kwaloko; emabhokisi lavele akhona ayavikelwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Mods
data.value: Kungenisa emafolda e-mod lahlanganisiwe nobe ema-ZIP. Hlola kulandzelana kwebabhali; Ikhodi isebenta ku Empyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Remove.Confirm
data.value: Buyisela emuva lokungenisiwe lokufaka {0}? Onkhe emafayela lafakwa ngalelo phakeji atawususwa noma abuyiselwe kumakhophi awo akadzeni, kufaka ekhatsi lamanye ema-mods kulelo phakeji. Emafayela laguculwe ngaphandle kwe Synix atawuvimba kubuyela emuva. Gcina i-backup lephelele ngaphambi kwekutsi uchubeke.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.FolderUnsupported
data.value: Loluhlelo lwekwengeta alwesekeli kungeniswa kwemafolda. Khetsa yinye yalemiculu leyasekelwa.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Khetsa lifolda leliphelele lemodi noma lesimo lelicuketse emafayela ladzingekako, hhayi umdlalo lofakiwe nobe inhlanganisela yekulandvwa lokungakahlobani.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Size
data.value: Lephakeji yengca lemikhawulo yekungenisa yaloluhlelo lwekwengeta, nobe lokucuketfwe kwayo kuguculwe ngesikhatsi sekukopishwa. Kute lokwafakwa.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.Help
data.value: Khetsa i-ZIP nobe lifolda leliphelele lemdlalo lokhetsiwe kanye neluhlaka. Gcina imibhalo ledzingekako, tintfo letitsite kanye nemagugu ahlangene. Hlola indzawo lekuyiwa kuyo uphindze uhlole imiphumela ngaphambi kwekufaka.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.SelectFolder
data.value: Khetsa imfolda lephelele ye-mod nobe yesimo, hhayi luhlelo lwekuhlela umdlalo

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Import.ExistingScenario
data.value: Lelifolda lesimo selivele likhona. Emafayili lafanako atawutsatselwa indzawo, lokungahle kutsintse umhlaba usebentisa lesimo. Gcina i-backup lephelele ye-server bese usebentisa ligama lelihlukile lemfolda kwentela simo lesihlukile. Emafayela emhlaba losindzisiwe angeke ashintjwe.

data.name: ModManager.Error.NewerInstallation
data.value: Lokungeniswa lokusha nyalo sekungumnikati wemafayili aloluhlelo. Buyisela emuva lolokungenisiwe lokusha kucala.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileChanged
data.value: Lifayela lekucala leligciniwe lishintjiwe. Kubuyela emuva kwamiswa ngaphambi kwekugucula emafayela e-server. Buyisela li-backup leliphelele lelisetjentiswako uma kunesidzingo.

data.name: ModManager.Inventory.Scanning
data.value: Kuhlola tintfo letengetiwe nekubuka emafayela lalandzelwako...

data.name: ModManager.Inventory.Filtered
data.value: I-{0} ye-{1} lengetiwe ihambisana nelucwaningo lwakho

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Installing
data.value: Kufaka liphasela lelibuketiwe kanye nekugcina emakhophi alokucuketfwe...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Removing
data.value: Kuhlola liphasela leliphelele kanye nekulungisa emafayela akadzeni...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Framework
data.value: Kufaka luhlaka lweseva. Ngicela ugcine lelifasitelo livulekile...

data.name: ModManager.Framework.SaveFailed
data.value: Emafayela e-framework afakiwe, kepha i-Synix ayikwazanga kulondvolota kusetjentiswa kweseva. Hlola imvumo yefolda bese ulondvolota luhlelo lweseva ngaphambi kwekucala. Emafayela lafakiwe awazange asuswe.

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Failed
data.value: Lomsebenti awukapheli. Buketa liphutsa bese uyavuselela ngaphambi kwekutsi uphindze wetame.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewHelp
data.value: Kulawula i-server lekhetsiwe ye-Minecraft lapha. Yima ngaphambi kwekugucula emafayela, umhlaba, emaphakethe, nobe sikhatsi sekusebenta. Cala, yimisa uphindze ucale kabusha kusebentisa tindlela tekuvikela imphilo leyetayelekile ye-Synix.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewValues
MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp
data.value: Sebentisa luhlelo lwekucala kabusha nekulungisa, kufaka ekhatsi kulindza badlali nekwenta i-backup lephelele kucala. Tikhatsi tisebentisa sikhatsi sendzawo yale-PC. I-Synix kumele isebente kute i-scheduler yayo isebente.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Vuselela kute ubone emagama eku-inthanethi kanye neluhlu lwekufinyelela lolugciniwe. Khetsa nobe ubhale ligama lemdlali, bese ubuyeketa lokwentekile. Imiyalo idzinga kuseva lesebentako kanye nekuchumana kwe-console lokusebentako. I-Bedrock ayisekeleli imiyalo yekuvala i-Java.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Hlela server.properties nemafayela ekwakheka kwemod/plugin. Emagugu lasetjentiswe yi-Synix ayavumelaniswa ngesikhatsi i-server.properties igcinwa. Ligama lelikhangisiwe / i-MOTD yehlukile kuleligama lendzawo. Kuvuselela kulayisha imiculu yekuhlela yangaphandle ngalesikhatsi imisiwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Kugcina kwakha emakhophi ekubuyisa. Kuntjintja emachweba, umhlaba, inhlanyelo, imodi yemdlalo, umkhawulo wemdlali, kanye nekusekelwa kwe Minecraft control settings nako kuvuselela Synix. i-JSON, i-XML ne-YAML tihlatiywa ngembi kwekulondvolotwa; nalamanye emafomethi adzinga kulungiswa ngekucophelela. Gcina imininingwane yakho ingatiwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Ngenisa i-Java nobe i-Bedrock ZIP yelive ungene kufolda LENTSHA, bese uyayikhetsa kute uyisebentise. Tintfo letikhona emhlabeni angeke tibuyiselwe endzaweni yato. Imibhalo ayiguculwa. Kuntjintja akucinisekisi kufanelana kwemhlaba nemdlalo; buyela emuva kucala.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Hlola i-JAR metadata kanye netintfo letitsembele kuyo, lawula tintfo letengetiwe, noma hlola iphakethe leliphelele leseva. Sebentisa luhlelo lolucondzile lwemdlalo kanye nekwakhiwa kwe-loader. Kuhlolwa kwekuhambisana kwemakhodi kuyeluleka futsi akukhombisi kutsi ikhodi iphephile nobe kutsi onkhe emamodeli atawusebenta.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: I-backups lephelele ifaka ekhatsi lifolda leseva, umhlaba, ema-add-on, nekwakheka. Vimbela leseva kucala. Ciniseka ngebucotfo ngaphambi kwekubuyisela. Kuvuselela kufaka esikhundleni emafayela e-server; emarekhodi acinisekise kutsi i-archive iphelele, hhayi kutsi i-backup icuketse inkinga leseyivele ikhona.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Tonkhe tingucuko letentekako tigcina emafayela langaphambilini kanye nema-hashes. Khetsa ingucuko leyentiwe nobe lephutfumako kute uyibuyise. Cala ngekucedza tingucuko letinsha. Emafayela laguculwe ngaphandle kanye nemhlaba lotfunyelwe ngaphandle uvikelekile. Gcina i-backup lephelele yekusebentisa sikhatsi sekusebenta/kuvuselelwa kwemhlaba.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Funa tinkinga letivamile kulog ye server yakamuva kanye nembiko wekwehluleka kwakamuva. Tintfo letitfolakalako tingumtfombo wekuciniseka, hhayi tizatfu letivakalako. Inchubo CPU/RAM akusiyo inchubo Minecraft TPS/MSPT; sebentisa i-in-server profiler levumelanako nakuhlolwa kusebenta kwe-tick.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: Faka luhlelo lwemdlalo lolukhetsiwe, i-loader, kanye nekwakha kusuka kumitfombo yabo lesemtsetfweni? Loku kungalayisha i-Java bese isebentisa i-installer ye-Forge/NeoForge. Emafayela e-server ahlelwa kucala; Emafayela lashicilelwe ngaphambilini agcinwa kute abuyiselwe. Emhlaba kanye netintfo letengetiwe tiyalondvolotwa. Yenta i-backup lephelele ngaphambi kwekugucula tinhlobo temdlalo. Kute i-server yemdlalo lecalwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Tfumela umyalo wemdlali lokhetsiwe? Kufinyelela kwe-opharetha kuniketa kulawula lokugcwele kweseva yemdlalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: Utawusebentisa umhlaba lokhetsiwe ekucaleni lokulandzelako? Umhlaba lesiphila kuwo nyalo uhlala usediskini. Khetsa kuphela umhlaba lohambisana nekuhlela, luhlelo kanye nemodi yaleli seva.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Kungenisa loluhlelo lwe-server lolwetsembekile? Liphakethe le-Modrinth lingalayisha emafayela lakhonjisiwe kusuka kumitfombo ye-HTTPS leyemukelwe. Ema-mods kanye nemibhalo yemdlalo isebentisa ikhodi lengekhatsi kweseva yemdlalo. Luhlelo lwekuhlela, kuhlela, kuhambisana, kanye nekuhlolwa kwe-antivirus akusiwo sicinisekiso sekuphepha. Buketa konkhe lokwentiwe ngaphambi kwekusebentisa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Kuhlola kufundvwa kwemetadata ngaphandle kwekulayisha ikhodi ye mod. Tincenye letiyinkimbinkimbi temibhalo, kulandzelana lokunemibandzela, kanye nalokunye lokuhlanganisiwe/kwe-metadata lendzala kudzinga kubuyeketwa ngesandla. Lokuhlola akucinisekisi kuhambisana nobe kungabi khona kwe-malware.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupSpace
data.value: Hlola indzawo yekulondvolota kanye nendzawo lekhona.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Buyisela i-backup legcwele lekhetsiwe? Emafayela lasekhona ale-server atawutsatselwa indzawo. Hlola imiculu bese ugcina nobe nguwaphi emafayela lakhona nawadzinga ngaphambi kwekutsi uchubeke.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Tfola emafayela ekucala alolushintjo. Emafayela langetiwe ngalolushintjo ayasuswa kuphela nangabe angakalungiswa. Emafayela laguculwe avimbela kuvuselelwa. Kwenta i-backup lephelele kuyadzingeka kwentela kubuyisela emuva nobe nguyiphi indlela yekugucula umhlaba leyentiwe ngemuva kwekucala luhlobo lolwehlukile lwemdlalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Kute luhlobo lolutfolakalako etincwadzini letisandza kubhalwa. Loku akusiko kuhlola imphilo ngalokuphelele. Sebentisa i-Readiness bese uhlola liphutsa lekucala lelisedvute nesikhatsi sekwehluleka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Kubuyeketwa ngaphambi kwekusetjentiswa: {0} lensha • {1} lengenile • {2} lesusiwe. Emafayela akadzeni agcinwa kute alungiswe. Kute i-server leyasungulwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Loluhlelo lolucelwa lwekusebenta ngekusimama nobe i-metadata yalo yekulanda ayitfolakali. Vuselela luhlelo/kukhetfwa kwekwakha bese uyazama futsi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Lokucuketfwe kwendlula lelifayela lelisekelwako, imethadatha, nobe bukhulu lobuphelele.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Imininingwane yekutfola ayikatfolakali nobe ayihambisani. Gcina lifolda lekubuyisela futsi usebentise i-backup legcwele lecinisekisiwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Umsebenti wangaphambilini wetintfo letiku-inthanethi udzinga kubuyiselwa. Vula i-Change recovery bese uyayilungisa ngaphambi kwekwenta lolunye lushintjo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: Lifayela leliguculwe kusukela ekuhlolweni nobe kuloluhlelo. Hlatiya futsi uphindze ubuyekete. Kute kuhlela lokungakahlobani nalokunye lokutawubhalwa ngalenye indlela.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Kulungiswa kwephakeji nobe indlela yekusebenta ayikalungi, ayivakali kahle, nobe ayisekelwa. Khetsa i-server pack nobe i-world archive lesekelako.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Lona ngumhlaba lotfwele tintfo letitsite. Shintja ube ngulomunye umhlaba ungakakhoni kuwubuyisela emuva.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Lencwajana yemhlaba seyivele ikhona. Khetsa ligama lelifolda lelisha; Umhlaba lokhona awukabhalwa ngetulu ngekungeniswa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Khetsa i-archive lenemhlaba munye nge level.dat. I-full-server kanye ne-multi-world archives basebentisa i-backup/restore workflow esikhundleni saloko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Lomhlaba awuhambisani ne-server edition nobe ulahlekile emafayela endzawo/endzawo yekubhala. Emhlaba we-Java ne-Bedrock awashintjwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Sebentisa ligama lemfolda lephephile, ngaphandle kwemigca nobe emagama lagciniwe e-Windows. Emazulu latawungeniswa, sebentisa tinhlavu, tinombolo, tikhala, ema-hyphens nobe imibhalo lengaphansi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Loluhlelo lwekusebenta lwe Java server mods/plugins. Sebentisa i-add-on workflow ye-Bedrock; I-Java JAR angeke isebente ku-Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Kute lokucuketfwe kweseva lokwatfolwa. Imibhalo ye-launcher, emafayili e-client, tikhatsi tekusebenta, umhlaba, kanye netilungiselelo te-root server atingeniswa ngekuhamba kwemsebenti we-modpack.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Luhlobo lwekwatisa aluhambisani neluhlelo lwe-server lolukhetsiwe. Ema-Mods adzinga i-mod loader lefanako; Ema-plugin e-Bukkit/Paper adzinga sikhatsi sekusebenta.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Lona ngumculu welikhasimende le-CurseForge, hhayi liphakethe leseva leliphelele. Khipha i-ZIP yemsebentisi wembhali lefaka emamodeli nemiculu; Emafayela langatfolakali akalahlwa ngaphandle kwekukhuluma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Lifomu le Minecraft lalephakethe kanye nemlayeto/kuhlanganiswa kufanele kuhambisane nalomlayeto. Khetsa bese usebentisa leso sikhatsi sekusebenta kucala. Tintfo tekulayisha letingasekelwa atishintjwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Lokulandziwe nobe lokucondziswe kulenye indzawo akusiyo imitfombo yahulumende ye-HTTPS. Sebentisa i-ZIP yesiphakeli sendzawo lesisekelwa ngumbhali esikhundleni saloko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Lifayela lelilayishiwe belingavumelani nebukhulu balo nobe i-SHA-512. Kute lokwafakwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Linani le-Minecraft lelisetjentiswa yi-Synix alilungile nobe alivumelani. Hlola emachweba, umkhawulo webadlali, indlela yekudlala, kanye netintfo tekulawula ngaphambi kwekugcina.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: I-Synix ayikwati kulondvolota kungena kwe server lokuvusetelwe. Lomsebenti awuzange wemukelwe; emafayela ekubuyisa agcinwe lapho kudzingeka khona.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Luhlelo lwekulawula i-Synix lwe-Minecraft kumele luhlale lusendzaweni. Ungayikhiphi i-Internet kulendzawo yekulawula.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: I-port lekhetsiwe ingeyelinye liserver le-Synix. Khetsa i-port lehlukile ngaphambi kwekulondvolota.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Khetsa sento lesisekelwako kanye neligama lemdlali lelisebentako. Kuvinjelwa kwe-Java akusiyo imiyalo ye-Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: I-server ayizange icale. Hlola kulungela kanye neluhla lwemisebenti yelideshibhodi ngaphambi kwekuzama futsi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: I-metadata ayikhoni kufundvwa ngalokuphelele. Hlola lelifayela kanye netimfuneko tekuhambisana nembhali walo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Kunetincwadzi letingetulu kwayinye te-JAR letichaza le-ID. Hlola futsi ususe imibhalo lephindvwe kabili.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: Le-JAR itichaza ngekutsi isebenta kumakhasimende kuphela. Ungayibeki ku-server lekhetsiwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: I-metadata yale JAR ayihambisani ne-loader/software lekhetsiwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Lokudzingekako lokungabonakali kumetadata lehlolisisiwe: {0}. Hlola tintfo letidzingekile ngaphambi kwekufaka nobe ngabe yini.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Kuhlola ngesandla kutsembela {0}: kudzingeka {1}, kuhlolwe {2}. Lenandlela/lenhlobo ayicondzakali kahle.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: I-log ikhombisa kungalingani kwe Java/class-version. Sebentisa lihumusho le Java lelidzingwa yi-server lekhetsiwe kanye ne-mod loader.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: Lolucwebu lukhomba kutsi Java akakhoni kukhipha inkhumbulo leyenele. Hlola i-RAM letfolakalako, umkhawulo we-server, nekutsi ngabe lamanye emaseva ayasebentisa yini.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: Lolokulandzisa kukhuluma ngetidzingo tekutsembela. Hlola liphutsa lekucala le-loader, bese uhlola imodi lecondzile, kutsembela, lihumusho lemdlalo, kanye nekwakhiwa kwe-loader.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Lokwatiswa kukhombisa kutsi leligede selivele liyasetjentiswa. Hlola letinye tinchubo kanye nemichilo lehleliwe yale-server; ungawavuli emachweba e-firewall langakahlanganiswa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: I-log icela kwemukelwa kwe Minecraft EULA. Fundza bese uyemukela ngendlela levamile yekusebenta kwekucala uma uvuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Umbiko wemalanga ekucala ukhuluma ngekuhamba kancane kwematheksthi nobe sikhatsi sekulindza. Hlola CPU, kukhicitwa kwemhlaba, tinhlangano kanye nemamodeli. Lamanye ema-RAM angeke akucedze loku.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Liphutsa le mixin livame kufaka inhlanganisela ye mod/loader lengahambelani. Hlola imbangela yekucala embikweni wetingoti kanye nemibhalo ledzingekako.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World
data.value: I-log ibika emaphutsa ekufundvwa kwemininingwane yemhlaba. Vala i-server bese ugcina emafayela lakhona ngaphambi kwekusebentisa indlela yekulondvolota.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeRecovery
data.value: Lokufakwa lokudzala akunalo lirekhodi lesikhatsi sekusebenta. Sebentisa i-backup lephelele ye-server kutsi uyibuyise; I-Synix angeke ikhone kucagela umlayishi wayo wangaphambilini kanye nengucuko yayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeMismatch
data.value: Sikhatsi sekusebenta lesisetjentisiwe asihambisani nesidzingo seluhlelo lolukhetsiwe, lihumusho, i-loader nobe Java. Vula i-Minecraft Control Center bese usebentisa Apply Runtime ngaphambi kwekucala.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.InvalidValue
data.value: Linani le-{0} alikasebenti. Lungisa loku ngaphambi kwekulondvolota.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Empty
data.value: Kute tintfo letingaboniswa. Vuselela ngemuva kwekwengeta lokucuketfwe nobe kugucula kulungiselelwa kweseva.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilitySummary
data.value: Tintfo letengetiwe letitfolwe ku-{0} • Tintfo letitfolakele ku-{1} kufanele tihlolisiswe. Loku kuhlola akukashintji emafayela.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityAddOns
data.value: Kute ema-add-on latfolakala ku-active mods noma ku-plugins for this server setup.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityFindings
data.value: Kute tinkinga letatfolwa ngekuhlolwa kwemetadata lekhona. Loku akucinisekisi kutsi onkhe ema-mod nobe ema-plugin atawusebenta ngekubambisana.

data.name: AsaPackages.Help
data.value: Khetsa i-ASA Windows-server ZIP lelayishiwe nobe lifolda lelikhishwe. I-Synix itfola tinchazelo temamodeli ngekhatsi kwemaphakheji lahlangene, lahlanganisiwe, nobe lamanyenti bese ilungisa ema-ID abo e-CurseForge kutsi ahlolwe. Emafayela e-ZIP akakhophiwe nobe afakiwe. I-ASA ilanda bese ibhalisa luhlelo lwamanje lweseva yemnikati ngesikhatsi ucala iseva; Loku akukhombisi luhlobo lwe-ZIP.

data.name: AsaPackages.Choose
data.value: Khetsa i-ZIP nobe lifolda lotawulihlola. Kute kusetjentiswa kwemaseva nobe emafayela latawuguculwa kuze kube ngulapho sewubuka futsi ugcina luhlu lwema-ID etitfombe.

data.name: AsaPackages.Trust
data.value: I-metadata yephakeji ayetsembeki. Kuhlola akusiyo indlela yekuhlola i-malware, kuhlola kutsi iyahambisana yini nobe kucinisekisa kutsi ngumuphi umshicileli.

data.name: AsaPackages.Reading
data.value: Kufundvwa kwemetadata yephakeji. Kute imitsetfo yemodi lesebentako.

data.name: AsaPackages.Found
data.value: i-mods ye-{0} itfolakele; {1} matisi lomusha lotawengetwa. Ema-ID lakhona ayalandzelana. Hlola luhla loluphelele ngaphambi kwekulugcina.

data.name: AsaPackages.Timeout
data.value: Kuhlolwa kwemaphakheji kwakhanselwa nobe kutsatse sikhatsi lesidze kakhulu. Khetsa liphasela lelincane uphindze wetame futsi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Source
data.value: Khetsa i-ARK server mod ZIP nobe i-extracted mod folder. Letinye tinhlobo temarekhodi atisekelwa ngulomfundzi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Limit
data.value: Leliphephandzaba lidlula umkhawulo wemfundzi wemetadata. Khetsa lifolda lelincane nobe i-ZIP lenemagama langekho ngetulu kwa 100.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Lephakeji icuketse tindlela letingakaphephi, tixhumanisi, tindlela letimbili, emafayela laphikisanako, nobe emafolda lamanyenti. Kute lokwashintja.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Descriptor
data.value: Kute .uplugin mod descriptor leyatfolakala. Khetsa i-mod ZIP nobe lifolda layo lelikhishiwe; emarekhodi lahlanganisiwe kumele akhicitwe kucala.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Metadata
data.value: I-descriptor yemodi ayivumelekile, akusiyo i-JSON. Kute lokwashintja.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Game
data.value: I-descriptor ayikhombisi umklamo we-ARK: Survival Ascended CurseForge. I-Synix angeke iwulinganise lomdlalo nobe i-ID ye-mod.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Id
data.value: I-descriptor ayinayo i-ID ye-CurseForge yemklamo leyodvwa lesebentako (cf_ugcID). Sebentisa i-Manage Mod IDs nge-ID lesuka ekhasini lemlobi le-CurseForge.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.ServerBuild
data.value: I-mod ayinayo iphakheji ye-WindowsServer lemukelekile nobe ifayela lefanako ye .ucas/.utoc ayikho. Khetsa i-Windows-server loyitfolile, hhayi i-client build.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.DuplicateMod
data.value: Iphakethe licuketse tichazamagama letingetulu kwalunye te Mod ID lefanako. Khetsa lihumusho linye laleyo naleyo mod bese uyalihlola futsi.

data.name: AsePackages.Help
data.value: Khetsa i-ARK: Survival Evolved mod ZIP nobe lifolda lelicuketse i-descriptor ye .mod kanye nefolda yayo ye-mod lephekiwe. I-Synix ifundza i-ID ye-Workshop ku-descriptor, hhayi ligama le-ZIP. Emafayela awatsatselwa nobe afakwe: ngemuva kwekubuketa, i-Synix ivusetela i-ActiveMods kanye ne-ModIDS ye-ARK's automatic download route. Emabalave kanye nekuguculwa kwato tonkhe tintfo kungadzinga kusetjentiswa kwe-server ngalokwehlukile. Emaphakethe e-ASA CurseForge awavumelani.

data.name: AsePackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Lena akusiyo indlela yekuhambisa lephelele ye-ASE leyatiwako. Faka ekhatsi i-descriptor ye .mod kanye nefolda ye mod lefana ne-mod.info kanye nemagugu laphekiwe. I-ID lehlanganisiwe kumele ihambisane nanobe nguliphi ligama lefayela lenetinombolo. Tintfo letitfolakala ku-Raw Workshop .z ngaphandle kwelifayela lelilungisiwe .mod atisekelwa ngulomfundzi; Sebentisa i-Manage Mod IDs esikhundleni saloko.

data.name: ArkPackages.Error.WrongEdition
data.value: Leliphasela licuketse i-descriptor yalenye incwadzi ye-ARK. I-ASE Steam Workshop mods kanye ne-ASA CurseForge mods ayikashintjashintji. Khetsa iphakheji ye-server lekhetsiwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Help
data.value: Faka imfolda ye-mod nobe ye-plugin kanye netinhlobo temidvwebo lemikhulu leyemukelekako ngekusebentisa lemitfombolusito yalomdlalo nobe yekulayisha. Loku kusebenta kule-server kuphela. Khetsa indzawo lekhona kwentela kuyivuselela; kute emafayela lamasha laguculwako lapha.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Warning
data.value: Kungenisa emafayela akufaki i-loader nobe kubhalisa emamodeli laphetfwe ngumnikeli. Hlola imiyalo yekuhlela lomdlalo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Start
data.value: Sebentisa tindzawo tekungenisa kute ufake imodi noma i-plugin yaleli seva. Kungenisa emafayela akukhombisi kutsi lomdlalo ungawalayisha.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Help
data.value: Khetsa lifolda lelikulephakheji lelidzinga indzawo leseva lekhetsiwe. Emafolda langaphansi ayagcinwa. Ungasusa imiculu yekulanda ngekukhetsa lifolda lelisetulu. Kutawungeniswa kuphela emafayela labaliwe; emafayela lakhona atfola emakhophi lamasha. Loku akuguculi ema-mods langasebenti.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.WholePackage
data.value: Liphakethe leliphelele ? gcina luhlaka lwemafolda alo

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Summary
data.value: Emafayela {0} akhetsiwe; {1} Emafayela lakhona atawugcinwa ngaphambi kwekutsi asuswe. Kute lokungafakwa kuze kube sikhatsi sekucinisekiswa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InvalidLocations
data.value: Tindzawo tekungenisa letigciniwe atikasebenti nobe tihlobene nemdlalo we server lehlukile. Kute emafayela lashintjiwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InstallFolder
data.value: Faka le-server ngaphambi kwekumisa tindzawo tekungenisa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationLimit
data.value: Sikhonti singaba netindzawo tekungenisa letingafika ku 32.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationName
data.value: Faka ligama lendzawo lelingu 1–80 bese ukhetsa Mod nobe i-Plugin.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Extensions
data.value: Faka titfombe telifayela lelikhulu le-1–32, kufaka ekhatsi emachashazi alo, njenge .dll nobe .pak. Tinhlelo tekufaka kanye nemiyalo ayemukelwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Collision
data.value: Lephasela linekungcubutana kwelifayela/lifolda. Khetsa imiculu lephelele nalengagucuki.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.NoFiles
data.value: Lelifolda leliphakethe lelikhetsiwe alinawo emafayili lamakhulu alendzawo. Khetsa lelinye lifolda lelicuketse lokunye nobe ubuke luhlobo lwendzawo lolwemukelekile.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.PackageRoot
data.value: Khetsa lifolda lelisemtsetfweni lelikulephakethe. Tindlela letingaphandle kwaleliphakethe atemukeleki.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Done
data.value: Emafayela angenisiwe. Emakhophi alokubuyiselwe bekagcinelwa emafayela latawutsatselwa indzawo. Hlola le-loader yalomdlalo kanye netimfuneko tekusebenta ngaphambi kwekucala. Kute i-server leyasungulwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Rollback
data.value: Buyisela emuva lonkhe liphasela '{0}' (emafayela e-{1})? Loku kubuyisela emafayili lakhona ekucala bese kususa emafayela langetiwe. Kutsintsana nalo lonkhe liphasela, hhayi lifayela lelikhetsiwe kuphela.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Help
data.value: Khetsa i-ZIP, ifayela ye-mod lelayishiwe, nobe lifolda lelikhishwe. I-Synix ifundza liphasela le-{0} bese ikhombisa kutsi itawufakwa njani ngaphambi kwekugucula lokutsite.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Empty
data.value: Cala ngekukhetsa i-ZIP nobe lifolda lolilandzile. Akudzingeki kutsi ucale ngekuhlela tindzawo tekungenisa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.DestinationHelp
data.value: Khetsa lifolda lelikhona kule-server, ulandzele ticondziso tekufaka lomdlalo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Reading

data.name: ModSupport.ImportRules
data.value: I-Synix inemitsetfo yekungenisa kulomdlalo. Iphakheji kumele ivumelane nemlayetisi lofakiwe, luhlobo lweseva kanye nalokuncike kuyo.

data.name: ModSupport.ManualSetup
data.value: Kute imitsetfo yekuhlela leyetayelekile lekhona kulomdlalo. Fundza lendlela lengentasi ngaphambi kwekukhetsa indzawo; Emafayela angaphindze adzinge kusetjentiswa ngendlela letsite noma kumhlinzeki.

data.name: ModSupport.EvidenceNote
data.value: Lusito lolubhaliwe alusiyo indlela yekuhlola kuhambisana nekusebenta kwe-server. Ema-mods e-server, ema-mods e-client kanye nema-installer ekulayisha ayahluka. Kute lokulandziwe, lokufakiwe nobe lokucale ngaloluhlelo.

data.name: ModSupport.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Kute indlela yekusebenta ye-server lekungiyo lecinisekisiwe. Loku akusho kutsi lomdlalo angeke ulungiswe. Khetsa i-ZIP nobe lifolda lekulihlolisisa, bese usebentisa imiyalo yemsebentisi wemlobi kucinisekisa indzawo lokuyiwa kuyo kanye nekusebenta.

data.name: ModSupport.GuidedImport
data.value: Tindlela tekuhlela i-server tibhalwe phansi. Sebentisa i-Mod support & setup kute utfole ticondziso tekusebentisa, bese u-Import ZIP/folder kute uhlole liphasela lakho.

data.name: ModSupport.UnverifiedImport
data.value: Khetsa i-Import ZIP/folder kute uhlole liphasela. Lusekelo lweseva ludzinga kucinisekiswa; Lusekelo lwema-mods nekusungulwa kwawo kuchaza imincele.

data.name: ModSupport.InvalidCatalog
