data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingRecovery
data.value: Gcina i-server nemhlaba ngaphambi kwekusebentisa emamodeli lamasha. Lendlela lekhetsiwe itawuchaza kutsi yini lengentiwa.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LayoutRecognized
data.value: Luhlelo/indlela yekulayisha lemukelekile. Tinhlobo temidlalo, tintfo letitsembele kuyo kanye netidzingo tebasebentisi atikacinisekiswa ngalokuphelele lapha; hlola tidzingo tembhali.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualCompatibility
data.value: Kulungiswa kwendlela yekubhala ngekusebentisa tandla akuzange kucinisekiswe. Kufakwa kwelifayela lelifanako akusho kutsi le-mod isebenta nalomdlalo nobe lomlayishi.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LoaderMissing
data.value: Kungenisa kuvinjelwe: i-loader lehambisanako ayikho nobe liphasela alihambelani ne-loader lekhetsiwe. Hlola kulungiswa kwe-server kanye nekusekelwa kwe-Mod & setup.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderCompatibility
data.value: Kuphela ema-ID labaniketa tinsita. Ema-version ema-mod, lokuncike kuwo kanye nekuhambisana kwemapulatifomu akukahlolwa. Cinisekisa kutsi yonkhe intfo yemhlinzeki isekela leseva.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderDestination
data.value: I-Synix igcina luhla lwe-ID ye-{0}, hhayi emafayela e-ZIP. Umhlinzeki wemdlalo nguye lolawula indzawo yekulanda.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileChanges
data.value: emafayela {0} kuloluhlelo; {1} Emafayela lakhona atawugcinwa ngaphambi kwekutsi asuswe.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FilePreview
data.value: Khetsa lifayela ngesencele kute utfole lapho uya khona. Kute lokutakwentiwa kute kucinisekiswe luhlolo lolulandzelako.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderActivation
data.value: Gcina ema-ID lalayelwe, bese ucala iseva wena ngekwakho bese uhlola kulog yayo yekulanda/yekusungula. I-ZIP lekhetsiwe ayigcini i-version letsetfwe ngumdlali/umnikati.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualActivation
data.value: Kukopa emafayela akufaki i-loader nobe kubhalisa/kuvumela i-mod. Landzela ticondziso te-Mod support & setup kanye netincwadzi te-server, bese ucala iseva ngekwakho bese uhlola log yayo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioActivation
data.value: Kungenisa tintfo akuyiguculi indlela yekusebenta. Sebentisa i-Choose Scenario kute ukhetse lesimo bese uyasigcina ngaphambi kwekucala. Konga lokukhona akukaguculwa ngekwe-othomathikhi.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileActivation
data.value: Lolokucuketfwe/lenchubo lekhetsiwe ifundza lamafayela lafakiwe uma ucala i-server. Gcwalisa imibhalo yekusungula kanye netidzingo telikhasimende kucala, bese uhlola umlandvo wekucala. I-Synix ayicali i-server.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileRecovery
data.value: Yima i-server, ukhetse intfo loyitfolile bese usebentisa iRoll Back Import. Loku kubuyisela emafayela labuyiselwe bese kususa emafayela lamasha kuleyo import; Kuhlela lokulandzelako kungavimbela kubuyela emuva. Akusenti kutsi kube netingucuko emhlabeni. Yenta i-backup lephelele ngaphambi kwekucala.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderRecovery
data.value: Misa leseva bese uhlela luhla lwema-ID kususa lokwengetiwe nobe kubuyisela luhlelo lwayo lolwendlulile. Loku akukhiphi emafayela e-provider nobe kubuyisela imibhalo lemidzala ye-mod/idatha yemhlaba. Gcina luhlu loludzala lwema-ID kanye neluhlelo loluphelele lwe-server ngaphambi kwekucala.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioRecovery
data.value: Simo lesisebentako noma lokugciniwe lokukhona kungavimbela kususwa.

data.name: Backup.Retention.Warning

data.name: ServerStart.Maintenance.UpdateFailed
data.value: Kucaliswa kwalomsebenti kukhanselwe: lokucuketfwe lokudzingekako akukapheleli. I-server ihlala imile. Hlola liphutsa lekuvuselela ngaphambi kwekwetama futsi.

data.name: ServerActions.Operation.RequiresStopped
data.value: Misa leseva futsi ucinisekise kutsi tinchubo tayo tiphumile ngaphambi kwekuvuselela nobe kucinisekisa emafayela ayo.

data.name: Backup.Error.CustomFolderUnavailable
data.value: Ifolda yekusekela lekhetsiwe ayitfolakali. Phindza uyihlanganise nobe ukhetse lelinye lifolda lekugcina. I-Synix angeke isebentise indzawo leyehlukile.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.TooLarge

data.name: Backup.Restore.PreviousPending
data.value: Kulungiswa lokwendlulile kusadzinga kunakekelwa. Lokubuyiselwa akukake kucale. Imininingwane: {0}

data.name: Language.PreviewNotice
data.value: Kubuketa: kuhunyushwa kwetintfo letisetjentiswako. Letinye ticondziso kanye netindlela tekuhlola tihlala tingesiNgisi.

data.name: GameText.Introduction
data.value: I-Synix yemukela umbhalo wemave emhlaba. Tonkhe tinkambu letilandzelako tinesimo sato sekuba bufakazi; kusekelwa kwesihloko akukhombisi kusekelwa kwephasiwedi. Kungacinisekiswa akusho kungasekelwa futsi akufaki umtsetfo wesiNgisi kuphela. Lokucuketfwe akusiyo indlela yekuhlola lesebentako yato tonkhe tinhlobo temidlalo, emafonti e-client nobe tindlela tekufaka.

data.name: GameText.SafetyNote
data.value: Gcina emaphasiwedi ngendlela lefanele njengobe afakiwe: tinhlavu temagama letibukeka tifana tingaba nemakhodi lehlukene. Imikhawulo yekudlala lekhona kanye netintfo letihlukanisako letingavunyelwa tiyachubeka nekusebenta. Emathokheni ekucinisekisa, ema-ID, emagama emafolda nemagama ebadlali anemitsetfo lehlukile.

data.name: GameText.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Kusesha ku-inthanethi akuzange kutfole sisekelo semhlaba wonkhe kulomkhakha. Hlola imiculu lekhona yemdlalo bese uhlola balingisi ngaphambi kwekwetsembela kubo. Inkhundla lengasebenti ku Synix akusho kutsi ayikho kulomdlalo.

data.name: GameText.InvalidUnicode
data.value: {0} icuketse umlingisi we-Unicode longakapheleli. Kufaka kabusha; I-Synix angeke itsatse sikhundla seligama lekungena nobe tinhlavu temagama ngekuthula.

data.name: Content.007253C01F3D240BCA85
data.value: I-Euro Truck Simulator 2 kumele ikhiphe i-map yayo, i-DLC, kanye nemafayela e-mod kusuka kumdlalo lowetayelekile ngaphambi kwekutsi iseva lekhetsekile icale. Landzela tinyatselo tekusungula letibonisiwe; I-Synix itawungenisa emafayela lakhicitwe kule server.

data.name: Content.00DEEBB0AC0CF305D39F
data.value: Kukhona indlela yekuhlela ikhodi leseceleni kweseva, kufaka ekhatsi indlela yekuhlela i-stockpile yemcambi. Luhlelo lwepakethe, tintfo letitsembele kuyo kanye nekusebenta kwemhlaba kuncike kuloluhlobo lwemdlalo/kwe-mod; akukho lapho i-DLL ifike khona.

data.name: Content.027ABB3BADA8C0B33854
data.value: Khetsa imodi yemhlaba/yekuhlela i-server kunekukopa i-ZIP. Steam ne crossplay/mod.io kutfolakala kwehlukile. Ema-server plugins adzinga kusetjentiswa kahle kwe-server kanye nekwakhiwa kwe-plugin.

data.name: Content.02F77AA927B80C70293F
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Cala i-server kanye kute ukhicite 'PCServer-UDKGame.ini', bese uyayicisha.
2. Hlela lelifayili kwentela kulawula kugucugucuka kwemephu kanye nemitsetfo yekulimala kwelicembu.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://chivalrythegame.com/

data.name: Content.03C3E5851F1A6D5D93B8
data.value: i-Java ineliphasiwedi le-rcon; I-Bedrock ayinayo i-Java RCON yekugcina. Lusekelo lwekwakheka kwe UTF-8 alubeki indlela yekuphatfwa kwetinhlamvu kunobe ngumuphi umlayenti we RCON. Hlola i-server kanye ne-client ndzawonye.

data.name: Content.04306C6DCC8E032536F2
data.value: Gcina onkhe emaphakheji alokucuketfwe kanye ne-filelist.xml ndzawonye bese uvumela emaphakheji ngekwakheka kweseva. Umhlahlandlela loshicilelwe ukhombisa imininingwane letsite; khombisa indlela lekhona.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Sebentisa lencwajana kute wakhe i-server yakho yekucala. I-Synix iyisebentisa kule-PC, ngako-ke shiya i-PC ivulekile ngesikhatsi labanye bantfu badlala. Akudzingeki kutsi ubhale umyalo wekucala kwentela kusetjentiswa lokwetayelekile.
1. Vula i-Synix bese uvumela i-SteamCMD kutsi icedze kuhlola. 2. Khetsa i-Add Server, bese wakha iseva lensha. Nangabe emafayela e-server asevele akhona, khetsa Import Existing Server esikhundleni saloko. 3. Ku-General, faka ligama lelikhetsekile leseva bese ukhetsa umdlalo. Khetsa i-edition, i-game version, nobe i-loader nangabe letintfo tivela. 4. Gcina loku lokunconywako ngaphandle nangabe ufuna lokunye lokwehlukile. Bukisisa lamakhasi lacinisekisiwe ekuhlela bese usombulula lomlayeto lokumele ulungiswe longentasi. 5. Khetsa i-Save Server. Loku kwengeta umlayeto kudeshibhodi; loko akusho kutsi lomdlalo sewucedzile kufakwa. 6. Khetsa leyo ndzawo bese ukhetsa i-Start. Vumela kulayisha nekulungiselela kucala kwekucala kutsi kuphele, kulandzela nobe ngabe nguyiphi imilayeto lekhonjiswa yi-Synix. 7. Gcwalisa nobe ngabe nguyiphi indlela yekusebenta lefakwe ngumdlalo, njengekwenta sivumelwano, kungena ngemvume ku-akhawunti, nobe kwakha sikhatsi sekusebenta kusiphatsimandla se-in-game server. 8. Hlanganisa kule-PC nobe kulenye intfo kunethiwekhi yakho yasekhaya. Uma sekusebenta, yenta i-backup ngaphambi kwekwengeta noma kwenta tingucuko letinkhulu.
NANGABE UKABAMBIWA Vula i-Readiness ku-server lekhetsiwe bese ufundza i-Activity & Diagnostics. Landzela liphutsa lelitsite kunekutsi ucindzetele ku-Start. I-Minecraft nobe i-Satisfactory, sigaba seTicondziso teMidlalo sichaza tinyatselo letengetiwe.
Kubamba bantfu labangephandle kwenethiwekhi yakho kusinyatselo lesihlukile sekwakha inethiwekhi. Kwekucala cinisekisa kutsi i-server isebenta endzaweni yakini.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Konkhe lokungena kudeshibhodi kudzinga ligama lalo kanye nelifolda lekufaka. I-Synix igucula leligama leseva libe yi-Windows-kuphephile kwatiwa ngekwesekelwa kwemafolda kanye nekusungulwa. Loku kuvikela ema-instance lahlukene kutsi angahlanganyeli ngalokungakahlosi emafayili; akusiyo i-virtual machine nobe umncele wekuphepha.
TINDAWO LETIKHETFULWE • I-C:\Synix ‡ indzawo yekusebenta yemniningwane we-Synix. â€¢ C:\Synix\SteamCMD â€" i-downloader yemidlalo lehlanganisiwe. • C:\Synix\Games\<umdlalo>\<umsebentisi> ‡ luhlelo lolwetayelekile lwemsebentisi. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ‡ imphandze lengiyo. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ? imiculu yekusebentisa kanye nemibiko yetingoti.
Emafayela e-MSI avame kuba ngaphansi kwa %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Letinye tintfo letitsandvwako kanye nemagugu lavikelwe yi-Windows aphindze abe ngeyakho i-akhawunti ye-Windows.
TINDAWO LETENTAKALO Sebentisa i-Install & Launch nawukhetsa lifolda leseva. Kute ufake loluhlelo lolusha, khetsa lifolda lelingenalutfo longakhona kubhala kulo bese utfola sikhala lesenele semdlalo netingucuko. Ungabeki emaphrofayili lamabili esicondzisweni lesifanako.
I-Open Server Folder ikhombisa indzawo ye server lekhetsiwe. Vula i-Folder ye-Backup kukhombisa indzawo yayo ye-backup; ungacabangi nobe nguyiphi indlela ngekusebentisa ligama layo.
EMASAVA ANGAKHONA KANYE Umdlalo ungagcina umhlaba ku AppData, Documents, kulenye idrayivu, noma eluhlelweni lwawo lwekusebentisa. Ciniseka kutsi lomdlalo usendzaweni lengiyo ngaphambi kwekuwubuyisela emuva noma kuwuhambisa.
Kubita kabusha noma kuhambisa emafolda ku-File Explorer akucinisekisi kutsi yonkhe indlela legciniwe itawuguculwa. Sebentisa i-Synix's supported import/transfer workflow bese ubuyeketa tindlela ngaphambi kwekucala lokulandzelako. Tintfo letehlukene nato tidzinga emachweba langashayisani.

data.name: Content.04B9D3E7C29AEA747A53
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Yenta i-server ibe yinye kute ikhicite 'UDKDedServerSettings.ini', bese uyayicima.
2. Hlela i-configuration file kute uhlele emaphasiwedi akho e-server kanye netindlela tekudlala.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://subsistence.fandom.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers

data.name: Content.05A8CF055143908911B7
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Kwetfula i-server kanye kwentela kwakha 'Engine.ini', bese uyayivala.
2. Gucula lelifayela kute ufake emagama e-server, ema-ID e-workshop kanye netindlela temdlalo.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://harshdoorstop.com/

data.name: Content.07DB28C48D22292BF1AB
data.value: Satisfactory isebentisa i-in-game Server Manager yayo noma i-HTTPS API kucela i-server, kubeka iphasiwedi yemlawuli, kwakha luhlelo, nekulayisha lokugciniwe. I-Synix iphatsa i-port yekucala kanye ne MaxPlayers lesekelwa ku-Game.ini, kepha iseva kumele isetjentiswe ngumsebentisi ngemuva kwekucala kwayo.

data.name: Content.08752F01163B69069283
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Veta i-server kanye ekucaleni kwayo, uyivale bese ulungisa tikhungo te-server yakho!
2. Gucula i-GameUserSettings.ini kute uchaze imicondvo yakho kanye netakhiwo temhlaba.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://starrupture.wiki.gg/wiki/Server_Hosting

data.name: Content.092466FE1253A8AFC4DE
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Cala i-server kanye kute wakhe 'gameserver.conf', bese uyayicisha.
2. Hlela i-configuration properties file kute ulungise imikhawulo yeserver kanye netintfo tekudlala.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://wurmpedia.com/index.php/Dedicated_server

data.name: Content.0A3D6FD5368E0F1C5813
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Yenta i-server ibe yinye kute wakhe 'Engine.ini', bese uyayicisha.
2. Kugucula tindlela tekuhlela kwentela kusungula imitsetfo yemdlalo kanye nekubalwa kwebadlali.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://readyornot.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_Server

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers isebentisa i-Dedicated Server Manager yayo, Synix kumele ihlale ibonakala. Nawuyivula kwekucala, khetsa Local/Console, khetsa Continue to server configuration, faka i-server kanye netilungiselelo temhlaba, bese ukhetsa Save & start. Sebentisa imenenja kwentela timo letisetulu, umhlaba, ema-mods, baphatsi, kanye nekhonsoli yayo. I-Synix igcina lesimo ngaphansi kwefolda ye-Instance leseva. Imodi yekucala Local/Console ayidzingi emalungelo ebasebenti; Kwenta umsebenti we Windows kuyasebenta. Letimfuneko letisemtsetfweni nguleti .NET Framework 4.8 nobe letinsha, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 na 2017, lokungenani 6 GB yesistimu RAM, kanye ne UDP port 27016 levumelekile nge Windows Firewall futsi idluliselwe ku-router yebadlali be-Internet. Umhlahlandlela losemtsetfweni: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Le-watchdog ibuka tinchubo telusito letatiwako futsi ingacala kuvuselelwa ngemuva kwekuphuma lokungakalindzeleki nobe inkinga lekhonjisiwe.
KUSEBENTA NGALOKUVAMILE Sebentisa i-Synix's Stop and Restart controls kwentela tingucuko letihlosiwe. I-Synix ihlanganisa letinyatselo nenja lelawulako kute kucinywa kwekusebenta kwemishini kungabhekwa njengekushayisana kwemishini.
Kuvala lifasitelo lemdlalo, kuwucisha ku-Task Manager, nobe kuwumisa kulenye i-manager kungabonakala kungakalindzeleki futsi kuvuse kubuyela esimeni.
TINKHATSI LETIPHINYISWAKO Vimbela i-server ngekusebentisa i-Synix, bese uhlola luhlelo lwekugcina lwemdlalo. Lungisa inkinga yesikhatsi sekusebenta, yekuhlela, ye-port, yememori, nobe ye-mod ngaphambi kwekuyicala kabusha. Kulungiswa angeke kulungise imodi lengasebenti kahle nobe luhlelo lwemdlalo lolungakapheli.
Kwehluleka kwenchubo kanye nemibuto lengatfolakali kuletinye tinkinga letehlukene. Sikhatsi sekuvuselela incike emdlalweni kanye nasesimeni sanyalo, ngako-ke ungahlahleli yonkhe inkinga ngekusebentisa sikhatsi lesitsite.
IMIBHALELO I-Synix ilandzelela ema-launcher lasekelwa kanye netinchubo temntfwana letiseveni. Imishini lecondziswa ngaphandle nobe tinsita tekusebenta tingaphila sikhatsi lesidze kunesiphatsimandla futsi tidzinga kulawulwa lokwentiwa ngumdlalo.
Loluhlelo lwe-watchdog alusiyo indlela yekucinisekisa ema-backups nobe kubuka i-server lesandza kuguculwa ngesikhatsi sekucala kwayo.

2. Kugucula 'Game.ini' kusetjentiswe imitsetfo yelihhovisi leligatja lendzala kanye nemaphasiwedi ebasebenti.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Sebentisa imijikeleto yemphilo ye-Synix kwentela kusebenta kwe server ngalokwetayelekile. Loku kwenta umgadzi akhone kwehlukanisa emkhatsini wekumiswa ngemabomu kanye nekushayisana kwemoto.
Kucala Khetsa lokungena bese ukhetsa kucala kanye. I-Synix ihlola tidzingo letisetjentiswako, tindlela, emachweba, kanye nekulungiswa kwekucala lokukhetsiwe, ilungisa emafayela langekho lasekelwako, bese ivula iseva. Linda imiphumela ngaphambi kwekutsi uphindze wetame.
KUMELA Khetsa ku-Stop bese uvumela sikhatsi semdlalo kutsi sigcine futsi sivale. I-Synix isebentisa indlela yekucedza ngekushesha lapho khona ikhona, bese kutsi uma kudzingeka kusetjentiswe indlela yekucedzela inchubo ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi. Kucedza ngekucindzetelwa kungabangela kulahleka kwetinhlelo letingagciniwe.
Kucala kabusha Khetsa ku-Restart kwentela kumisa lelicembu lalenchubo lekhona bese ucala intfo lensha. Ungacali kwenta lenye ikhophi ngesandla ngalesikhatsi loku kwenteka.
NAKUNGAKHONA KUSEBENTIWE KUNYENTAYETFO Lomunye umsebentisi angahle abe ngumnikati wale-server, lokungenelela kungahle kube sesimeni sekwendlula, nobe lomdlalo ungasebentisa kusetjentiswa kwangaphandle. Fundza umlayeto wekusebenta kanye nemakhono emaphrofayli.
Gwema kubulala i-server ku-Task Manager nobe kuyimisa kusuka kutintfo letingahlobani tekulondvolota. Loko kungabonakala njengekuphuma ngalokungakalindzeleki futsi kubangele kutsi umuntfu aphindze avuke.
Imidlalo lephetfwe ngemishini lengemaciniso nobe tinsita tangaphandle tekwetfulwa idzinga kuhlolwa kwekuphila kwayo. Kuvalwa kwembhobho wekusakata akukhombisi kutsi letinsita setiphelile.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
I-Satisfactory idzinga kulungiswa kwekucala ku-in-game Server Manager yayo. I-Synix ingafaka iphindze icalise i-server lekhetsiwe, kepha ayitsatsi indzawo yekufuna i-server nobe kwakha luhlelo lwayo.
KULUNGISELWA KWEMIDLALO KUYAPHELA 1. Yakha i-Satisfactory bese uyicala ku-Synix. 2. Lindza i-dedicated server icedzele kulayisha. 3. Vula i-Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager bese ufaka nobe ukhetsa iseva. 4. Faka sicelo, faka ligama lekuvula lemcondzisi, bese ungena njengemcondzisi. 5. Yakha nobe ulayishe luhlelo lofuna kulusebentisa.
I-Synix icondzisa kusetjentiswa/kulungiswa kwelizinga, kufaka ekhatsi i-port yekusebentisa kanye nema-MaxPlayers. Emafayela lafanele atfolakala ngaphansi kwe FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
I-CONNECT SYNIX 1. Gcina i-server isebenta nge--NewConsole. Hlola imibhalo lengenisiwe nobe lemidzala; uma ufaka leligama, cala kabusha nge Synix. 2. Sebentisa imvumo lefanako ye-Windows ku-Synix naku-server. 3. Khetsa leseva bese uvula i-Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Khetsa ku-Connect automatically kanye bese ulindza.
I-Synix itfumela i-server.GenerateAPIToken, ifundze imphumelelo lephelele, icinisekise i-API yendzawo, bese igcina i-token lebhaliwe ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Windows. Le-token iniketa umlawuli kufinyelela, hhayi kugadza kuphela.
Imibiko yemphumelelo I-token icinisekisiwe futsi igcinwe ngekuphepha bese kuvulwa i-overview. Akudzingeki kutsi ukopishe umugca we-console nobe unamatsisele i-token ngesandla.
Uma umzamo wehluleka, i-Synix igcina nobe ngukuphi kuchumana lokugcinwe ngaphambilini futsi ayitami kuphindze ikhiphe lomyalo. Fundza imiphumela lecondzile ngaphambi kwekutsi uphindze wetame.
Loku kuchumanisa kuseva lekhetsiwe kule-PC; ayidzingi umtsetfo lomusha we-router ye-Synix. Kucala lokujwayelekile, kumisa, nekucala kabusha kusasebenta ngaphandle kwe API.

data.name: Content.1734B5184A8732EBE5C7
data.value:
Khetsa umlayeto we-dashboard bese uvula i-Server Options. Kuniketwa kuphela emathuluzi lasekelwa ngulephrofayili nesimo sayo sanyalo.
EMAFILE NEKULONDZISWA KWAWO • Vula i-Server Folder kanye ne-Open Backup Folder kuvula tindzawo letisebentako. • Umhleli wekuhlela uvula emafayela ekuhlela emdlalo lasekelwako. • I-Update Server ilandze luhlelo lolusekelako lwekutfutfukiswa kwemdlalo. • Kucinisekisa kutsi i-Game Files ihlola nobe ilungisa emafayela lalawulwa ngulomfaki. • Backup ne Restore kulondvolota nobe kubuyisela luhlelo lolukhetsiwe. • I-Create Batch File itfumela i-launch script nangabe iphrofayili iyasekela. • Kususa kususa intfo letsite futsi kuniketa kuphela indlela yekususa lifayela leboniswe ekucinisekiseni kwayo.
TINHLANGANO NEMITFUYELO YEMIDLALO I-Connection Information ikhombisa emakheli, emachweba kanye netento tekukopa. Luhlolo lwekuchumana, iMod & Plugin Manager, emathuluzi e-Minecraft, kanye ne-Satisfactory Control Center tivela lapho tisekelwa khona.
HLOLA i-server lesebentako Chofoza kabili emgceni wayo kute utfole umniningwano nge server. I-Live Process Details ikhombisa i-launcher lecinisekisiwe, i-console hosts, kanye netinchubo tebasebenti baleyoncenye. Umdlalo lonetinchubo letinyenti ungaba neti-ID tetinchubo letingetulu kwalunye.
Sebentisa i-Resource Monitor kuhlola i-CPU yalesiseva nemlandvo wememori. Lokufundvwa kwehlukile kulokucuketfwe yi-dashboard.
Kuvala imininingwane nobe luhlelo lwekubuka tintfo akuwuphelisi lomdlalo. Sebentisa i-Dashboard's Stop action nangabe leyo yinhloso yakho.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Khetsa luhlelo lwe Minecraft ngaphambi kwekukhetsa imodi nobe indlela yekusebenta. i-Java ne-Bedrock tinhlobo letehlukene temaseva; I-Bedrock akusiyo i-Java yekulayisha.
Kulungisa i-Server 1. Yakha i-Minecraft bese ukhetsa Java nobe Bedrock. 2. Kwentela i-Java, khetsa i-Minecraft version, loader, kanye ne compatible loader version leniketwa ngulabakhetsi. 3. Hlola umhlaba, imodi yemdlalo wendzabuko, umkhawulo wemdlali, inkhumbulo, emachweba kanye netindzawo tekuphepha. 4. Gcina bese ucala nge Synix. 5. Fundza nobe ngusiphi sivumelwano ngaphambi kwekutsi usemukele. 6. Linda umhlaba kutsi ucedzele kulayisha, bese ujoyina ngekuhlanganisa luhlelo lweklayenti kanye nengucuko. 7. Yenta i-backup yemhlaba losebentako ngaphambi kwekwengeta ema-mods.
I-Java ne-BEDROCK Tincumo te Java tifaka ekhatsi iVanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, kanye ne Purpur lapho kwakheka kutfolakala khona. Sebentisa ema-version kanye ne-build selectors; I-Paper ne-Purpur tisebentisa ema-plugins, ibe i-Fabric, i-Forge, ne-NeoForge tisebentisa ema-mods lafanako. I-Synix itfola i-runtime lekhetsiwe kumniketi wayo losemtsetfweni.
I-Bedrock isebentisa liphasela lelisemtsetfweni le-Bedrock Dedicated Server futsi ayisebentisi i-Java.
HAMBALANA NEBANTFU LABAHLATSEKILE Khetsa i-loader ledzingwa ngema-mods akho. Hlanganisa i-Minecraft version, loader, dependencies, kanye netidzingo telikhasimende.
I-Fabric, i-Forge, i-NeoForge, kanye nemaphakheji e-plugin-server ayashintshaniswa. Kwakha imfolda yema-mods nobe ema-plugins akufaki i-loader ledzingekako nobe luhlaka lweseva. I-Browse Catalog akusiyo i-automatic modpack nobe i-dependence installation.
KULUNGISELWA kwato I-Configure icondzisa i-server.properties kanye netilungiselelo letitsite teluhlelo. I-Java iphindze inikete imodi ye-Spectator. Emagugu ebuchwephesha nemiyalo igcina indlela i-Minecraft leyilindzele.
Ku-Server Options, vula i-Minecraft Control Center. Likhasi layo le-Settings lineluhla lwemafayela ekuhlela e-server. Kuhlela i-File kuniketa kuhlela umbhalo; I-Structured Editor iniketa i-format-aware editor lekhona. Kokubili kugcina tingucuko ngalesikhatsi i-server imisiwe. Tintfo letatiwako te server.properties letifana netindzawo tekungena, umkhawulo wemdlali, umhlaba, inhlanyelo, imodi, kanye nekulungiselelwa kwe-command-channel nako kuvuselela lokungena lokugciniwe kwe Synix. Ligama lelikhangisiwe/i-MOTD yehlukile kuleligama lendzawo. Imiculu lengatfolakali yema-mod ihlala kumafayili ayo.
I-Synix iphindze ifundze letitintfo ngaphambi kwekuhlela noma kucala kwalokucuketfwe, nangesikhatsi i-Refresh isetjentiswa ngesikhatsi imisiwe. Uma luhlelo lwangaphandle lungasebenti nobe luphikisana nalokunye kungena, lungisa lenkinga lechaziwe esikhundleni sekuvuselela i-server. Umhleli uyala kubhala ngetulu kwelifayela leguculwe ngemuva kwekuvulwa kwalo; vula kabusha kute ulayishe lokucuketfwe lokusha.
Kushintja Sikhatsi Sekusebenta Se-Server Gcina i-backup lephelele ngaphambi kwekugucula ema-version nobe ema-loaders. Khetsa sikhatsi lesisha sekusebenta ku-Setup, ulondvolote lokungena lokubuyeketiwe, bese ukhetsa Apply Runtime in Minecraft Control Center. I-Synix ilungisa sikhatsi sekusebenta lesisemtsetfweni ngekwehlukana, igcina i-server.properties kanye nemafolda emhlaba, iphindze ibhale emafayela esikhatsi sekusebenta lashiyiwe. Akusiko kutsi i-server icale kusebenta. Kucala kuyavalwa uma sikhatsi sekusebenta lesibhaliwe kanye nephrofayili lekhetsiwe kungavumelani.
Kubuyela emuva kwelifayela akubuyisi emuva tingucuko letentiwe ngemuva kwekucala kweseva. Ungalokotsi ucabange kutsi umhlaba lovulekile nge Minecraft lensha nobe ema-mods lehlukene angafakwa ngekuphepha ngesikhatsi sekusebenta lesidzala; buyisela le-backup legcwele lefanako esikhundleni saloko.
Yima ngaphambi kwekugucula emafayela ladzinga kucalwa kabusha. Ungashintji live lelikhona libe lithempulethi lensha njengendlela yekulungisa.
NANGABE BADLALI BANGAKWAZI KUHAMBATSA Hlola luhlelo, umdlalo/umlayetisi wetincwadzi, ema-mods ladzingekako, kanye ne-port/protocol yaloluhlelo lolukhetsiwe. Uma ufuna kuphuma ngekushesha, hlola i-log yemdlalo kutsi awukho yini umehluko, sikhatsi sekusebenta, inkumbulo, nobe emaphutsa ekutsembela.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Vula i-Satisfactory Control Center ngemuva kwekuhlanganisa i-API yendzawo. Khetsa i-tab yekusebenta lokufunako.
KUCAPHELA LIKHASI Khetsa i-Refresh kute ufundze ligama leseshini, linani lebadlali labahlanganisiwe/umkhawulo, simo semdlalo, lizinga le-tick lelisemkhatsini, sikhatsi sekudlala, nelizinga letetheknoloji.
Umdlali we-dashboard ubala kuvuselela ngekwe-othomathikhi uma kuchumana kusesimeni lesikahle; liThebula le-Overview livuselelwa ngekucelwa. Le-API iniketa tinombolo, hhayi luhlu lwebadlali. Luhlelo lolumisiwe nobe i-server leme kulolunye luhlelo akusilo luhlelo lolumisiwe.
TINHLATSELO TASE-Server Khetsa Kuvuselela, ulungise emagugu lasekelako, bese usebentisa tingucuko. Phindza uhlole emagugu lasemkhatsini ngemuva kwekuvuselela. Letinye tindlela tidzinga kucalwa kabusha; kusetjentiswa kwetingucuko akucali lomdlalo ngalokuphelele.
Emakhodi ekubeka kanye nemagugu lamukelekile ahlala akhona ngelulwimi lwebuchwephesha.
IMIDLALO LELONDZISIWE • Londvolota nyalo: Faka ligama nobe usebentise ligama lelinemhlaka Synix. Kusebentisa leligama kabusha kungenta kutsi kubhalwe ngetulu kwalelogama lesevele likhona. • Umtfwalo ukhetsiwe: Bukisisa lesicinisekiso. i-Synix igcina inchubekelembili lekhona kucala uma inchubo isebenta; Kulayisha kungasusa badlali. â€¢ Faka lifayela leligciniwe: Yengeta lelifayela lelikhetsiwe futsi ingase itsatse indzawo yelifayela leligciniwe lelinegama lelifanako. Ayitfwali ngalokuphelele. • Download selected: Kugcina ikhophi kulendlela loyikhetsile.
Gcina i-backup ngaphambi kwekufaka nobe kufaka letinye tintfo letibalulekile. Kuguculwa kwekugcina kunemkhawulo wekuphepha we 512 ne MB. I-API ingase ingatfolakali kwesikhashana ngalesikhatsi kulayishwa luhlelo.
I-ADVANCED CONSOLE Tfumela munye umyalo wemdlalo losekelwa ngesikhatsi bese ufundza sicinisekiso. Ema-scripts, imiyalo ye-token/password, netingucuko tekungena lokungakaphephi tivaliwe lapha.
Imiyalo yekumisa leyemukelekako ihanjiswa ngekusebentisa indlela yekumisa ye-Synix. I-command output ihlala kulewindi kunekutsi ifakwe ku-dashboard nobe kuma-log ema-text e-Synix; lomdlalo ungahle utibhalele wona emalogi awo.

data.name: Content.29E9D2F428F5E2BA4705
data.value: Umtfutfukisi ubhala imiculu ye-plugin ngayinye yema-plugin e-Java-edition server. Luhlelo lwamanje kanye naloludzala lusebentisa ema-API lehlukene; hlola luhlelo loluhleliwe kanye nefomethi ye-plugin ngaphambi kwekusebentisa indzawo.

data.name: Content.2B0EFE8DBC3E9BEC09E3
data.value:
IMIDLALO YEBANTFU LABANINGI INGAFUNDZEKA:
I-Synix ifaka i-dedicated-server package kepha angeke ikhone kulayisha, kukopa nobe kusakata emafayela lanelayisensi kusuka kumdlalo lowetayelekile. Uma i-server ikhomba kutsi i-multiplayer content ilahlekile noma yehluleka ngesikhatsi ifaka nobe igucula emabalave, faka i-Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer nge-Steam usebentisa i-akhawunti lengumnikati wayo. Kopa i-mpsrc ye-multiplayer kulokufakwa kwalomdlalo kule-folder leseva, bese ucinisekisa kutsi i-mapcycle.txt ne-maplist.txt icuketse emabalave lofuna kuwagijima.
Lesinyatselo kumele sigcwaliswe ngumsebentisi lofaka i-server. Tinhlobo temidlalo nguleti: 0 Deathmatch, 1 Team Deathmatch, 2 Crusade, 3 Capture the Flag, kanye ne 4 Colosseum.

data.name: Content.2B58E9F9AC7FE77A9E6C
data.value: Kudzinga luhlelo lwe Metamod:Source kanye ne SourceMod loluhambisana naloluhlobo lweseva. Ema-plugins lahlanganisiwe .smx aya ku-tf/addons/sourcemod/plugins; Kuhumusha lokuhambisanako, i-gamedata kanye nekwandzisa kugcina emafolda abo labhaliwe.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Kufundza imiphumela ye-Connect ngekwakho ngaphambi kwekuzama futsi. Umyalo lovela ku-console yemdlalo awufakazeli kutsi kutsatfwa, kucinisekiswa kanye nekulondvolotwa kwemathokheni sekuphumelele.
HLOLA KUNGAKHONA LOKWENGEKE KWAKHONA • I-console ayitfolakali: Cinisekisa i--NewConsole, i-server leyakhetsiwe, kanye nemazinga emvumo lafanako e-Windows. • Umyalo longakapheleli emlayetweni: Susa ngekwakho. I-Synix angeke iyibhale ngetulu. • Umyalo uyasebenta kepha kute luphawu lolutsatselwako: Vumela kucalwa kwemdlalo kutsi kuphele, hlola imiculu yekubhala yemidlalo, bese uvumela umkhicito lomusha kutsi ufike. • Tintfo letihlungiwe tiyaphazamisa: Khipha tintfo letihlungiwe letifaka ekhatsi/letivimbelako bese uvumela i-console kutsi iphendvule. • Litiko le-API lingelenye inchubo: Lungisa litiko lemdlalo lelihleliwe leseva lekhetsiwe. Ungatfumeleli umlayeto walo kumuntfu longamtsandzi. â€¢ Tikhombandlela letilahliwe nobe letilondvolotiwe angeke tikhone kuvalwa: Gcwalisa luhlelo lolusemtsetfweni lwemdlalo, bese uphindze uhlanganisa. â€¢ API ayitfolakali: Linda kucalisa nobe ulondvolote kulayisha bese uhlola luhlelo lwemdlalo.
Imphendvulo lensha ingafaka ekhatsi linani lelingilo lemphendvulo lendzala. Kubamba kusebentisa lokukhokhelwako lokwentiwe ngemuva kwemyalo, hhayi intfo lendzala lengakahlelwa.
Vikela nobe Susa Kufinyelela I-Satisfactory iprinta emathokheni e-administrator ku-console yayo kanye nemarekhodi. Yenta kube yintfo leyimfihlo futsi ususe imigca yetimphawu etitfombeni nasemibikweni.
I-Synix icinisekisa kutsi i-endpoint yendzawo ngeye-server lekhetsiwe bese ibeka sitifiketi sayo. Ungakuvimbeli kuhlolwa kwesitifiketi kute ulungise inkinga.
Kususa lithokheni leligciniwe kususa kuchumana lokugciniwe kwe-Synix; akalisusi lelikhodi kusetjentiswa i-server.
Kususa emathokheni lasebentako, sebentisa i-server.InvalidateAPITokens ku-console ye-server ye-Satisfactory nobe i-console ye-Server Manager. Loku kuphindze kutsintse letinye tindlela tekuhlanganisa letisebentisa lamathokheni.
Kwelinye i-akhawunti ye-Windows nobe luhlelo lolunyusiwe, hlanganisa futsi uma loluxhumano lolugcinwe lungeke lusetjentiswe.

data.name: Content.2E2BBD89AFEC2FD2B678
data.value:
Fundza umsebenti wekugcina we-server lekhetsiwe kanye nelog yemdlalo. Funa sehluleki sekucala kunekutsi ufune umlayeto wekugcina wekucedza.
KUSHIYELELA KUCALA KUNYE NEKUPHELA ESIKHATSINI LESIKHULU 1. Cinisekisa lifolda lekufaka lelikhetsiwe, i-executable, i-game edition kanye ne-loader. 2. Hlola emafayela ladzingekako, sikhala se-RAM/disk lesikhanyako, kanye nemikhumbi lekhona. 3. Gcwalisa nobe ngabe ngusiphi sivumelwano, kungena ku-akhawunti, tidzingo temathokheni, nobe kusetjentiswa kwemdlalo. 4. Kwentela ema-mods, catsanisa umdlalo, loader, dependencies, kanye netidzingo teliklayenti. 5. Yima ku Synix ngaphambi kwekugucula emafayela, bese uhlola kucala.
I-launcher lephilako ingahlala ngemuva kwekwehluleka kweseva yangempela. I-server lephilile ingaphindze ilindzele kulayishwa kwemhlaba nobe ibe nemibuto lengatfolakali/API. Hlola leto tifundza ngekwehlukana.
KUMISA KANYE NEKUCHUMA KUTSATSA SIKHATSI Imidlalo idzinga sikhatsi sekugcina nekucedzela tinchubo tetisebenti. Linda imiphumela ye-Synix bese ufundza umlayeto wayo wekuvala. Kubuyela emuva ngekuphocelelwa kungenta kutsi ulahlekelwe nguloko lokwentekile.
Ungabulali tinchubo ngesikhatsi sinye, ungacali lenye ikhophi, nobe usebentise lesinye siphatsimandla kulokufakwa lokufanako.
SITSETFULWA KUNYE LOKUSEBENTIWE LOKUNGAKAKHO Hlola likhono lephrofayili nesimo sayo sanyalo. Letinye tindlela tivaliwe ngoba umdlalo unato nobe kute indlela yekulawula lesekelako lekhona. I-N/A yedatha yemdlali akusiyo intfo lecondzile yekwehluleka kweseva.
Nangabe lenkinga ichubeka, bhala phansi lesento, liphutsa lelicondzile, kanye nesicashunwa lesifishane ngaphambi kwekutsi wente letinye tingucuko letingakabaluleki.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
Faka nobe uvuselele i-MODPACK ye-Server 1. Yenta li-backup leliphelele le-server bese uyayimisa. Sebentisa i-Synix ngemalungelo e-Windows lavamile. 2. Faka bese usebentisa luhlelo lolucondzile lwe Minecraft, umlayishi kanye nekwakhiwa kwemlayishi kwekucala. 3. Ku Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, khetsa Import Server Pack. Khetsa i-Modrinth .mrpack nobe i-server ZIP legcwele icuketse ema-mods/ema-plugins kanye nemafayela ekwakheka. 4. Ema-optional server mods ayashiywa ngaphandle nangabe i-Include optional server mods ikhetsiwe. Imibhalo ye-Modrinth ye-client kuphela kanye nemibhalo ye-client overrides ayingeniswa. 5. Hlola imiphumela yekuhlola, kuhlola imethadatha, lokucuketfwe lokunganakwa, kanye nawo onkhe emafayela latawungetwa, afakwe kulenye indzawo nobe asuswe. Cinisekisa kuphela nangabe lomtfombo netingucuko tifanelekile. 6. Cala ngesandla ngemuva kwekufakwa, fundza i-console, bese uhlola kuchumana kweliklayenti lokuhambisanako.
Lomngenisi akalisebentisi liphakethe lelisetjentiselwa kusungula tinhlelo tekusungula, kungena esikhundleni semhlaba nobe kubhala ngetulu kwe-root server.properties. Tsatsa i-server pack lephelele yemcashi uma iklayenti le-CurseForge licuketse imenyu yekutsatsa kuphela. Kulandvwa kwemiculu yangasese, ema-host langasekelwa nobe ema-loaders langasekelwa adzinga emafayela e-server lasekelwa ngumbhali; I-Synix ayigubhi imitsetfo yemnikati.
Kukhishwa kwe Modrinth kuhloliwe. I-metadata ye-JAR lesekelwayo iyahlolwa kwentela i-loader, i-client-only content, ema-ID laphindvwe kabili, kanye nekutsembela lokuchaziwe ngaphandle kwekusebentisa i-JAR. I-metadata lengatiwa kanye netindzawo letiyinkimbinkimbi temibhalo tidzinga kubuyeketwa. Kuhlolwa lokuhlantekile nobe kungabi khona kwetinkinga akucinisekisi kutsi i-mod iphephile nobe iyahambisana. Tintfo letidzingekako letingasekho atilayishelwa ngaphandle kwekukhuluma.
Kungenisa kabusha iphakethe lelinemagama lafanako kungasusa ema-JAR lakhiwe ngaphambilini langasekho, kepha kuphela uma lamafayela asahambelana nema-hashes abo labhaliwe. Ema-JAR kanye nema-world files langakacondziswa angeke asuswe. Emafayela ekwakheka laniketwa yi-pack lensha angatsatsa indzawo yalawo lamadzala; i-preview iyabakhombisa ngaphambi kwekutsi ucinisekise. Gcina leligama lefayela le-ZIP lale-server nawuvuselela le-pack kute ibonwe njenge-pack lefanako.
KUPHATSISWA KWEMHLABA Sebentisa i-Worlds kuhlela umhlaba lowatiwako. Import World ZIP ukopisha incenye yinye yalelive lelingilo, uyifake ku-folder lensha; Akukabhalwa ngetulu kwemhlaba lokhona nobe kuguculwe emkhatsini wa Java na Bedrock. Khetsa umhlaba lofakiwe bese usebentisa i-Activate World kwentela kugucula ligama lelizinga kanye nekuhlela umhlaba we-Synix ndzawonye. Kucala lokulandzelako kufaka live lelikhetsiwe. Kushintja kwenhlanyelo kutsintsa kwakhiwa kwelive lelisha, hhayi indzawo lekhona nyalo.
KUPHINISEKA Kulandzisa kugucula emafayela lokwentiwe ngulendzawo yekusebenta. Kubuyisela emuva kubuyisela emafayela labhaliwe ekucala nobe kususa emafayela laletfwe ngulolo shintjo. Khweshisa kulomhlaba longetulu ngaphambi kwekutsi ukhiphe lokungetulu kwawo. Uma ngabe emafayela alungiswa ngemuva kwaloko, i-Synix ayivumi kuwabhala ngetulu kwawo; kulondvolote lokuhleliwe futsi usebentise i-backup lephelele uma kunesidzingo.
Kubuyiswa lokulindzelekile kuvimbela kucala kuze kube ngulapho kubuyiswa sekuphelile futsi nekungena lokugciniwe kuvumelana nemafayela labuyisiwe. Tintfo letindzala letingenayo i-runtime profile letibhaliwe tidzinga i-backup lephelele kwentela kubuyisela sikhatsi sekusebenta. Ema-backups ahlala angema-backups laphelele emafolda e-server, langakatsintsani nemarekhodi ekugucula.
Ngemuva kwekuphumelelisa kubuyiselwa kwe-backup lephelele, emarekhodi lamadzala ekugucula indzawo yekusebenta abekwa njengalendzala ngaloluhlobo lwe-backup. Tiyawuhlala tibonakala kodvwa ngeke tikhone kuphendvula emafayela lavuselelwe. Kungenisa nobe kuhlela lokucuketfwe ngemuva kwekubuyisela kwakha emarekhodi lamasha ekubuyisela.
TINCWADZI TEKUTIFUNDVUTA KANYE NEMISEBENTI I-Diagnostics ifundza imibhalo yakamuva kanye nemibiko yekwehluleka kwe Java, inkhumbulo, kutsembela, emachweba, umhlaba, kanye netinkinga tesikhatsi. Kungabikho kwendlela lekhonjwako akusiso siciniseko sekutsi i-server iphilile. Kusebenta kuvula luhlelo lwekubuka imitfombo; Kulinganiswa kwe CPU kanye ne RAM akusiyo indlela yekwenta iphrofayili yetikhova.
I-Schedules ivula i-Synix's lekhona yekucala kabusha kanye nekulungiswa. Khetsa emalanga lafunekako, sikhatsi, indlela yekulindza kwebadlali, kugcina nekutfutfukisa, bese ubuyeketa futsi ugcine. Indzawo yekusebentela ayenti luhlelo lwesibili nobe igucule luhlelo lwakho ngalokuphelele.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Khetsa iseva ye-Minecraft, bese uvula i-Server Options → Minecraft Control Center. Emakhasi e-Console kanye ne-Players agcina emathuluzi ekulawula kanye newemdlali ahlangene. Lamanye emakhasi aniketa tikhungo, tindzawo, ema-add-on, kugcinwa kwe-server ngalokuphelele, kuhlelwa kwekucala kabusha, kubuyiselwa, kanye nekutfola.
TINDLELA TEKULAWULA Tintfo letisekelwa tingasebentisa i-console lelawulwa yi-Synix, indlela yekuphatsa ye-localhost lesekelwa, noma i-RCON lengakhetsi. Umsakato lotfolakalako utsembele kuloluhlelo kanye nekwakheka kwe-server.
Lifasitelo lemvelo lelifihliwe lingashiya umyalo wendzawo losekelwa utfolakala. Uma ngabe tintfo tekulawula tivaliwe, hlola kutsi i-server iyasebenta nekutsi tinhlelo tayo tekuphatsa tisemtsetfweni.
IMISEBENTI LELUNGISELWE Lapho kusekelwa khona, i-Synix iniketa tatiso, luhlu lwebadlali, kulinganisela, bashayeli kanye neluhlu lwetingucuko letivumelekile, sikhatsi/simo selitulu, kanye nekonga.
Khetsa lomdlali lofunako bese ufundza lesento ngaphambi kwekutsi usicinisekise. Kuniketa umsebentisi lilungelo lekufinyelela kuniketa imvumo lenemandla yekudlala. Ungayisebentiseli kucatulula tinkinga tekuchumana.
Imiyalo ye-RAW Sebentisa indlela yekuhlanganisa emagama lefana naleyo lekulencwadzi. Imiyalo lefana ne-list kanye ne-save-all iyindlela yekungena emdlalweni futsi ayihunyushwa nge-interface ye-Synix. Hlola imitsetfo yemdlalo ngaphambi kwekutfumela umyalo lotawugucula umhlaba nobe imvumo.
TINKHONDO NEMABITO Imibuto ingakhombisa linani lebadlali ngaphandle kwelicembu lelidvwetjelwe. Lithebula lelinemagama langenalutfo alisho kutsi kute umuntfu lohlangene nalomunye.
Sebentisa i-dashboard yekumisa nobe kucala kabusha kusebenta kwendlela yemphilo kwentela kutsi umgadzi ati kutsi lokucinywa kwemsebenti kwentiwe ngenhloso.
Gcina i-RCON lengakhetsiwe nobe tindzawo tekugcina tekuphatsa endzaweni yakho ngaphandle nangabe unendlela levikelekile yekuphatsa khashane. Umdlalo wembuso awudzingi kutsi kuvetwe lemininingwane nobe tintfo letisetjentiswako.

1. Kuba ngumnikati

Nobe ngabe nguliphi lilungelo lelinganiketwa ngalokucacile ngulelilayisensi ligcinelwe umnikati we-copyright.
3. Tingucuko Letiba Khona Emtimbeni
Ungakwati kugucula le-Software kute ivumelane netidzingo takho.
Kuntjintjwa kwetintfo takho kufanele kuhlale kuyimfihlo ngaphandle nangabe Jason Turner akunikete imvumo lebhaliwe kutsi utisabalalise.
Angeke ushicilele, ulayishe, wabelane, ukhulule, usabalalise, nobe wente kutsi ikhodi yemtfombo leguculiwe nobe ema-binary lahlanganisiwe atfolakale emphakatsini njengeluhlobo lolwehlukile lwe-Synix.
4. Kuvinjelwa
Ngaphandle kwemvume lebhalwe phambilini levela kuJason Turner, angeke:

4.2 Kusabalalisa kabusha nekubamba sive

4.3 Kuntjintjwa kweligama nekwabiwa kweligama
- Susa, ufihle, nobe ugucule ligama le-Synix, satiso se-copyright, tikweleti tebabhali, satiso selayisensi, emalogo, nobe kuniketwa. - Kwetfula nobe kugucula ligama le-Software kute itfolakale emphakatsini nobe isakatwe. - Utsi nguwe lowadala i-Software yekucala. - Sebentisa ligama le-Synix nobe ligama le-brand ngendlela lengakafaneli lekhombisa kusekela, kuvuma, budlelwano, nobe sikhundla lesisemtsetfweni.
4.4 Kuntjintja kweBunjiniyela nekuVikela i-Bypass
Ngekuya ngekuya kwemtsetfo losebentako, angeke wente umsebenti wekuhlela kabusha, kuhlanganisa, kwehlukanisa nobe ngetindlela letitsite wetame kugwema timemetelo tekuniketa ilayisensi, kuniketwa kwemalungelo, timphawu tekuphepha, kuhlolwa kwekuvuselelwa, nobe kubeka ligama kulokukhishwa lokusemtsetfweni lokuhlanganisiwe.
Lomkhawulo awukavimbeli nobe nguwaphi emalungelo langeke alahlwe loniketwe wona ngumtsetfo losebentako.
5. GitHub Emakhowe neminikelo
Umtapo wetincwadzi we-Synix losemtsetfweni ungabonwa nguwonkhe wonkhe ku-GitHub. I-platform ye-GitHub ingavumela basebentisi kutsi babuke futsi bahlukanise i-public repository ngekusebentisa kusebenta kwe-GitHub.
I-fork ye-GitHub ayikuvumeli kutsi:
- Shano umlayeto longasiwo we-Synix. - Hambisa ema-binary laguculiwe nobe langagucuki. - Kwenta kabusha i-Synix. - Sebentisa likhasi lelihlukile lekulayisha nobe sibuko. - Veta iforkhi njengeluhlelo lwakho. - Kusabalalisa kabusha i-Software ngaphandle kwekusebenta lokulinganiselwe lokuniketwa yi-GitHub.
I-fork ye-GitHub ingasetjentiswa kuphela ekubukisiseni ikhodi, kulungiselela kufaka sandla nobe kutfumela sicelo sekususa ku-repository ye-Synix. Kuntjintja kwemuntfu ngekwakhe lokungakaletfwa njengemnikelo kumele kuhlale kusendzaweni futsi kube ngekwakho.
Ngekufaka ikhodi yemtfombo, imiculu, umsebenti webuciko, nobe lomunye umnikelo kuloluhlelo lolusemtsetfweni lwe-Synix, uyavuma kutsi unelilungelo lekuwufaka bese uniketa Jason Turner ilayisensi yesikhatsi lesidze, mhlabawonkhe, lengakhetsi, lengenakuhociseka, lengenayo inkhokhelo yekusebentisa, kukhicita kabusha, kugucula, kushicilela, kusakata, kuniketa imvumo lencane, nekuhlanganisa lomnikelo ku-Synix.
6. Synix Ligama kanye neBranding
Ligama le-Synix, ilogo, sitfombe kanye nalokunye lokumayelana naleligama kuhlala kuyintfo yaJason Turner.
Kute timphawu tekutsengisa nobe emalayisensi emphahla laniketwa ngalelilayisensi ngaphandle kwekubonisa ligama le-Synix lelingakachitjelwa kanye nemphahla yemphahla uma usebentisa leSofthiwe.
Kusetjentiswa ngalokungekho emtsetfweni kweluphawu lwe-Synix kungahle kwephule i-copyright, uphawu lwekutsengisa, kuchudzelana lokungakafaneli nobe leminye imitsetfo.
7. Kuphela kwemsebenti
Emalungelo akho ngaphasi kwalelilayisensi aphela ngekwendalo uma ngabe wephula nobe nguyiphi imitsetfo yalelilayisensi.
Ngemuva kwekucedvwa kwalomsebenti, kumele:
-Yekela kusebentisa nekugucula leSofthiwe. - Yekela kusakata nobe kuveta emakhophi langakavumeleki. - Susa emakhophi lasemtsetfweni langakavumeleki, kukhipha, kubuketa nobe kulayisha lokungaphansi kwekulawula kwakho. - Susa emakhophi lacondzene nawe nangabe umtsetfo ufuna njalo.
Tigaba letiphatselene nebunikati, imincele, iminikelo, kuncatjelwa kwemitfwalo nekuphocelelwa kusebenta tiyasindza ngemuva kwekucitfwa.
8. Kuphatfwa kwemtsetfo
Umnikati we-copyright angafaka sandla kunobe ngabe ngutiphi tindlela tekwelashwa letikhona ngaphasi kwemtsetfo losebentako mayelana nekukopisha lokungagunyaziwe, kusakata, kubamba umlayeto wemuntfu emphakatsini, kutsengisa, kushintja ligama lalomkhicito nobe lokunye kunyakata.
Tindlela tekwelashwa letitfolakalako tingafaka ekhatsi ticelo tekususa, tinchubo tekususwa kwemapulatifomu, tijubo tekucindzetela, kulahlekelwa kanye naletinye tindlela temtsetfo wesintfu lapho kufaneleke khona ngekwemtsetfo.
Kute lokukulelilayisensi lokucinisekisako kutsi nobe ngabe ngusiphi sinyatselo sekuphocelela nobe indlela yekwelashwa itawutfolakala kuwo onkhe emave.
9. Kuyekelwa kwemitfwalo kanye nekuncishiswa kwemtfwalo
I-SOFTWARE INIKETWA NJENGOBA INJENGOBA ISEBENTIWE FUTFU NJENGOBA KUTFOLAKANGAKHONA, KUTE SICINISEKISO SANOMA NGULUPHI LUHLOKO, Lolucacisiwe nobe Lolucondziswako, Lokufaka ekhatsi ticinisekiso tekutsengiswa, kulungela inhloso letsite, sihloko, kanye nekungahlukunyetwa.
KULOKUNINGI LOKUVUMELWE ngumtsetfo, i-JASON TURNER angeke ibe nelicala lelimayelana nanobe ngukuphi kulimala lokucondzile, lokungakacondzi, lokungahle kwenteke, lokukhetsekile, lokubangelwe ngulokutsite nobe lokungahle kwenteke, nobe kulahleka kwedatha, inzuzo, imali lengenako, emafayela e-server, umhlaba wemidlalo, ibhizinisi, nobe kutfolakala kwetinsita lokuvela nobe lokuhlobene ne-SOFTWARE nobe kusetjentiswa kwayo.
Nguwe lonemtfwalo wekugcina ema-backups kanye nekucinisekisa kutsi iSoftware ilungele luhlelo lwakho kanye nendzawo yekusebenta yemdlalo.
10. Tincenye temuntfu wesitsatfu
I-software yenkampani yesitsatfu, imitapo yetincwadzi, emafayili e-server yemdlalo, tincenye te-SteamCMD, timphawu tekutsengiswa, kanye naletinye tintfo letitfolakalako tiyimphahla yebanikati bato futsi tihlala tingaphansi kwemalayisensi nemibandzela yato.
Lilayisensi isebenta kuphela etincenyeni te-Synix letiphetfwe nguJason Turner.
11. Imvumo Lebhaliwe
Lokungavumelani nalelilayisensi kusebenta kuphela uma kuniketwe ngekubhala nguJason Turner.
Imibuto nobe ticelo temvumo kumele tifakwe ngekusebentisa luhlelo lolusemtsetfweni lwe-Synix GitHub nobe lenye indlela lesemtsetfweni yekuchumana ne-Synix.
12. Imitfombo Lesemtsetfweni Yekutitsatsela
Tfola i-Synix kuphela ngalemitfombo lesemtsetfweni:
- https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases - https://synix.info
Emakhophi laniketwa ngulamanye ema-website akacinisekiswa ngu-Jason Turner futsi kungenteka angabi nesiciniseko, ashintjwe, aphelelwe sikhatsi nobe afakwe tinhlelo letingafuneki. Kuphepha kwawo kanye nekwetsembeka kwawo akucinisekiswa nguJason Turner.
Kufaka i-Synix eluhlwini, kuxhumanisa ne-GitHub, nobe kuniketa indlela yekutitsatsela yona akusho kwendlulisa bunikati nobe kusho kuniketwa kwemvume, kuhlanganiswa, kuvunywa nobe kuba sesimeni lesisemtsetfweni. Synix ihlala iyimphahla yaJason Turner.
Kubamba, kulingisa, kusebentisa ema-proxy, kuphindze uhlanganise nobe kufaka imiculu letsetfwe kudzinga imvumo lebhaliwe. Kucondzisa kumtfombo losemtsetfweni akuyivumeli lemvumo.
Sigaba 4.2 asivimbeli kuchumana lokucondzile lokujwayelekile nalemitfombo lesemtsetfweni lecinisa i-Synix kanye naJason Turner. Lama-link akenti kutsi lelikhasi langcondvomshini lekuchumana libe ngumtfombo losemtsetfweni.
Iphakheji ye-WinGet ubidzz.Synix yindlela yekuhlela leyemukelwe uma itsatsa luhlelo lwekufaka lolungakaguculwa ngco kuletincwadzi letisemtsetfweni te-GitHub. Loku akuvumeli kutsi umuntfu wesitsatfu alungise nobe aphindze alungise.
13. I-Live Activity Counter kanye ne-Privacy
I-Synix ifaka i-optional live activity counter lekhomba linani lemisebenti ye-Synix ku-https://synix.info. Ungayicisha nobe kunini ku-Settings > Privacy & Security > Share active count ngaphandle kwekunciphisa letinye tintfo te-Synix. Lokutsandvwa lokwakugcinwe ngaphambilini kuyahlonishwa.
Uma ikhona, i-Synix itfumela umlayeto wekubakhona kwe-HTTPS ku-https://synix.info/api/presence ekucaleni kanye nakuwo onkhe emaminitsi e-10 ngalesikhatsi loluhlelo lusebenta, kufaka ekhatsi ngemuva. Lesiginali icuketse ikhodi yesikhashana yekusebenta kanye ne-identifier yeluhlelo loluphelele lwe-Synix, ngaphandle kwemtimba wemlayeto. Ikhodi yeseshini igcinwa emkhumbulweni kuphela futsi iyabuyiselwa uma kucala umhlangano lomusha wekubika; akusiyo indlela yekukhomba intfo lengagucuki.
Le-counter ayilayishi ligama lakho, likheli le-imeyili, emaphasiwedi, umniningwane we-server nobe wemdlali, emagugu ekuhlela, emafayela, nobe tikhombisi temshini.
Kuyo yonkhe inchubo yekusebentisa i-website, i-counter igcina kuphela i-hash yekhodi yekusebentisa i-website kanye nesikhatsi sekusebenta kwayo kwekugcina. Lelikhasi langcondvomshini lemphakatsi libonisa kuphela linani leliphelele lebantfu labasebentako, lokulinganiselwa kunekubalwa kwebantfu labatsite. Sigaba siyayekela kubalwa ngemuva kwemaminitsi langu-15 ngaphandle kwesibonakaliso. Emarekhodi emarekhodi langasebenti ayafaneleka kutsi ahlanjululwe ngemuva kwemaminitsi langu-30 futsi ayasuswa uma ticelo letilandzelako temarekhodi tihlanteka. I-Synix ayihlanganisi lemiculu yekulinganisa ne-akhawunti yemcondzisi lokhashane nobe matisi wemakhompyutha lahlanganisiwe.
Kuvala lomsebenti kuvimbela letinye timphawu tekubakhona bese kwenta sicelo sinye sekususa leseshini lekhona. Kuvala i-Synix nako kwetama kususa; uma kususwa kungeke kufinyelele kulewebhusayithi, leseshini itawuyekela kubala ngekwendalo ngemuva kwesikhatsi sekungasebenti.
Njenganobe ngukuphi kuchumana kwe-Internet, tinsita tekubamba iwebhusayithi titfola lwati lolwetayelekile lwekuchumana, njengelikheli le-IP lekucala kanye nesikhatsi lesicelwako, futsi tingacubungula nobe tibhalise ngekwemigomo yato yetemfihlo. Lolwati alugciniwe ethebuleni lekubala imisebenti ye-Synix futsi aliboniswa ekubalweni kwebantfu.
14. Kufinyelela Lokukude Kwemfihlo Nekuphepha
14.1 Kufinyelela lokungakhetsi futsi akukho kutsengiswa kwedatha
Kuphatsa lokukhashane ku-https://manager.synix.info akukhetsiwe futsi akuvunyelwanga kuze kube ngulapho uhlanganisa ikhompyutha bese uvuma i-akhawunti lecelako ku-app ye-Synix kuleyo khompyutha. Ungasebentisa i-Synix endzaweni yakho ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti yemcondzisi. I-counter yemisebenti yemphakatsi yehlukile futsi ingacishwa ngalenye indlela.
I-Synix ayitsengisi, ayikhokhi, ayitsengisi, futsi ayidaluli imininingwane ye-akhawunti yakho, imininingwane yemakhompyutha lahlanganisiwe, umsebenti lokwentiwa khashane, nobe umniningwane we-server kubantfu labatsengisako nobe emakhasimende. I-Synix ayisebentisi lemininingwane kukhangisa lokucondzile nobe kwakha ema-advertising profiles kuyo. Lwati lusetjentiselwa kuniketa tinsita lotikhetsile, kucinisekisa kufinyelela, kusebentisa lenkonzo kanye nekuyivikela kutsi ingasetjentiswa kabi.
Kufinyelela khashane akusiyo indlela yekugcina tintfo. Idzinga i-akhawunti lelinganiselwe, kuhlanganiswa, kusebenta kanye nemarekhodi ekuvikeleka lachazwe ngentasi. Lemarekhodi ayashicilelwa ku-Public Activity Counter nobe akhonjiswe kulamanye ema-akhawunti ebaphatsi ngekusebentisa lolusito.
14.2 Lokuhlala kuKhompyutha Yakho
I-Synix ayilayishi ngekushesha umhlaba wemidlalo, emafayili e-server yemdlalo, lokucuketfwe kumafayili ekwakheka, lokucuketfwe kuma-archive ekusekela, lokuphuma ku-console, noma emaphasiwedi e-server yemdlalo. Kusekela nekutfola tintfo letikhashane kusetjentiswe kukhompyutha lehlanganisiwe; emafayela ekubhekhaphi ahlala etindzaweni letisetjentiswe lapho. Nangabe ukhetsa kubhala umyalo wekudlala ku-website, umbhalo walomyalo uyalungiswa bese utfunyelwa kulekhompyutha lehlanganisiwe, lokufaka ekhatsi nobe nguwaphi emagugu lowabhala kulombhalo. Lomlawuli akasiyo i-cloud backup storage futsi akaniketi ideskithophu lekhashane lengenamkhawulo, i-Windows yekufinyelela ngekushesha kwemyalo, nobe kusesha jikelele kwemafayela.
I-Synix igcina imiculu yayo yasendzaweni, luhlu lwemaseva, umlandvo, ema-backups kanye nesimo sekuphatsa ku-computer yakho. Ikhi yekusayina yangasese ye-computer lehlanganisiwe ihlala ku-Windows. I-Synix itsandza kugcinwa kwe-TPM uma ikhona futsi isekela kukhiya kwesofthiwe levikelwe yi-Windows, kufaka ekhatsi kuma-VM ahambisanako. Kutfolakala kwe-TPM akusiso siciniseko sekutsi ikhompyutha ayingenabo bungoti.
Letitatimende tichaza kusetjentiswa kwe-Synix ngekusebentisa indlela yekulawula indzawo lekhashane. Imidlalo, Steam, mods, kuhlanganiswa kwe Discord, lokutfunyelwa ngaphandle, kanye nemibiko yekusekela lotikhetsela kuhlanganyela nayo inendlela yayo yekuhamba kwemininingwane. Ungafaki emaphasiwedi nobe lokunye kwatiswa lokubucayi emagama emakhompyutha, emagama e-server, nobe emagama emafayela ekubhekhaphu, ngobe lamalebuli angahle avele ku-manager.
14.3 Umcondzisi ucubungula nekugcina lwati
- I-akhawunti nekucinisekiswa: Ligama lelisebentisi lolikhetsile, i-account identifier, sikhatsi sekucalisa, tintfo letifunwako tekuphepha, i-password hash, imfihlo ye-encrypted authenticator uma ivunyelwe, i-passkey public credentials uma ivunyelwe, kanye nemarekhodi ekucinisekisa/eseshini yesikhashana. Emaphasiwedi nemakhodi ekucinisekisa ayacutjungulwa kute acinisekise kungena; emaphasiwedi langeke agucuke angeke agcinwe njengembhalo lofundzekako. I-Synix ayitfoli iminwe yakho, sitfombe sebuso bakho, i-passkey nobe inkinobho yekusayina ye-computer lehlanganisiwe. Kubhalisa akudzingi kutsi unikete ligama lakho mbamba nobe likheli le-e-mail. - Kuhlanganiswa nekuhlanganiswa: I-label yekhompyutha loyikhetsile, i-random device identifier, i-public signing key yayo, kuhlanganiswa kwe-akhawunti, luhlobo lwemnikati wenkhombandlela lobikiwe, simo sekwemukelwa kwekuhlanganiswa, kanye nesikhatsi sekuhlanganiswa kwekugcina. Lokutsintsana kwe-relay lokuthulile kungahlala kuvulekile ngesikhatsi i-Synix isebenta kute kutsi iwebhusayithi ikhone kuvusa le app lehlanganisiwe ngekushesha. I-relay itfwele timemetelo tekuvuka/kuyekela kuchumana kanye nemetadata yekuchumana, hhayi emafayili emdlalo nobe titfombe tesiphakeli. - Simo lesibonisiwe: Ema-identifiers emaseva lamancane, emagama, emagama emidlalo, simo sekusebenta, linani lebadlali, sikhatsi lesisetjentiswako, tinyatselo letitfolakalako, sikhatsi/simo sekugcina sekulondvolota, kuhlanganiswa kwe CPU kanye ne RAM lokufundvwa kusuka kunchubo yemaseva emidlalo lesebentako (kufaka ekhatsi ema-launcher lalandzelwako kanye netisebenti), nekuhlukanisa i-computer yonkhe i-CPU, kusetjentiswa/inani leliphelele le-RAM, kanye netilinganiso tekutfumela/temukela inethiwekhi. Tindleko tetinhlelo temakhompyutha tifaka ekhatsi i-LAN traffic kuma-adaptha emagateway lasebentako; tikhombisi te-adapter, emakheli e-IP, lokucuketfwe ngemaphakethe kanye netindzawo tekufundzela angeke kutfunyelwe nalemibala. Loluhlelo lutfumela lesifinyeto ngalesikhatsi kubukwa kwe-authenticated manager kusebenta. i-CPU/i-RAM ihlanganisa emakhompyutha lahlanganisiwe; i-server lechazwe kabanti ihlanganisa ikhompyutha lekhetsiwe. Kuvusetelwa kuvame kwentiwa njalo ngemizuzwana lengu-10 bese kuyema ngemuva kwekuvalwa, kwehlukaniswa, kuphelelwa sikhatsi nobe kufihlwa. Letinye tikhungo tekuhlola letisebentako tingasebentisa tindlela tato tekubuka tintfo. - Imisebenti lecelwako kanye nekusekela: i-server/kwatiswa kwesento, sikhatsi lesicelwako, inchubekelembili/umphumela, futsi, uma ucela kukhetsa kwekusekela, kwatiswa kwekusekela, emagama emafayela, tinsuku, bukhulu, kanye netimphawu tekuciniseka. Lokucuketfwe kwe-backup kanye nemigwaco lephelele yendzawo ayitfunyelwa kuloluhlelo. - Imiyalo yekudlala: i-identifier lengakhanyi kahle yekudlala, kuvunyelwa kwekuvula kwesikhashana, kanye nemlayeto lowetfulako. Umbhalo lolindze ubhalwa ngemshoshaphansi ku-database yelusito bese uyasuswa kulelo rekhodi uma kuniketwa imvumo. Alikho eluhlwini lwetento letisandza kwenteka nobe emarekhodi e-account-alert. Umphumela wekutfunyelwa kwemlayeto kusho kutsi lombhalo utfunyelwe kulomdlalo, hhayi kutsi lomdlalo uwemukele nobe sewuwugcwalisile. Imphendvulo yemdlalo kanye nesihlahla senchubo yasendzaweni angeke kulayishwe. - Kuvikeleka nekuvimbela kusetjentiswa kabi kwemandla: luhlobo lwekungena lolwehlulekile, kubalwa kwetama kanye netikhatsi letihlanganisiwe, luhlobo lwesehlakalo sekuvuselela/kuvikeleka, kanye nemamaki e-computer lafanele. Emarekhodi lanesikhatsi lesifishane langasebenti kahle angasebentisa ema-hashes lahlanganisiwe ekuchumana, emakheli e-IP kanye netinombolo tekutfola i-akhawunti. Emarekhodi e-akhawunti-yekucwayisa ye-Synix ayinayo imitamo yemaphasiwedi, emakhodi ekucinisekisa, emakheli e-IP langakahlelwa, nobe iminwe yesiphequluli. Umnikati wekubamba angacubungula imininingwane yekuchumana ngalokwehlukile njengobe kuchaziwe kusigaba 14.6.
Lelikhasi langcondvomshini libese lilandzela imiyalo kanye netincwadzi tekuhlola letivumelekile kwentela kuniketa kulawula lokukude. i-HTTPS kanye nekuhlanganiswa kwe-relay lokufihliwe kuvikela kusetjentiswa kwethrafikhi; loku akusiyo inkhulumo yekutsi le-hosting service ayikwati kucubungula ledatha.
14.4 Kugcina nekususa
- Imininingwane ye-akhawunti kanye netintfo letisetjentiswako kuyasala kuze kube ngulapho i-akhawunti isusiwe. Emarekhodi ekuhlanganiswa kwemakhasimende lavunyiwe atawugcinwa kute kube ngulapho ikhompyutha ingasahlanganiswa nobe i-akhawunti isuswa. - Ema-snapshots esimo kanye netilinganiso te-CPU/RAM tibhalwa ngetintfo letinsha futsi tiyalungiswa ngemuva kwemaminitsi langu-15 ngaphandle kwekuguculwa. Sikhatsi sekuchumana kwekugcina siyincenye yemarekhodi ekuhlanganiswa. - Imiculu yekulawula khashane, imiphumela, kanye nemetadata lekhetsiwe lebuyeketiwe iyafaneleka kutsi ihlanjululwe ngemuva kwemahora e-24. - Imiyalo yemdlalo lemiselwe iphelelwa sikhatsi ngemuva kwemizuzwana lengu-30. Umbhalo longazange utfunyelwe uyacelwa kutsi ususwe ngemuva kwekuphelelwa sikhatsi nobe kucitfwa; kuhanjiswa lokuvunyelwe kususa lelicala ngekushesha. Imvumo yekusebentisa i-console iphelelwa sikhatsi ngemizuzu lemitsatfu. I-identifier yesento kanye nemphumela wekutfunyelwa lokucinile kulandzela sikhatsi sekubhalwa kwesento lesingu-24-emahora. - Tintfo letiphatselene nekulungiswa/kuvikeleka kanye netindzaba tekwehluleka kungena tifanele kutsi tisuswe ngemuva kwemalanga langu-90. Kuhlola lokungakaphumeleli kugcina kakhulu emacembu e-100 lakamuva; Kwehluleka kuhambelana ngesikhatsi semizuzu lengu-10 kuhlanganiswe ndzawonye. - Tikhatsi tekusebentisa i-browser tiphelelwa sikhatsi ngemuva kwemizuzu lengu-30 ngaphandle kwekucela umphatsi nobe emva kwemahora langu-8. Imigomo yekucinisekisa iphelelwa sikhatsi ngemuva kwemizuzu lengu-5; le-password yesikhashana iphelelwa sikhatsi ngemizuzu lengu-10 futsi ingasetjentiswa kanye kuphela. Emarekhodi laphelelwe sikhatsi ekuhlola, kubuyisela, kuvikela kuphindze kudlalwe, kanye nekunciphisa lizinga ayasuswa ngesikhatsi sekuhlanta. Kubhaliswa kwe-akhawunti lokungakapheleli kuba ngulakufanelekile kutsi kususwe ngemuva kwemahora langu-24.
Kuphelelwa sikhatsi kuvimbela kuniketwa kwemvume ngisho nangaphambi kwekutsi lirekhodi lisuswe. Luhlelo lwekuhlanta i-database lusebenta ngesikhatsi seticelo telusito lolulandzelako, lokungenani kanye njalo ngemizuzu le-10 yekuhlanta umphatsi, ngako letikhatsi letingenhla tiphelelwa sikhatsi nobe tikhatsi tekulungela kuhlanta kunetetsembiso tekususwa ngesikhatsi lesitsite. Emarekhodi ebasebentisi kanye nemakhophi lamasha anemijikeleto yekuphila leyehlukene.
Kususa kuhlanganiswa kususa kuhlanganiswa lokukhetsiwe kanye nemarekhodi lakhona lakhashane kusuka kudathabhesi yemsebenti losebentako. Umlandvo wekubuyiswa kwemali/wetibambiso ungahlala kule-akhawunti kulesikhatsi lesingenhla. Kususa i-akhawunti yemcondzisi kususa imininingwane yayo, kuhlanganiswa, titfombe, imiyalo kanye nekuphepha kwe-akhawunti/irekhodi lekubuyisa kusuka kudathabhesi yemsebenti lesebentako. Akususi i-server yemidlalo yakini, umhlaba, tintfo letisetjentiswako, nobe emafayela ekuvikela. Emarekhodi ekuvimbela kusetjentiswa kabi kwemitfombolusito yesikhashana kanye nemarekhodi laphetfwe ngumnikeli nobe ema-backups akususwa ngekushesha ngaletinyatselo.
14.5 Kulawula kwakho nekuvikela kungena
Kungena ngemvume kudzinga kutsi usebentise li-password lakho kanye ne-passkey lekhona nobe i-authenticator, lefana ne-Google Authenticator. Ema-akhawunti lahlelwe kutsi adzinge letindlela totimbili, agcina letimfuneko totimbili. Kuntjintja iphasiwedi, kuhlukanisa ikhompyutha nge-website, nekususa i-akhawunti yemenenja kudzinga kucinisekiswa kabusha kwalolushintjo lolutsite.
Kuvula i-game console yakho kudzinga kutsi ufake iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti yakho lesebentako kanye nekucinisekiswa lokusha ngekulandzela imitsetfo lekhona ye-akhawunti. Kuvumeleka kuboshelwe kuseshini yinye yekusebentisa i-browser, kukhompyutha lehlanganisiwe, kuseva legciniwe kanye nemdlalo lophilako losebenta imizuzu lemitsatfu. Kuyekela, kucalisa kabusha, kuvala ikhonsoli, kukhubateka kwekusebenta kwekhonsoli nobe kulahleka kwenchubo kuvimbela leminye imiyalo. Kuhlukanisa nobe kufihla i-tab yemenenja kucedza kuvunyelwa kwaleyo tab. Tinkinobho letetayelekile tekusebenta kweseva tigcina tidzingo tato tekungena. Kuphela kwetintfo tekungenisa letisekelwa ngumdlalo letingafakwa; i-identifier lekhetsekile iyodvwa ayikuvumeli kubhala ku-command prompt Windows.
Ikhompyutha lehlanganisiwe leyemukelwe ngaphambilini ingakhipha iphasiwedi yesikhashana uma ngabe ukhohliwe iphasiwedi ye-website yakho. Ayikhoni kukhetsa lenye i-akhawunti. Iphasiwedi yesikhashana ayiyibalekeli nobe isuse tidzingo takho tephasiwedi lekhona, futsi kumele ukhetse iphasiwedi lensha ngaphambi kwekutsi ungene ku-manager. Kucedza kuvuselela kucedza letinye tincenye teluhlelo lwakho.
Imenenja ye-Synix igcina i-login yayo yesiphequluli kumemori ye-tab yamanje, hhayi kuma-cookies, kugcinwa kwasendzaweni, nobe kugcinwa kweseshini. Kuvuselela nobe kuvala le-tab kutawukwenta ungakhoni kungena. Loku akuvimbeli i-browser yakho nobe umphatsi wemaphasiwedi kutsi agcine imininingwane yekungena nangabe ukhetsa njalo, futsi akuchazi ema-cookie labekwe ngekwehlukana baniketi be-hosting/be-security nobe umsebenti wekuhumusha we-website yemphakatsi.
Ungakhipha i-log out, ukhiphe tonkhe tingucuko tesiphequluli, nobe ukhiphe inhlanganisela yekhompyutha. I-Synix app yangakini ingakhubaza iphindze ivale kuchumana kwayo lokukude ngaphandle kwekungena kulewebhusayithi. Uma ingekho ku-internet, ivimbela kufinyelela lokukhashane endzaweni bese iphindze yetama kususa lelikhasi langcondvomshini uma kuhlanganiswa kutfolakala. Kucala kabusha i-app nobe i-Windows akubuyisi ngalokuphelele kuhlanganiswa lokususwe ngalokucacile. Kusetjentiswa endzaweni kuphela.
14.6 Kubamba, Emakhasi Lavulekile, kanye Nemikhawulo Yekuphepha
Lelikhasi langcondvomshini lelisemtsetfweni lisebentisa i-OpenAI's Sites hosting kanye netinsita te Cloudflare tekutfula, kugcina, kuvikela, kanye nekusakata. Labaphakeli bacubungula umniningwane lodzingekako kute banikete letinsita futsi bangatfola emakheli e-IP, tinhloko teticelo, tikhatsi, kanye naleminye imethadatha yekuchumana, nobe bagcine emarekhodi abo ekusebenta kanye nemakhophi lamasekelako. Tinchubomgomo tabo temfihlo tiyasebenta ekucubunguleni kwabo: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ na-https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Kuhumusha lokuzenzakalelayo kwemakhasi lavulekile kanye nekutfola i-GitHub kufaka ekhatsi labaniketi babo. Lomcondzisi wangasese wehlukene nemakhasi emphakatsi futsi akalayishi umsebenti wekuhumusha wemphakatsi nobe imibhalo yekukhangisa. I-Synix ayisho kutsi kuvakashela nobe nguwaphi emawebhusayithi akubangeli kutsi kwakhiwe ema-cookies, emarekhodi, nobe imininingwane legciniwe. Imininingwane ingaphindze idalulwe uma kudzingekile ngekwemtsetfo; Lesibopho sekungatsengiswa lesingenhla asikuvimbeli kubamba lokudzingekile nobe kudalulwa ngalokusemtsetfweni.
I-Synix isebentisa kuhlanganiswa kwetintfo, ticelo temakhompyutha letisayiniwe, kuchumana kwenethiwekhi lokufihliwe, kuhlolwa kwekungena kwe-akhawunti kanye nekwemukelwa kwesikhashana kwentela kunciphisa kungena lokungakavumeleki. Letindlela tekuvikela atenti kutsi kufinyelela khashane kungabi nebungoti nobe kucinisekise kuvikeleka ekuhlaselweni ngalokuphelele, kukhinyabeteka kwe-computer/kwe-browser, tindlela tekucinisekisa letintsatfwako, nobe kusetjentiswa kwetinhlelo letitsintsekako. Gcina i-Synix kanye ne-Windows ilungisiwe, uvikele i-akhawunti yakho kanye netindlela tekucinisekisa, futsi uvumele kuphela emakhompyutha kanye nema-akhawunti lowalawulako.
Lesatiso siyatfolakala ku-https://synix.info/license/ futsi sifakwe ku-Help Center kanye nasekufakweni kwaloluhlelo. Imibuto lemayelana nemfihlo ingaphakanyiswa ngekusebentisa tindlela tekusekela letisemtsetfweni ku https://synix.info/support/. Ungatfumeleli emaphasiwedi, emakhodi ekubuyisa, nobe lolunye lwati lwe-akhawunti yangasese kumlayeto losemtsetfweni wekusekela. Kuvusetelwa kwalomlayeto kufaka luhlelo lolusha kanye nelusuku.

data.name: Content.3EDF002B53C15DD7A21D
data.value:
Vula i-Settings → Report a Problem kute ulungiselele umbiko, nobe usebentise tindzawo tekusekela letisemtsetfweni letingentasi.
YENTA LENKINGA IBE YINDLELA YEKUPHENDVULA Faka indlela yekufaka, tinhlobo te-Synix ne-Windows lotisebentisako, umdlalo/iphrofayili kanye nemininingwane lefanele yekuhlela/yekulayisha.
Chaza: • Loko lokuchofozile nobe lokushintjile. • Nguloko lobewukulindzele nalokwentekile. • Liphutsa lelicondzile kanye nesicaphuno lesifishane lesisondzelene nesikhatsi salo. • Kutsi ngabe loluhlelo belusebenta yini ngaphambilini nekutsi yini leseyishintjile.
KUBUYETELA NGAPHAMBI KWEKUNIKETA Susa emaphasiwedi, ema-tokens, ema-URL e-webhook, tindlela takho, kanye nemininingwane yenethiwekhi longafuni kutsi ibe semphakatsini. I-Privacy Mode ayigcini onkhe emafayela lahlanganisiwe. Ungafaki ema-log laphelele nobe tinhlelo temdlalo ungakahlolisisi.
Mayelana nenkinga yekuhumusha, faka lulwimi lolukhetsiwe, ligama lelifasitelo, kanye nemagama lacondzile labonakalako. Uma kunenkinga yekuchaza umdlalo, faka luhlelo loluhleliwe lwekufaka kanye nemiculu lefanele yemdlalo.
TINDZIMBO LETISEMtsetfweni Imibiko yekukhishwa: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Umphakatsi Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Sitolo sekugcina imiculu: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Luhlelo loluphumelelako lwekufaka nobe kwakha luhlelo alukwati kuvivinya yonkhe imidlalo, ema-mod kanye netindzawo tetinethiwekhi. Tinyatselo leticacile tekukhicita tisita kwehlukanisa inkinga ye-Synix kulenkinga yemdlalo nobe yekusungula i-host.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Chofoza emgceni we-server ngaphambi kwekusebentisa lokulawula lokusekugcineni. Lomugca lokhetsiwe uchaza kutsi nguyiphi i-server lesetjentiswako.
Tfola ISERVER Sebentisa ibhokisi lekucinga kute ukhetse umdlalo nobe ligama leseva. Luhlelo lwekuhlola simo lwenta loluhla lube luncane kakhulu. Uma ngabe intfo letsite ibonakala ingekho, khulula lamafiltha lamabili ngaphambi kwekutsatsa kutsi isusiwe.
CABANGA NGALOKUFINELEKO • Ema-server lafakiwe abala emarekhodi e-server labhaliswe. • Ku-Running Now kukhombisa imibhalo lekhonjisiwe njengamanje. • Kusetjentiswa kwe CPU kanye ne RAM kuchaze i-PC yonkhe, hhayi nje Synix. • Imininingwane yemdlali itfolakala kuphela nangabe umdlalo lokhetsiwe ukhombisa kutsi uyasekelwa.
KULANDZISWA LIKHASI LONKHE • Kucala, Kuyekela nekucalisa kabusha i-server lekhetsiwe. • I-Configure ivula tindzawo tekusungula. • Kulungela kuhlola tintfo letingakuvimbela kutsi usebente. • Tincumo te-Server ticuketse emafayela, kulondvolota, kuchumana, kanye nemathulusi lacondzene nemdlalo. • Cacisa kabili emgceni kute ubone kabanti ngaloluhlelo.
I-Activity & Diagnostics ikhombisa inchubekelembili kanye neticwayiso letifanele. Fundza umlayeto wekugcina ngaphambi kwekutsi uphindze wente lokutsite. I-CLEAR isusa indzawo lebonakalako yekusebenta; akusiwo umyalo wekususa onkhe emafayela emarekhodi.
Inchubo lechubekako ayikalungeli kudlalwa ngulabadlali. Kufakwa, kulayishwa kwemhlaba, tivumelwano, kanye nekusungulwa kwemdlalo kungachubeka ngemuva kwekuvela kwenchubo. Cinisekisa kulungela kwakho ngekubhalisa emdlalweni nangekujoyina.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Vula i-Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager kute utfole iphrofayili lesekelako. i-Synix itfola lokucuketfwe lokufakiwe kanye netindzawo tekutfutsa letisekelwa; akusiyo ikhathalogi lehlanganisa onkhe ema-mods.
Faka iphakethe lendzawo 1. Tsatsa li-backup lemhlaba, letengetiwe letikhona, kanye nekuhleleka lokutsintsekile. 2. Yima i-server nge Synix bese ulindza licembu layo kutsi liphume. 3. Hlola loluhlelo lolwengetiwe lolutfolakele, indzawo yekubeka, kanye neluhla lwekuvikela. 4. Khetsa i-Install From File nobe i-Import Package yelifayela lelisekelwako, i-ZIP, nobe imfolda ye-mod lephelele. Lokukhetsiwe lokutfolakalako kuncike kuloluhlelo lwemdlalo. 5. Hlola lapho uya khona, imiphumela yekuhlola, tecwayiso kanye nekucinisekisa. 6. Vumela kulungiselelwa, kusekela, kanye nekuhlanganiswa kwemishini kutsi kuphele. 7. I-Synix ivusetela loluhla uma sekuphelile kufakwa. Cala kabusha uma kunesidzingo, bese uhlola luhlelo lwekudlala kanye nekuchumana kweliklayenti.
Loluhla lukhombisa indzawo yekuhlela lekhetsiwe. Sebentisa i-Search kute utfole i-add-on ngeligama, luhlobo, umtfombo, nobe indlela. Kuvuselela luhlolo futsi kugcina intfo lekhetsiwe uma isekhona. Kubona tintfo ngendlela lemelula kususa imininingwane letsite ngaphandle kwekugwema kuhlolwa.
Gcina lelifasitelo livulekile ngalesikhatsi kwentiwa luhlolo nobe lushintjo. I-Synix icitsa tinyatselo letiphikisanako ize iphele. Nangabe sehlulelo singaphumeleli, fundza liphutsa laso bese uvuselela loluhla ngaphambi kwekutsi uphindze wetame.
TINHLOKO TEKUSEBENTA Tindlela tekusebenta letisekelwa tifaka ekhatsi emaphakheji e-Minecraft JAR, ema-plugins e-Rust Oxide/uMod, emaphakheji e-7 Local Days to Die, simo se-Empyrion kanye nema-mods e-server, ema-ID e-Workshop e-ARK: Survival Evolved, kanye nema-ID ebahlinzeki be-ARK: Survival Ascended. Letinye tinhlelo titfola kuphela nobe tidzinga luhlaka lwato kucala.
I-ID yemnikeli, i-Synix icondzisa luhlelo lolusekelwako ngalesikhatsi umdlalo/umniketi aniketa lokucuketfwe. Lokucuketfwe lokungakalayishwa angeke kukhonjiswe kusenesikhatsi endzaweni.
LOKUNGAKWENTIWA NGEMACHEKHI KANYE LOKUNGAKWENTIWA NGEMACHEKhi Kungenisa kuhlola luhlaka lwephakeji kanye netindzawo lekuyiwa kuto bese kulahla tindlela letingaphephile, ema-link, lokucuketfwe lokungavumeleki, emaphakheji lamakhulu kakhulu, tindzawo letiphindvwe kabili, kanye nekutfolwa kwe-malware.
Luhlolo lwe-Defender lolungakatfolakali nobe lolungakhombisi siciniseko, lusicwayiso, hhayi bufakazi be-malware. Luhlolo loluhlobile kanye ne-hash lebhalwe phansi nako akukhombisi kutsi liphasela lemuntfu wesitsatfu letsembekile. Ema-mods asebenta nge-server's Windows imvumo.
KUKHATALOGISHA, KUSUKA NEKUBUYETELA TINCWADZI Kuvula i-Browse Catalog kuvula i-website yemnikati. Akusiti ngekususa tintfo letidzingekile nobe ufake i-modpack lephelele.
Vimbela i-server ngaphambi kwekuyibuyisela emuva. Loku kugucula lonkhe luhlelo lolukhetsiwe, lolungaba netintfo letengetiwe. Ivuselela imibhalo yekucala lesigciniwe bese isusa emafayela laletfwe ngule-import. Kuhlatiya tintfo letinsha letingenisiwe kucala uma tihlanganyela emafayela; I-Synix ayivumi kubhala ngetulu kwalamafayela laguculwe ngaphandle kwekubhalwa kwawo nobe isebentise imibhalo yekucala legciniwe lengaphumeleli kuhlolwa kwebucotfo. Emarekhodi lamadzala ekungenisa angahle angabi nema-hashes etincwadzini tekucala letisindzisiwe.
Ku-ID lephetfwe ngumnikeli, Kususa Lokukhetsiwe kususa leyo ID kuloluhlelo lwe-Synix lolwesekelwe; akusiko kubuyiselwa kwemaphakheji endzaweni yakini. I-Synix ibhala tingucuko letentiwako, hhayi tonkhe tingucuko letentiwe ngesandla. Gcina ema-backups e-server lephelele: kususa i-mod kungenta umhlaba ungalayisheki nobe kususe lokucuketfwe yi-mod.
Lithebula lelingenalutfo lisho kutsi kute ema-add-on lasekelako lafana nendzawo yekuhlela nekusesha lekhetsiwe. Susa i-Search bese uhlola iphrofayili, ifolda, kanye ne-framework ngaphambi kwekutsatsa kutsi onkhe emafayela e-disk aseshekile.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Vula i-Add Server → Game Support Catalog kute ubone kutsi yini Synix leyati ngalomdlalo ngaphambi kwekwenta lokutsite. Lelikhathalogi lisebentisa tinchazelo letihambisana nesicelo sakho lesifakiwe.
1. Funa ligama lalomdlalo. 2. Sebentisa luhlelo lwekuhlela, idatha yemdlali, kuhlangana, kuhambelana, nobe kuhlunga kwentela kunciphisa luhla. 3. Khetsa umdlalo bese uvula imininingwane yawo, nobe ucofe kabili emgceni wawo. 4. Fundza luhlelo lolusekelwako, luhlelo lweseva, imfuneko kanye nemininingwane yekucinisekisa.
Khipha emafiltha uma umdlalo ungekho ngalokungakalindzeleki. Tincumo te Minecraft's Java kanye ne Bedrock tiyincenye yekusebenta kwekusungula kunekutsi tibe tinhlelo letimbili letishintjanako.
CABANGA NGALOKUFUNDZISEKILE ngemakhono akho Iphrofayili inganiketa luhlelo lolulawulwako, luhlelo loluhleliwe, luhlelo lwekucala, nobe lusito lolulinganiselwe/loluvamile. I-appID ye-Steam ichaza kutsi luhlelo lusebenta njani; akusiyo yonkhe imidlalo lekhicitwako lecinisekisiwe.
Sicelo se-SteamCMD lesicinisekisiwe sisho kutsi lephrofayili icela kufinyelela ku-akhawunti. Kuba ngumnikati walomdlalo kanye nemitsetfo yemshicileli kungenta kutsi kube netidzingo letengetiwe.
TINCWADI LETIKHETFULWE AKUSIYO Luhla Lwekuhlola lwe-Firewall Ligama leligciniwe lemphendvulo yemibuto alikhombisi kutsi kukhona umlaleli wemibuto nobe kutsi kufanele kuvulwe. Sebentisa luhlelo lwemdlalo kanye netimfuneko teluhlelo.
Ikhathalogi yindzawo yekubuka tinchazelo letifakiwe. Emarekhodi ekuhlola endzawo akhombisa loko lokwabonwa kule PC, hhayi imiphumela yendzawo yonkhe yemshini ngamunye noma inhlanganisela ye-mod.

data.name: Content.45EB10CB4237CAC4A2E5
data.value:
Vula sitfombe semagiya ku-dashboard kwentela kusetjentiswa kwato tonkhe tinhlelo. Sebentisa inkinobho ye-Configure ye-server kwentela kusetjentiswa kwe-server kuphela.
I-GENERAL • Kubonisa i-Server Console Window kulawula kutsi ema-server lasekelwako ayakhombisa yini i-console yawo. Lifasitelo lelifihlekile alisho kutsi i-server imisiwe. • I-Dark Mode ishintja luhlelo lwekusebenta. • I-SteamCMD Download Speed ikhetsa lizinga leliphelele nobe umkhawulo wekulanda losekelwako. â€¢ Kuntjintja lulwimi kusekela emalebuli e-interface, tinkhulumiswano kanye nemilayeto yesimo.
Lamanye emakhasi anetindzawo tekulondvolota kanye nekwendlulisa, tindlela tekugcina imfihlo/kuvikeleka, imibiko yetinkinga, kanye netintfo letisezingeni lelisetulu/tekusekela. Akudzingeki kutsi ukhetse tintfo letisezingeni lelisetulu kute wakhe i-server leyetayelekile.
LULWIMI LWEKUTIPhatsa Khetsa emkhatsini wetilwimi letitfolakalako. Kulawula kwe-Synix, tihloko telusito kanye nemilayeto lekhicitwa luhlelo lokusebenta kusebentisa lulwimi lolukhetsiwe. Imiyalo yemdlalo, emagugu ekwakheka, kanye nemphumela wekucala we-server awuhunyushiwe. Emafayela emarekhodi etebucwepheshe agcina imibhalo yawo yekucala yekuhlola.
Imibhalo lebhekiswe emdlalweni ayihumushiwe: imiyalo, tikhiya tekuhlela kanye nemagugu, emagama emamephu, tindlela, emagama emafayela, kucalisa imisho, tikhombi, kanye nemibhalo yekuhlola kufanele ihlale ngendlela umdlalo lofuna ngayo.
Kuntjintja lulwimi lwe-interface akukashintji i-syntax yemyalo walomdlalo nobe kugucula lokuphuma ku-console. Uma i-Synix leyetayelekile ingakahunyushwa ngalokungakalindzeleki, bika emagama ayo lacondzile, lifasitelo kanye nelulwimi lolukhetsiwe.

data.name: Content.493BAB772B40AABA8979
data.value:
Vula i-Settings → Privacy & Security ngaphambi kwekuhlanganyela sikrini nobe kubuketa tindlela tekuphepha.
I-PRIVACY MODE (indlela yekugcina imfihlo) Ema-Privacy Mode masks asekela kuboniswa kwetintfo letibucayi, letifana nemakheli kanye nemininingwane yekungena. Akashintji i-IP yakho, ayibhaleli inethiwekhi nobe ihlanta onkhe emarekhodi emdlalo kanye nemafayela ekuhlela.
Hlola sitfombe sesikrini ngaphambi kwekusendlulisela kulabanye. Sento sekukopisha enkhabeni lefihliwe singachubeka nekukopisha linani leliciniso.
EMA-PASWORD LAGciniwe KANYE NEMAKHOKENI I-Synix ivikela emaphasiwedi lagciniwe, emathokheni, kanye nemagugu e-webhook kumsebentisi we-Windows. Lomdlalo ungahle udzinge imiculu lefundzekako ngekwakheka kwawo noma ngemaphuzu ekucala.
Ikhophi yefolda leyetayelekile kulenye i-akhawunti ye-Windows ayikucinisekisi kutsi lamagugu lavikelekile angavulwa. Sebentisa i-encrypted transfer workflow kwentela kusekela kuhanjiswa kwebufakazi.
I-WINDOWS PERMISSIONS (Imvume yekungena kumafasitelo) Sebentisa i-Synix kanye nemaseva emidlalo leyetayelekile ngemvumo ye-Windows. Kuntjintja luhlelo lolutsite nobe kuvulwa kwemdlalo kungacela kuphakama ngekwehlukana; akusiso sizatfu sekuchubeka usebenta njengembusi.
Tinkinga tekuhlanta i-firewall ngekukhetsa tasekela imitsetfo ye-Synix lengasasebenti. Kubuketa imitsetfo lehlongotwako ngaphambi kwekwemukela kususa. Alikhoni kulawula onkhe emafolda lakhetsiwe nobe kuvumela kususa imitsetfo ye-firewall lengahlobene.
Nangabe imfihlo yembulwa, yetama kuyibuyisela nobe uyihoxise enhlanganweni leyikhiphe. Kufihla lenkhundla nobe kususa ikhophi lephephile ye-Synix akusiyo intfo lebangela kungasebenti kwaleligama lekusebentisa kuletinye tindzawo.

data.name: Content.5157BE079A5B48521112
data.value:
Kuvala i-window yemntfwana, kunciphisa Synix, kanye nekuphuma kuloluhlelo lokusebenta tintfo letehlukene. Hlola indlela lotiphatsa ngayo kanye netindlela tekuphuma.
KUVULA KUPHINISELA LIPHANO LEKULAWULWA I-Synix ingakwati kubona tinchubo telusito letisasebenta bese itfola bunikati bato. Vumela luhlolo lwekucala kutsi luphele ngaphambi kwekucala lolunye luhlolo.
Kukhonjwa kwenchubo kumele kuhambisane nekuhlela lokukhetsiwe, hhayi nje ligama lelatiwako le-executable. Ema-wrappers lakhetsiwe nobe tinsita letenganyelwe ngaphandle tingadzinga kunakekelwa lokwengetiwe.
TINKHONDVO LETIFUNDVWAKO Tisetjentiswa tekusebentisa i-start/background-agent tisekela kulandzelela ku-Windows. Akudzingeki kutsi bakha i-server yakho yekucala.
Umsebenti lohleliwe udzinga inchubo nobe i-ejenti ye-Synix lefanelekile, umhlangano we-Windows lokhona, kanye ne-PC lephapheme. Kucala kwekungena akusiso setsembiso sekutsi umsebenti utawuchubeka ngalesikhatsi umshini uvaliwe.
NGAPHAMBI KEKUCALA kabusha emawindi Gcwalisa ema-backup, kulayisha kanye nekwendlulisa. Vimbela imidlalo ku-Synix kute ikhone kugcina ngendlela leyetayelekile, bese uphuma noma ucala kabusha i-Windows.
Ungacabangi kutsi i-console yemdlalo lofihliwe seyimile nobe kuvala lifasitelo lekubukela kucedza lomdlalo. Hlola ideshibhodi futsi usebentise kulawula lokuhlosiwe kwendlela yekuphila.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Vula umphumela we-Readiness wale-server lekhetsiwe kute utfole imfuneko lengekho. I-runtime lefakwe ku-Synix ayitsatsi sikhundla setidzingo temdlalo.
IMilayeto ye-DLL LENGAKAKHONA Emaphutsa lakhuluma nge MSVCP140.dll nobe VCRUNTIME140.dll avame kukhomba i-Visual C++ runtime requirement. Sebentisa imiyalo yemdlalo kanye nekuhlanganisa i-Microsoft leyengetiwe.
Imininingwane ye-Microsoft lengatfulwa kabusha: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Ungakhiphi emafayela e-DLL kusuka kuma-website lakhetsiwe nobe ubeke ema-DLL langakahlobani eceleni kwe-server executable.
TINKHONDVO LETENGETU Umdlalo ungadzinga i-akhawunti, emalungelo e-server, sikhatsi sekusebenta se-Java lesitsite, sici se-Windows, nobe i-hardware lesekelwako. Gcwalisa lemibandzela ngaphambi kwekugucula emachweba langakahlangani nobe kubeka kabusha luhlelo.
Ku-Minecraft Java, sebentisa inhlanganisela ye-version/loader lesekelwe ku-Synix's selectors. I-Bedrock ayisebentisi i-Java.
Kwetfulwa lokudzinga i-Hyper-V nobe i-hardware virtualization, hlola luhlolo lwekulungela umdlalo. Ungasebentisi tintfo letisecophelweni lelisetulu nobe usebentise onkhe ema-server njengemcondzisi kute nje unciphise secwayiso.
Ngemuva kwekulungisa lesidzingo, yenta sicalo lesisha bese ubuyeketa liphutsa lekucala lelibalulekile lemdlalo uma ngabe lisahluleka.
