data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. I-Synix ivula i-Space Engineers Dedicated Server Manager lesemtsetfweni futsi ihlale ibonakala.
2. Khetsa 'Local/Console', ukhetse 'Continue to server configuration', ufake i-server kanye ne-world settings, bese ukhetsa 'Save & start'.
3. Sebentisa imenenja kwentela timo letisezingeni lelisetulu, emave, emamodeli, baphatsi, kanye nekhonsoli yekusebenta. Imininingwane yesiphakeli igcinwa ngekhatsi kwalelifolda le Synix leseva ye Instance.
4. Imodi ye-Local/Console lengenhla ayidzingi emalungelo ebasebenti. Indlela yekusebenta ye-Windows iyasebenta.
5. Lokudzingekako: .NET Framework 4.8 nobe yakamuva, Visual C++ Redistributables 2013 na 2017, lokungenani 6 GB yesistimu RAM, kanye ne UDP port 27016 leyemukelwe nge Windows Firewall futsi idluliselwe kubadlali be-Internet.
6. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.5CA69EB89BDD805145B9
data.value: Vula i-Documents\Euro Truck Simulator 2\config.cfg bese usebentisa i-g_console "1". Vala lomdlalo, bese uphindze ucofa ku-Start in Synix. I-Synix itawungenisa emafayela lakhicitwe ngekwetfu.

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Sebentisa lomhlahlandlela uma kusetjentiswa kwe-LAN kuyasebenta kodvwa luhlolo lwelikheli lemphakatsi lungasebenti.
LIKHASI LAKHO LEKUPHAKAMISELWA KWABANTFU Liyahluleka Lamanye ema-routers akawasekeli ema-NAT loopback, aphindze abitwe ngekutsi yi-hairpinning. Kuchumana lokuchamuka ngekhatsi kulendlu kuya ekhelini layo lemphakatsi kungahle kwehluleke nanobe labangephandle bangakhona kujoyina.
Sebentisa likheli le-LAN ekhaya bese ucela lotsite kulenye inethiwekhi ye-internet kutsi ahlole likheli le-public. Kwehluleka kwe-in-PC WAN probe kukodvwa akusiso siciniseko sekutsi i-internet ayisebenti.
KUHAMBISELWA KWETIKHAMBI AKUYENTI UMehluko Hlola kutsi ikhona yini lenye i-router lengetulu, i-double NAT, noma i-carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT). Catsanisa umniningwane we-WAN ye-router nelikheli le-public bese ubuta i-ISP kutsi ngabe kuchumana lokungena kuyasekelwa yini.
Umtsetfo wekuchubekisa ku-router yakho angeke ukhone kuvula i-ISP lelawulwa yi-upstream NAT. Ngekuya ngekuhlanganiswa, kusetjentiswa kwelikheli lemphakatsi, i-VPN/umhubhe lofanele, nobe iseva lebanjiwe ingadzingeka. Lena yimiculu yangaphandle, hhayi tintfo letakhelwe ku Synix.
KUPHATSISWA KWAKHO NGEKULAWULWA KWABADLALELI Kuchumana ngekusebentisa i-remote control kanye nekuchumana kwemdlali kulomdlalo kunetindlela letehlukene. Kuvumela imilayeto ye-API nobe ye-Discord ayenti kutsi umdlalo utfolakale ku-inthanethi.
Yetama kugcina luhlolo lwe-network lucondze endzaweni lengiyo kanye nemitsetfo yemdlalo. Ungatishicileli emaphasiwedi, ema-tokens, titfombe te-router, nobe imininingwane yenethiwekhi yangasese nawucela lusito.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Sebentisa i-log lenencenye leyehlulekile.
SYNIX ACTIVITY Tindlela tekusebenta I-Activity & Diagnostics ikhombisa inchubekela phambili kanye neticwayiso letihambelana nemsebentisi kudeshibhodi. Kususa lendzawo kususa imilayeto lebonakalako kuphela; akusiwo onkhe ema-diagnostics lagciniwe.
TINCWADZI TEKUSEBENTA Ema-Synix emarekhodi ematheksthi kanye nemibiko yetingoti letibulalako kuvame kutfolakala ku: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Inkhulumomphendvulwano ye-crash ingaletsa ligama lefayela letsite. Sebentisa lendlela kanye nesikhatsi sekwehluleka kutfola lokungenelela lokufanele.
Tindlela tekuhlola letisetjentisiwe tingabhalwa kuloluhla lwemibhalo ngaphandle kwekuvela kudeshibhodi. Lokwehlukile lokugciniwe lokungakabhaliswa akusibo bufakazi bekwehluleka kwekusebenta kwesicelo.
I-GAME LOGS Sebentisa i-log yemdlalo lekhetsiwe kwentela kulayisha umhlaba, kubeka, mod, kanye nemaphutsa ekugijima kwemdlalo. Indzawo yayo incike kulomdlalo futsi ingahle ibe ngaphandle kwemphandze yekuhlela.
CABANGA NGALOKUFUNDZISWA kwalendzaba Naka lokwentekile kanye nesikhatsi, bese uhlola imilayeto lemayelana nekwehluleka kwekucala. Kufinyeta umshini ekugcineni kungaba ngumphumela kunekutsi kube yimbangela yaloku.
Ngembikwekutsi wabelane nganoma nguyiphi incenye, susa emaphasiwedi, ema-tokens, ema-webhooks, emakheli langasese, kanye netindlela takho. I-console/log ye-Satisfactory ingaba neluphawu lwemlawuli. Gcina lokwatiswa kwekucala kute usebentise kuphenya kwakho.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Kubuyisela kungatfwala tintfo letisetjentiswako ku-server lekhetsiwe. Khetsa i-server lefanele bese ugcina nobe ngabe yini lensha ngaphambi kwekuchubeka.
1. Vimbela i-server bese wenta ikhophi lehlukile yemafayela lakhona longahle uwadzinge. 2. Vula i-Restore backup workflow ku-Server Options. 3. Khetsa i-archive lofuna kuyisebentisa uphindze uhlole i-server yayo, lusuku, bukhulu kanye nesimo sekuhleleka kwayo. 4. Yenta siciniseko ngaphambi kwekubuyisela. Ema-backups e-Synix lanemarisiti e-SHA-256 angacwaningiswa nalamarisiti; imibhalo lemidzala ingase ibonwe njengemlandvo. 5. Fundza lesecwayiso sekugucula bese ucinisekisa kutsi ngulena kuphela indzawo lofuna kuyibuyisela. 6. Vumela kuhlunga kanye nekuphindza kusetjentiswe kuphotfule ngaphandle kwekuvala i-Synix nobe kwehlukanisa sitolo. 7. Cala i-server futsi ucinisekise kutsi umhlaba lohlosiwe kanye netilungiselelo sekubuyiselwe.
LOKUFUNDZISWA LIKHASI Kuhlolwa kwebucotfo kutfola tingucuko letihambelana nekutfolwa. Akufakazeli kutsi live belinemphilo lenhle ngalesikhatsi lisindziswa nobe kutsi umlandvo walomunye umuntfu wetsembekile.
NAKUPHATSEKA KUDLA Gcina imiculu kanye nalamanye emafayela ekubuyisela nobe ekulungisa. Fundza lomlayeto ngaphambi kwekutsi wetame kubuyisela nobe kususa emafayela.
Ungasebentisi i-ZIP ku-server lesebentako. Uma umdlalo ugcina imiculu ngaphandle kwefolda yekuhlela, buyisa leyo miculu ngekwehlukana ngekusebentisa lenchubo leyisekelwa ngulomdlalo.
Gcina i-backup yekucala kute kube ngulapho sewuhlole i-server lebuyiselwe kanye nekuchumana kweliklayenti.

data.name: Content.74448A2C2CBD821D56C4
data.value:
I-Import Existing Server ibhalisa luhlelo lolusekelwako lesevele lukhona kudiski. Akusiko kufaka kabusha futsi kwehlukile kunekungenisa liphasela leliphelele le Synix.
NGAPHAMBI KWEKUTSATSA Yenta i-backup leyehlukile, kufaka ekhatsi nobe ngabe nguyiphi intfo loyigcinile ngaphandle kwefolda yekuhlela. Misa leseva bese ukhubaza lomunye umphatsi nobe umhleli longayicala ngesikhatsi Synix ayiphetse.
BHALISISA LIKHAMBI 1. Khetsa i-Add Server → Import Existing Server. 2. Khetsa lifolda lekufaka i-server, hhayi indlela lemfishane, lifayela le-ZIP, nobe lifolda leklayenti lemdlalo. 3. Vumela Synix ayihlole, bese ucinisekisa umdlalo lotfoliwe, luhlelo, i-executable, kanye netilungiselelo. 4. Niketa lelifomu ligama lelihlukile bese ugcwalisa nobe ngabe nguwaphi emagugu langekho. 5. Qedela kungenisa, vula i-Configure, bese ubuyeketa tindlela nemikhumbi yayo. 6. Sebentisa i-Readiness, bese wenta kucalisa lokunye lokulawulwa. Hlola kutsi lomhlaba lohlongotwako kanye nekwakheka kwalayishwa.
LOKUNTSI LOKUCHUBHUKILE Kubhalisa akuyicedzi indzawo yekuhlela, kuyilayisha kabusha, nobe kugucula emafayela ayo ekuhlela. Tinyatselo letilandzelako lotikhetsile, letifana ne-Update, Validate, nobe kulungisa kulungiswa, tingashintja emafayela.
Ema-wrappers, ema-modpacks, emaphasiwedi, kanye nemiculu yangaphandle angeke itfolwe ngalokuzenzakalelayo. Lendlela lefanako yekubekwa angeke ibhaliswe kabili.
NAKUNGABEKANAKI KUTFUNDZELWA Cinisekisa kutsi ukhetse kusetjentiswa kwe-server lekhetsiwe leyisekelwa ngulephrofayili loyikhetsile. Ungashintji ligama le-executable lengakahlobani kute ucinisekise kutsi iyahambisana. Bhala umbiko lomayelana nalomdlalo bese uhlela luhlaka lwemafolda kute kuhlolwe inchazelo yawo.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Sebentisa lomhlahlandlela uma i-configuration editor ibika kutsi kunenkambu lengekho, luhlaka lolungasebenti, nobe lithempulethi lelingalingani.
CINISEKA NGALOKU LOKUKHETFILE • Kuvuselelwa lokujwayelekile kwekulondvolota kusekela emagugu ekucamba lokhetsiwe. • Kulungisa kucatulula inkinga lebikiwe. â€¢ Kubeka kabusha kubuyisela tintfo letisetjentiswako ku-template futsi kungasusa imicondvo lebekiwe.
Kucala kabusha akusiso sinyatselo sekucala sekwehluleka kwaso sonkhe sisebenti. Kulahlekelwa sikhatsi sekusebenta kwemdlalo, emachweba langasebenti kahle, kanye nemamodeli langasebenti kahle angeke kulungiswe ngekufaka lamanye emafayili ekuhlela.
NGAPHAMBI KEKULUNGISELWA Yima lomdlalo, ugcine ikhophi lengakatsintfwa yalamafayela latsintsekile, bese ufundza ngalokuphelele loko lokuhlongotwako. Lamanye emaphrofayili anemathempulethi laphelele; Labanye balindzele kutsi lomdlalo ukhicite emafayela nawucala nobe udzinga kulungiswa ngesandla.
I-Synix ibika emathegi ladzingekako langekho kunekutsi icabange kutsi ingakhona kufaka yonkhe imigca ngekuphepha. Kusebentisa luhlelo loluphetfwe luhlelo lwekuhlela emathempulethi kungalondvolota ikhophi yesikhatsi sinye lebitwa ngekutsi .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
NGEMUVA KWEKUNGAKHULULISWA nobe KULUNGISELWA Gcina nobe ngabe nguyiphi i-backup nobe emafayela ekubuyisela bese ufundza lomlayeto wekubuyisela. Catsanisa luhlelo lwekucala naloluntjintjiwe ngaphambi kwekukhetsa kutsi yini lofuna kuyibuyisela. Ungasesuli bufakazi ngekubuyeketa.
Ngemuva kwekululama, cala kanye bese uhlola umlandvo walomdlalo. Cinisekisa kutsi ifundza indlela lengiyo nekutsi imicondvo yakho lefunekako isekhona.

data.name: Content.7776A5CA82E9769808BF

data.name: Content.780D9B8DEE8EE337F6D9
data.value: Tfumela emaphakheji e-server kusuka kumlayenti lonetintfo lotifunako. I-SCS itsi i-server lekhetsekile ayidzingi idatha ye-DLC/mod leyengetiwe; ungalayishi i-ZIP yemakhasimende leyetayelekile njenge-plugin ye-server.

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
I-Dune isebentisa luhlelo lwangaphandle lwekusebenta ngemishini lengiyo yemdlalo kanye nesimo selicembu lemphi. Akusiyo i-single-process game server leyetayelekile.
Tidzingo tekucala Kufundza Synix'Kuhlola kulungela inkhumbulo yesistimu, iAVX2, i-virtualization ye-hardware, iHyper-V, kanye ne-Professional nobe Windows lihumusho lekucala. Tidzingo tememori tiye ngelicembu lemphi kanye nemamephu lowasebentisako.
I-Synix ayikhoni kusebentisa i-virtualization noma ifake i-Hyper-V. Gcwalisa lemitfombolusito yemdlalo ngaphambi kwekutfumela.
Faka Futsi Ucale 1. Yakha i-Dune: Awakening bese uhlola tidzingo kanye nemfolda yekuhlela. 2. Gcina bese ucala. 3. I-Synix ivula lithulusi lelisemtsetfweni le-battlegroup.bat ngekuphakanyiswa kwemlawuli lokudzingwa ngulokusetjentiswa. 4. Khetsa initial-setup kuletintfo temdlalo bese utfumela i-Self-Host Token yakho. 5. Gcwalisa luhlelo lwe-VM, inethiwekhi, nelicembu lemzabalazo kulelithulusi.
Tfola i-Self-Host Token ngekusebentisa i-akhawunti ye-Funcom kusetjentiswa inchubo yekufaneleka/yekusungula: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Gcina loluphawu luyimfihlo. Kuphakanyiswa kwalelithulusi lekuniketa akusho kutsi onkhe ema-server e-Synix kufanele asebente njengemcondzisi.
I-NETWORKING KANYE NEMIKHALO YEKULAWULWA Sebentisa luhlaka lwendzawo yekubamba/lenethiwekhi ye-VM kanye netindzawo letidzingekako. I-metadata yenkambu yemibuto ku-Synix imele i-RMQ, hhayi umlaleli wemibuto ye-A2S lovamile.
Kuvalwa kwelifasitelo le-launcher akukhombisi kutsi i-VM yayo imile. Cinisekisa simo sekusebenta futsi wente imisebenti yelicembu lemphi ngekusebentisa lokulawulwa kwekusetjentiswa kwalomdlalo.
I-Synix ingafaka, ivuselele, icalise iphindze igcine lifolda lekufaka lelikhetsiwe. Ungalindzeli kutsi kucedvwa kwetinchubo letetayelekile, imibuto yemdlali, nobe kuvuselelwa kwe-watchdog kulawula ngalokuphelele kusetjentiswa kwangaphandle. Kutfunyelwa kwelifayela lekwetfulwa akukavumeleki kuloluhlobo lwemsebenti.
Sebentisa tinchubo tekuvimbela nekusekela letisekelwa ngumdlalo kwentela idatha ye-VM/database lehlala ikhona. I-ZIP yefolda yekusebentisa ayisiyo i-backup yayo lecinisekisiwe.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Lenkhulumo ilungiselelwe basebentisi labadzala kanye nebanikeli. Akudzingeki kutsi ube nemathuluzi ekutfutfukisa kute wakhe i-server kusuka ku-profile lesekelako.
INDLELA TINCAZELO LETISEBENTA ngayo Tinchazelo temidlalo leyakhelwe-ngekhatsi tichaza kulandvwa, kuchuba, Steam AppIDs kanye netidzingo tekungena ngemvume, kwetfula tintfo, emachweba, indlela yekuhlela, tidzingo kanye nemakhono e-controller.
Tinchazelo tikhetsa indlela yekuphatsa leyakhelwe ngekhatsi lesekelwako. Atikalayishi ngekushesha tintfo letisetjentiswako, ema-assembly, nobe imibhalo lelayishiwe. Kufaka lifayela le-JSON kufolda yelusito loluhleliwe akufaki iphrofayili yemdlalo lensha lehlanganisiwe.
KULUNGISA nobe KUNGETEKA KUPHROFILE 1. Cala ngeticondziso letisemtsetfweni te-dedicated-server kanye nemafayela e-configuration lakhiwe ngeliciniso. 2. Sebentisa indlela lecondzene ne-server-root lapho kudzingeka khona kanye netintfo letitfola umdlalo. 3. Faka ekhatsi emathempulethi lasekelwa ngalokuphelele etindzaweni tawo letifanele. 4. Kuvuselela tinchazelo/kulungiswa/kuguculwa kwethempulethi. 5. Kucinisekisa umtapo wetincwadzi, kwakha nge-SDK ledzingwa ngumklamo, bese wenta luhlolo lolufanele. 6. Kuvivinya kufaka, kucala, kumisa nekubuka ngemdlalo mbamba ngaphambi kwekubhalisa kucinisekiswa.
I-Definition Builder lithulusi lekutfutfukiswa nekwakhiwa, akusiso sidzingo lesijwayelekile sekusungulwa.
I-SOURCE ORGANIZATION (Kuhlelwa kwemitfombo) • UI: Emafasitelo lakhetsekile. • ServerHandler: Kulawula imidlalo nekuhlanganiswa kwemaseva. • I-SynixEngine: Umjikeleto wekuphila kwesicelo, kulondvolotwa, kuchumana, kusekela kanye nekuphepha. • Umklamo: Kusetjentiswa tintfo tekulawula letifana naleti, tihloko kanye netindlela tekuhlela. • Database/GameDefinitions: Game profiles and templates. • Database/ModSystems: Kusekelwa kwe-add-on workflows. • Kuhumusha: Tincwadzi teluhlaka kanye nemagenerator. • Kuhlola: Kuhlola lokugcile kulokucuketfwe.
Mayelana nekuhumusha, buyeketa onkhe ematheksthi elulwimi ndzawonye bese ugcina ema-placeholders. Faka ekhatsi tihloko telusito, tinchazelo tekutfola kutsi umuntfu unesifo lesitsite, ematheksthi lamayelana nekufinyeleleka kanye netinchazelo temidlalo. Ungahumushi imiyalo, tikhiya, emathokheni, emagugu ebasebentisi, nobe timphawu tekuhlola. Emarekhodi ekucala ekutfola kutsi umuntfu unesifo lesitsite awazange ashintje.
Fundza License & Proprietary Terms ngaphambi kwekusabalalisa ikhodi nobe kwakha. Gcina imiculu yangempela kanye netincwadzi tangasese ngaphandle kweminikelo netintfo letisetjentiswako.

data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Yakha luhlelo lwekunakekela i-server kuphela ngemuva kwekuhlola indlela leyetayelekile yekulondvolota, kuvuselela, kumisa, kanye nekucala.
1. Vula i-automation/schedule settings bese uvumela i-schedule. 2. Khetsa emalanga kanye nesikhatsi. 3. Vumela i-Smart Maintenance bese ukhetsa tintfo letitfolakalako tekusekela/kuvuselela. 4. Khetsa kutsi ulindze badlali bese ubeka sikhatsi lesidze. 5. Gcina uphindze uhlolisise ngesikhatsi sekulondvolota longasilawula.
Ema-schedule asebentisa sikhatsi sendzawo ye-PC. Gcina liwashi kanye nesikhatsi salo kulungile.
NALAPHO SIKHATSI SEKUKHETFWA Sikhatsi Lesibekiwe I-Synix ingalindzela badlali labachumanako, bese ihlela kumisa licembu lelicinisekisiwe lenchubo, kusekela ngalesikhatsi imisiwe, kuvuselela, kanye nekucala kabusha ngekuya kwetindlela letikhetsiwe.
Lokubambezeleka lokukhulu ngumkhawulo, hhayi setsembiso sekulindza kuze kube phakadze. Lokunakekelwa kungachubeka uma kuphelelwa sikhatsi ngisho nobe badlali basele. Kubambezeleka lokungu-zero akuniketi sikhatsi sekulindza.
Imininingwane Yemdlali Inemincele Kulindza kuya ngelwati loluniketa lomdlalo lokhetsiwe. I-server ye-API lehlanganiswe ne-Satisfactory ibukana netibalo letingasasebenti nobe letingatfolakali kahle ngesikhatsi sekulindza lesihleliwe. Loko akusho kutsi imininingwane yemibuto lengasekelwa kahle yetsembekile.
Tjela badlali kusenesikhatsi uphindze ufundze imilayeto yemisebenti levelako. Tindzaba tekwatisa te-Discord tingabika ngetigameko tekugcinwa kwetintfo letisekelwako uma tindlela tato tihlelekile.
I-PC kumele ivuke futsi inchubo ye-Synix lefanele nobe i-ejenti lengemuva kumele isebente. Ikhompyutha levaliwe nobe lengasebenti kahle angeke ikhone kukhipha nekucalisa kabusha tintfo ngendlela lefanele.

data.name: Content.8579FAD0312C27797E9E
data.value:
Vula i-terminal Windows nobe i-terminal PowerShell bese usebentisa le-identifier yephakeji lengentasi. Lemiyalo icondzisa i-Synix, hhayi emaseva emdlalo ngamunye.
Kufaka winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
HLOLA LIPHAKATSI LELIFAKELWE winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
KUSHAKASHISWA Vala i-Synix bese ucedza kusebenta kwayo ngaphambi kwekusebentisa: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
KUSUKA Lokusetjentiswa winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Gcina Imininingwane Yakho Kufakwa kweseva, kugcinwa kanye nekugcinwa kwe-backup kuhlukile kuloluhlelo lwekusebenta. Ungasusi i-C:\Synix nobe leminye imiculu yemininingwane ngaphandle nangabe ufuna kuyisusa.
Nangabe Umyalo Wehluleka Fundza sizatfu lesibhaliwe saloko. Uma i-WinGet ibika kungalingani kwe-hash yemfaki, yimisa bese uyibika; ungalubeki eceleni luhlolo lwe-hash. Lokutfutfukiswa lokushodako kungasho kutsi indzawo yekugcina ayikashicileli liphasela lelisha.
Kuvumeleka kwe-WinGet kanye ne-hash lelandzelanako yekulayisha akubeki luphawu lwe-Synix nobe kucinisekise kutsi i-software ye-Windows yetekuphepha itayetsemba.

data.name: Content.884F40B2519DA77E3B97
data.value: Ema-plugins e-JAR nobe ema-mods lakhetsiwe ku-server loader kanye nemafolda lasevele akhona kudiski.

data.name: Content.8924C1F5DB78640C6A6B
data.value: I-SourceMod iyachubeka nekusekela umdlalo noma injini. Sebentisa luhlelo loluphelele lwekulayisha loluhambisana nemdlalo/lihumusho; hlola lifolda lemdlalo ngaphambi kwekungenisa ema-plugins.

data.name: Content.8955D3CDE85E433AAE7F
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Cala i-server initialization batch script kanye kute wakhe i-configuration ini file, bese uyayivala.
2. Hlela i-INI leyakhiwe ngekhatsi kwefolda yakho ye-server ye-Zomboid kwentela kusungula kukhetfwa kwetindlu letiphephile, emaphasiwedi laphetse, kanye netindlela temamephu.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Dedicated_Server

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Kwekucala khombisa kutsi lomdlalo uyasebenta kunethiwekhi yakho. Kuntjintja i-router angeke kulungise umdlalo longazange ucale nobe ucedzele kusetjentiswa kwawo.
Khetsa INDLELA LEKULUNGILE • Ku-PC leseva: Sebentisa luhlelo lwasendzaweni lolusekelwa ngulomdlalo nobe luhlelo lwekubuyela emuva. • Kulenye i-home-network device: Sebentisa likheli le-LAN le-PC leseva. • Ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi yakho yasekhaya: Sebentisa likheli lakho lelisetjentiswako nobe indlela yekutfola/kujoyina leyemukelekako kulomdlalo.
Vula i-Connection Information yendlela lekhetsiwe kwentela kuhlola emaphuzu ayo ekugcina. Lamakheli e-LAN langasese angeke asetjentiswe ngulabadlala i-internet.
KUHLOBANGA NGEKWENDZA KUNYE 1. Linda lomdlalo kutsi ucedzele kulayisha. 2. Hlola i-port lelungisiwe kanye nemiphumela yekulungela kweseva. 3. Hlanganisa kusuka ku-PC yakho, bese usebentisa lenye i-LAN. 4. Uma kungaphumeleli kufinyelela ku-LAN, hlola i-log yemdlalo kanye ne-Windows ye-Firewall yekufinyelela ku-server lekhona.
VUMELA BADLALI BE-INTERNET 1. Nika umnikati welikhaya likheli le-LAN lelicinile, lelivame kuba ne-DHCP ye-router. 2. Tfola emachweba ladzingekako kanye netinchubo te-TCP/UDP tekwakheka kwemdlalo. 3. Tfumela kuphela lawo maphuzu endzawo kulelikheli le-LAN lemnikati. 4. Vumela i-traffic yemdlalo lofanako kutsi ingene ku Windows Firewall kumaphrofayili wenethiwekhi lowasebentisako. 5. Kuhlola ngekusebentisa i-internet leyehlukile.
Ungayivumeli i-DMZ ye-router, ungayivimbeli i-firewall, nobe uvete tonkhe tikhungo tekuphatsa njengendlela yekulungisa jikelele. Gcina imininingwane ye-router iyimfihlo.
Synix ngumlawuli wendzawo wedeskithophu. Akukafaki i-web panel lesetjentiswako nobe i-public relay leyenta letidzingo telucingo tibe tingasekho.

data.name: Content.89EEC15B97BFDEED3C10
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Hlela 'server-settings.json' ufake imininingwane yakho ye-Factorio lesemtsetfweni kanye ne-token yemsebentisi kwentela kutsi luhlu lwebantfu lubonakale.
2. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://wiki.factorio.com/Multiplayer#Server_settings

data.name: Content.8A54B9CD24C7B493D832
data.value:
MINECRAFT EULA INCWADZI YEMSEBENTI LOFUNekako:
Ngekucalisa le-server, uyavumelana ne-Minecraft End User License Agreement (EULA).
Uma ungavumelani nalemibandzela, cofa ku-Decline bese i-server angeke icale.
Umculu losemtsetfweni EULA: https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA

data.name: Content.8AC09A4C2AD24AD74A8A
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Cala i-server kanye kute utfole luhlelo lwekuhlela, bese uyayivala.
2. Hlela emafayili ekuhlela lakhicitwako kwentela kugucula indlela yekukhetsa emabalave.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://themeangreens.com/

data.name: Content.8AEFC5E9182C6069EB41
data.value: Tindlela tekusebenta kanye netindlela te API tinhlelo letehlukene. Imibono idzinga lifolda layo leliphelele kanye nekukhetfwa kwekulondvolota; I-Workshop blueprints ayisiyo indlela yekusebenta ye-API.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
I-SteamCMD ilanda iphindze ivuselele emafayili e-server labekiwe etinhlelo temidlalo ye-Steam. i-Synix ilungisa ikhophi yayo lehlanganisiwe ngekutitsandzela; i-server leyetayelekile ayidzingi i-tab ye-SteamCMD leyehlukile.
LANDZETELA LOKUSEBENTIWE Khetsa i-server bese ufundza i-Activity & Diagnostics. I-animation ye-dashboard ikhombisa kutsi umsebenti wekuhlela uyachubeka. I-SteamCMD ingashintja emkhatsini wekutfola, kuniketa, kukhipha, nekucinisekisa, ngako-ke kuphuma kwayo akuhlali kuniketa liphesenthi lelicinile nobe sikhatsi lesitsembekile lesisele.
Vumela kusebenta kwediski kutsi kuphele ngisho nobe i-network traffic inciphile. Fundza umlayeto wekugcina wekuphumelela nobe kwehluleka ngaphambi kwekucala lomunye umsebenti.
KUKHULULULWA KWAKHO KWEKULINDZISELA Vula i-Settings → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Khetsa imodi lecinile lesekelwako bese ufaka lizinga lelikhonjisiwe, nobe ukhetse lizinga leliphelele.
Loku kutsintsa lokulandziwe kwe-SteamCMD, hhayi i-bandwidth yemdlali, nobe ngumuphi umdlalo longekho ku-Steam, nobe lonkhe luhambo lwe-PC.
Kubhalisa nekwehluleka Lamanye emaphrofayili emdlalo adzinga i-akhawunti ye-Steam legunyatwe kanye nekucinisekiswa kwe-Steam Guard. Sebentisa i-sign-in prompt ye-Synix; ungabeki imininingwane yekungena ku-akhawunti etincwadzini nobe emibikweni lesemtsetfweni.
Uma ungakhoni kukhuphula, fundza liphutsa le-SteamCMD bese uhlola sikhala sediski, kufinyelela kumafolda, kufinyelela kunethiwekhi, kanye nalokunye lokudzingekako. Kucinisekisa kungalayisha kabusha emafayela laphetfwe ngulomfaki, ngako-ke gcina tingucuko takho ngaphambi kwekusebentisa.

data.name: Content.8B7975E13D85AB64E0E6
data.value: I-plugin_list_file leyakhiwe (i-default default_plugins.txt) ikhetsa ema-plugins e-AngelScript. Kukopisha imibhalo akuyifaki kuloluhlu; gcina emafayela emakhadi/ema-script futsi ahambisane ne-server version.

data.name: Content.8CA9126D6BF48BF6086B
data.value: Emaphakheji aya ku-directory ye-server's Packages kanye nemafayela e-Server, Client kanye ne-Shared. Index.lua kanye nekwakheka kwephakeji kuncuma kugcwala; khetsa emaphakheji lavumelekile ekucwangcisweni kwe server.

data.name: Content.8DC42817CC9996AD9D0D
data.value: Sebentisa i-ResourceFolder leyakhiwe. Server/<PluginName> idzinga i-top-level .lua script; Iklayenti igcina i-mod .zip ngayinye ingashintji. Emabalave lakhetsiwe nawo adzinga kulungiswa kweMephu.

data.name: Content.8E051A96DCEBC9E7BC17
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Kwetfula i-server kanye kwentela kwakha 'Game.ini', bese uyayivala.
2. Hlela lelifayili kute uhlele tinchubo tekutfutfukisa isayensi kanye nemagugu e server.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://playfragmented.com/

data.name: Content.8E8134125525EEA00760
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Kumele utfole i-cluster token ku-Klei bese uyinamatsisela ku-'cluster.ini'.
2. Cala i-server kanye kute ukhiphe luhlaka lwetitemplate, uvale bese ulungisa tikhungo ngaphambi kwekwetfulwa kwasobala.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://dontstarve.wiki.gg/wiki/Guides/A_Guide_to_Setting_Up_a_Dedicated_Server

data.name: Content.8EBA131441C4B2AE1004
data.value: Windows dedicated-server mods idzinga i-server-compatible Info.json, emafayela ku-Workshop leyakhetsiwe, kanye netintfo te-PackageName plus bGlobalEnableMod ku-Mods/PalModSettings.ini. I--workshopdir ibeka eceleni indlela bese i--NoMods ikhubaza ema-mods. Umdlalo usebentisa imitsetfo yekufaka; I-Synix ayisebentisi imiyalo yephakeji.

data.name: Content.8ECE8DD544FB94964ED9
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Cala i-server kanye kute ukhiphe 'server_cfg.ini', bese uyayivala.
2. Yakha kukhetfwa kwetingoma, imitsetfo yekusita, kanye neluhlu lwekungena ngekhatsi kwelifayela le-ini.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://www.assettocorsa.net/

data.name: Content.8F09934467ACD2C4EE0D
data.value: Ema-ID e-Workshop aya ku-WorkshopDownloadConfig.json yalendzaba. Rocket/LDM ne-OpenMod tiyimiculu leyehlukene ye-plugin ngaphansi kwe-Modules; Tindlela te-plugin ticondzene ne-server ngayinye. I-DLL ye-plugin ayisiyo intfo ye-Workshop.

data.name: Content.8F13D2A8F3FB3EEBDB40
data.value: Siyakwemukela ku Synix Engine Knowledge Base. Khetsa sihloko kuloluhla lwekufundza kute ucale.

data.name: Content.90BE6DA54C138D083F44
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Sebentisa i-server kanye ku-provision 'ROGame.ini', bese uyayicisha.
2. Yakha imicondvo ye-realism kanye nemitsetfo yekugucula emabalave ngekhatsi kwelifayela le INI.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://tripwireinteractive.atlassian.net/

data.value: Kudzinga luhlelo lwe Metamod:Source kanye ne SourceMod loluhambisana naloluhlobo lweseva. Ema-plugins e .smx lahlanganisiwe aya ku-dinodday/addons/sourcemod/plugins; Kuhumusha lokuhambisanako, i-gamedata kanye nekwandzisa kugcina emafolda abo labhaliwe.

data.value: Kudzinga luhlelo lwe Metamod:Source kanye ne SourceMod loluhambisana naloluhlobo lweseva. Ema-plugins .smx lahlanganisiwe aya ku-zps/addons/sourcemod/plugins; Kuhumusha lokuhambisanako, i-gamedata kanye nekwandzisa kugcina emafolda abo labhaliwe.

data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:

data.name: Content.945BA61438ECCD5DE0B0
data.value: Sebentisa iphakethe ye-LaunchPad ye-server lekhetsekile kanye ne-BepInEx lehambisanako. Khipha i-mod leyakhiwe kusuka ku-LaunchPad kute i-mods ne-modconfig.xml tihlale ndzawonye; ungayikopishi i-client loader ku-server.

data.name: Content.9562ED8E932C48484060
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Sebentisa i-server kanye kwentela kwakha i-database yekucala, bese uyayicisha.
2. Hlela tikripthi takho tekuhlela kute uchaze tintfo letigucukako telwati kanye nemitsetfo yemdlali.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://miscreated.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_Server

data.name: Content.9874202F0A53F482F5E6
data.value: Ema-server lakhetsiwe asekela kubhalwa kwemibhalo kanye nemamephu. Sebentisa luhlelo lwekubhala kanye netimvume telusito loluhambisanako; Imidvwebo yelikhasimende yehlukile kunemibhalo yeserver.

data.name: Content.9993A00BC2F8CF44B394
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Veta i-server ngalokuphelele ekucaleni kwayo, uyivale bese ulungisa tikhungo te-server yakho!
2. Gucula 'Game.ini' kute usungule imiculu yekusebenta kanye nemikhawulo yemdlalo.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://theisle.wiki.gg/wiki/Server_Hosting

data.name: Content.9A49DE43F45C43C2D5A1
data.value: Kudzinga i-SML lehambisanako kanye nekwakhiwa kwe-server lekhetsekile yema-mods kanye nalokuncike kuwo. Emaphakethe laphelele asebentisa iFactoryGame/Mods. Emaphakethe e-client-only angeke asebente; kumele kuhlolwe kutsi i-mod isekela luhlelo lweseva.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Tindlela tekusebentisa i-Empyrion kanye nekushintja kwendlela yekusebentisa i-server yehlukile. Ku-Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, khetsa Empyrion scenarios noma Empyrion server mods. Vimba i-server bese ugcina i-backup lephelele ngaphambi kwekwenta tingucuko.
Faka SENARIO 1. Kuvula i-Browse Catalog kuya ku-Steam Workshop. Bhalisa kulomdlalo bese ulindza kutsi Steam acedzele kuwutfola. I-Workshop blueprints kanye ne-collections akusiyo i-server scenarios. 2. Khetsa i-Import Package, bese ukhetsa i-Folder. Khetsa lifolda lelikhetsiwe le-scenario ngekhatsi kwe-library yakho ye-Steam's steamapps\workshop\content\383120. Ungaphindze ukhetse indlela lephelele ye-ZIP. 3. Faka ligama lelifolda lelikhonakalako. Ungasebentisi inombolo ye-Workshop ID kuphela. Gcina leligama lalelifolda kute utitfole esikhatsini lesitako. 4. Bukisisa luhlolo lwephakeji kanye nendzawo, bese ucinisekisa kungenisa. I-Synix ilandzisa yonkhe indzaba ibe yi-Content\Scenarios ngaphandle kwekuyisebentisa nobe kugucula umhlaba. 5. Khetsa Scenario kute utfole luhla lwetintfo letisetjentiswako. Khetsa yinye bese ubuka leligama lelihlukile lekugcina. Kuntjintja kulesinye simo kudzinga ligama lelisha, lelingakasetjentiswa; I-Synix ikhombisa yinye futsi ishiya imiculu lekhona ingakatsintfwa. 6. Sebentisa lolokukhetsiwe, cala i-server, bese uhlola i-log yayo kanye nekuchumana kweliklayenti. Letinye tindlela tekusebenta tinetintfo letengetiwe nobe tidzingo letibhalwe ngumdali wato.
Ligama lesimo selitulu ngu-GameConfig.CustomScenario; ligama lemhlaba logciniwe ngu GameConfig.GameName. I-Synix igcina i-dedicated.yaml ngaphambi kwekugucula letindzawo bese igcina kungena kweseva kuyalingana. Akusiti ku-seed, kumaphasiwedi, nobe kuletinye tintfo letingahlobene naloku.
Faka Tindlela te-Server Sebentisa i-Empyrion server mods profile kanye ne-Import Package kute ukhetse i-ZIP ye-mod lehlanganisiwe noma ugcwalise ifolda ye-mod. Faka ekhatsi ema-DLL ayo, tintfo letisekelako, lokuncike kuto, kanye ne-_Info.yaml uma kuniketwa. i-Synix ifaka loku ngaphansi kwe-Content\Mods; lomdlalo ulayisha lelikhodi nawucala. Kukhishwa kwemakhodi emtfombo kanye netintfo tekuhlela letitimele akusiwo emaphakethe lasekelwako.
I-Synix ayifaki i-mod loader nobe yente i-mod lekhubatekile kutsi isebente. Landzela tidzingo tembhali, kufaka ekhatsi nobe ngabe nguyiphi imilayeto leyengetiwe, luhlelo, kanye nekulungiselelwa kweliklayenti. Kungenisa ngekuphumelelako akukhombisi kutsi i-mod iyahambisana nemdlalo nobe leminye i-mods lefakiwe.
TINCWADZI NEKUBUYISELWA I-Steam ivuselela ikhophi yayo ye-Workshop, hhayi ikhophi ye-server leletfwe yi-Synix. Kuvuselela, yekela i-server bese ungenisa liphasela lelisha ngekusebentisa leligama lelifolda lelifanako. Hlola kutsi umbhali udzinga kusindzisa lokusha yini. Emafayela labuyiselwe emuva atfola emakhophi; Kungenisa luhlelo lolusha akusiko kufaka kabusha lokuhlantekile futsi akususi emafayela langekho kulephakheji lensha.
Kuvuselela luhlu lwemaphakheji laphelele kunemagugu lahlukene. Kufakwa (hhayi kucinisekiswa kabusha) kusho kutsi lokungeniswa kwabhalwa, hhayi kutsi onkhe emafayela lafakiwe asandza kuhlolwa futsi. Roll Back Import ibuyisela emuva lonkhe luhlelo lolukhetsiwe, kufaka ekhatsi lamanye ema-mod kuphakheji yinye, futsi ayivumi kufaka emafayela laguculwe ngaphandle kwe Synix. Imiculu lekhetsiwe kanye nemitfombolusito yemiculu ledzingwa yimikhakha lephephile iyavikeleka ekususweni; i-scenario update lebhalisiwe ingahle ibuyiselwe emuva kumafayili ayo lendzala.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Vula i-Configure → Network & RCON kute ubuke emaphuzu lasekelwa ngumdlalo lokhetsiwe. Sebentisa luhlelo lwangempela lwemdlalo, hhayi luhlu lwema-port.
I-PORT ROLES • I-Game port: i-Player traffic. â€¢ Umlayeto wekuphenya: umlayeto we-server nobe kutfola, uma leyo ndlela yekuphenya isekelwa. • RCON/admin port: Indlela yekuphatsa lengakhetsi. • I-App/API port: i-game-specific companion nobe i-management service.
I-TCP ne-UDP tinchubo letehlukene. Tindlela tekuchumana letimbili letehlukene tingasebentisa inombolo lefanako yemchudzelwano, kepha emaseva lamabili angeke abelane ngendzawo yekugcina yekulalela lengavumelani. I-Synix iphindze ihlolisise emaphrofayili lagciniwe etinkingeni tekungena, kufaka ekhatsi imibhalo lemisiwe.
Gcina emaphetselweni lakhetsiwe kutsi abe ngulawo lacondzene netimo letehlukene futsi ugcine nobe ngabe ngubuphi budlelwane lobudzingeka emdlalweni emkhatsini wematheku. Ungacabangi kutsi konkhe lokwentekako kungema-UDP nobe kutsi yonkhe inkambu yemibuto imelela umlaleli mbamba.
I-ADMINISTRATION AKUSIYO INDLELA YEKUDLULWA Badlali bavame kungadzingi kufinyelela ku RCON nobe kulenye indzawo yekugcina. Gcina lokunakekelwa kusendzaweni yakho ngaphandle nangabe uneluhlelo lolutsite lwekuphatsa lelikhashane loluvikelekile.
TINKHOMBO LETIKHONA EMIDLALWENI • Minecraft Java kanye ne-Bedrock tisebentisa indlela leyehlukile yekusebentisana; Landzela luhlelo lolukhetsiwe. i-Satisfactory yendzawo ye-API isebentisa umdlalo wayo lowakhiwe/i-API port; linani lemkhakha wemibuto lendzala alidzingeki kakhulu ku-Synix. • I-metadata yemibuto ye-Dune imele i-RMQ yayo yekusebentisa i-port, hhayi i-Steam A2S yemibuto leyetayelekile. • I-Rust+ isebentisa i-endpoint yayo lengumngani ngetulu kwekudlala.
Tintfo letisetjentiswako talethempulethi tibaluleko tekucala, hhayi luhlu lwekuhlola lwekuvula i-router. Hlola umlaleli mbamba ngaphambi kwekugucula umtsetfo we-firewall.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: I-Dune: Awakening isebentisa luhlelo lolusemtsetfweni lwekusetjentiswa kwemaseva. I-Hyper-V kanye ne-virtualization ye-hardware kumele kuvunyelwe, futsi i-Windows Pro nobe i-Enterprise iyadzingeka. Ekucaleni, i-Synix itawucala i-battlegroup.bat njengeMcondzisi. Khetsa initial-setup bese ulungisa i-Self-Host Token yakho. I-Synix ingafaka, ivuselele, igcine, iphindze icalise kusetjentiswa kwayo, kepha lomdlalo ungumnikati wemishini lengiyo kanye nesimo sayo sekusebenta. Umhlahlandlela losemtsetfweni: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.9E528B000363941C0E87
data.value: I-standard Java kanye ne-Bedrock server configuration ayinayo i-join-password setting. Sebentisa luhlu lwema-allowlist alomdlalo kanye nekucinisekiswa kwe-akhawunti. Ema-plugin emagama langasebenti anetimiso tawo.

data.name: Content.9FAB98E175C2FE8C4157
data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Kwetfula i-server kanye ku 'GameUserSettings.ini', bese uyayivala.
2. Hlela lifayela lekusungula kute ulungise imincele yelicembu, emakhodi e-admin nemitsetfo yeserver.
3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://mythofempires.wiki.gg/wiki/Server_Hosting

data.name: Content.A01279D2A6BC5DE946B6
data.value: Kudzinga luhlelo lwe Metamod:Source kanye ne SourceMod loluhambisana naloluhlobo lweseva. Ema-plugins .smx lahlanganisiwe aya ku-esmod/addons/sourcemod/plugins; Kuhumusha lokuhambisanako, i-gamedata kanye nekwandzisa kugcina emafolda abo labhaliwe.

data.value:
KUSETFULWA KWAKHULU KUYADZINGEKA:
1. Sebentisa i-server kanye kute ukhicite 'AstroServerSettings.ini', bese uyayicisha.

3. Imibhalo lesemtsetfweni: https://astroneer.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_Server

data.name: Content.A0BE3CC015AB6F92EA19

data.name: Content.A0F428891E8BA19A8524

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
Ema-webhook e-Discord atfumela imicimbi lekhetsiwe leseva kusiteshi. Tiyimibiko, hhayi i-Discord bot yekulawula i-Synix kusuka khashane.
Khetsa LIKHASI LOTAWUYA KULONA 1. Yakha nobe utfole i-webhook yesiteshi loligunya lekusiphatsa. 2. Vula likhasi lelikhetsiwe le-Configure → Discord. 3. Faka i-webhook bese ukhetsa tintfo letitfolakalako tekuhambisa umcimbi. 4. Gcina lokulungiselelwa. 5. Sebentisa indlela yekuhlola uma uniketwa, nobe ucinisekise kuniketwa ngesikhatsi semcimbi lohlongotwako.
Kucala, kuvala, kuvuselela, kusekela, nekugcina imilayeto kuya ngetindlela letivumelekile nekutsi ngabe lomsebenti wentekile mbamba yini.
Vikela i-URL I-webhook URL icuketse imiculu yekubhala. Nobe ngabe ngubani loyitfolako angakhona kutfumela imilayeto kulolucingo. Yigcine ngaphandle kwetitfombe letibonwako, tinkinga, imibhalo, kanye netingcoco.
I-Synix ivikela i-webhook yayo legciniwe kumsebentisi we-Windows. Uma i-URL ibonakala, yijikise nobe uyisuse ku-Discord, bese uvuselela indzawo yekuya ku-Synix. Bukisisa emagama e-server nemininingwane yetehlakalo letitfunyelwe kusiteshi lesihlanganisiwe.
NAKUBE IMILAYELELO YEMSEBENTI YAKHO INGAFIKELI Hlola indlela yemcimbi lokhetsiwe, i-URL, kutfolakala kwesiteshi/i-webhook, nekutsi ngabe i-PC ingafinyelela ku-Discord. Hlola liphutsa lelibikiwe ngaphandle kwekushicilela i-URL lephelele.
Kubika kusebentisa kuchumana lokuya e-Discord. Akudzingeki kutsi bavule i-inbound router control port.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Khetsa kutsi ufuna kususa i-control panel kuphela nobe kususa nemaseva akho ngalokuphelele. Lena yimisebenti leyehlukene.
Susa KUPHELA LE-APPLICATION 1. Cedza kufaka, kuntjintja nobe kusekela lokuchubekako. 2. Vimbela emaseva akho ku-Synix, ulindze kutsi acedzele kugcina bese uphuma ku-Synix. 3. Gcina ikhophi lecinisekisiwe yemhlaba lobalulekile, emafayela ekuhlela kanye nemininingwane yekungena. 4. Khipha i-Synix ku-Windows Installed apps nobe ku-package manager yakho.
Gcina i-C:\Synix, emafolda e-server lakhetsiwe, umdlalo wangaphandle logciniwe, netindzawo tekusekela nangabe ufuna kuphindze uwasebentise. Kufaka kabusha loluhlelo lokusebenta akudzingi kususa lamafolda.
Susa KUPHELA LIKHASI LELINYE LEKUSEBENTI Sebentisa lesento sekususa se-server lekhetsiwe ku-Synix bese ufundza siciniseko. Kususa intfo lebhalwe ku-dashboard akufanani nekwemukela kususa emafayela ekufaka nobe ema-backups. Cinisekisa kahle kutsi nguyiphi idatha letawususwa.
Ungasebentisi kususa njengendlela yekulungisa tinkinga. I-backup legcinwe kuphela ku-folder loyisusako akusiyo ikhophi yekubuyisela.
Uma utsintshela kulenye iphaneli yekulawula, cinisekisa kutsi ingacala luhlelo lolungilo kanye nekulayisha umhlaba lohlosiwe ngaphambi kwekususa idatha yakho lendzala.

data.name: Content.B4F7813ACC4371C7ADEF
data.value:
Khetsa sihloko lesisekudla kute ufundze ticondziso taso. Tonkhe tihloko telusito tisebenta ngaphandle kwe-internet ngelulwimi lolukhetsile.
Usemusha ku-SYNIX? Vula i-First-Time Setup Guide ku Kucala nekusungula.
KUPHATSISELA i-server? Khetsa sigaba salomsebenti, kufana nekwakheka, kuchumana, kubhekhaphu, nobe kulawula lokutsite kwemdlalo.
KUFUNDZA emaphutsa? Cindzetela Ctrl+F bese ufuna incenye letsite, umdlalo nobe incenye lemfishane yemlayeto. Kusesha kuhlola tihloko tematheksthi kanye nemibhalo lephelele bese kuveta umbhalo lofanako.
Sebentisa inkinobho yekusesha kute ubuyele kuto tonkhe tihloko. Emakheli ekulandzela nekwesekela avulwa kusiphequluli sakho kuphela nawukhetsa wona.

data.name: Content.B6FC67DB36AEA1C2C9E1
data.value: I-ATLAS idzinga i-server grid lehanjiswako kanye ne-Redis database yayo ngaphambi kwekutsi i-ShooterGameServer.exe icale. I-Synix itawuvala kucalisa kuze kufike i-ShooterGame\ServerGrid.json ne-ShooterGame\ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json. Yakha legridi nge Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor lesemtsetfweni, faka lamafayela ku ShooterGame, bese ucala AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat ngaphambi kwekucala i-ATLAS server. I-Redis kumele ihlale ku-127.0.0.1 bese kutsi ichweba le-6379 lingakhishelwa ku-Internet.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Khetsa i-server bese usebentisa emathuluzi ayo ekuhlola kuchumana nobe ema-player uma akhona. I-Synix ikhetsa ema-checks ngekulandzela i-query lesekelwa ngumdlalo, i-TCP/i-UDP/i-HTTP, i-API yendzawo, kanye nemakhono enchubo.
LOKUFUNDZISWA YIMIPHUMELA Imphendvulo yekuhlanganisa lokusezingeni leliphansi ayikhombisi kutsi umdlali angacinisekiswa futsi ahlanganyele. Inchubo lephilako ayikhombisi kutsi umsebenti wayo wekuphenya ulungile.
Kubalwa kwebadlali kanye nemagama ebadlali tintfo letehlukene. I-server ingabika kutsi bangakhi badlali labachumanisiwe ngaphandle kwekubonisa ligama lebalingisi. Kubakhona kwebantfu labangekho eluhlwini lwebadlali akusho kutsi kute labadlalako.
Emathulusi lafihlekile KANYE N/A Letinye tinhlobo te-EOS-kuphela nobe i-crossplay atikhombisi luhlolo lolutsembekile lolusekelwako nobe indlela yekulawula badlali. I-Synix ingakhombisa i-N/A nobe ingafaki luhlolo esikhundleni sekukhombisa umphumela lolahlekisako.
Hlola luhlelo lolukhetsiwe kanye nesiteshi sekuphatsa lesakhiwe se-Minecraft. Kubalwa kwebadlali be-Satisfactory kuncike kulokuchumana kwe-API. Ungacali wente tintfo te-EOS letentelwe bantfu labatfutfukisako kute ucinise luhlolo lwakho.
TINCWADZI TEMSEBENTI-TINKHULULO Imidlalo leminyenti ye-Steam isebentisa imibuto ye-A2S, kepha loku akusiyo yonkhe indzawo. Kubhalisa, kulungiswa kwemdlalo kanye nekusebentisa i-browser kunemtselela ekubonakaleni, futsi kute sicinisekiso sekutsi utawufika nini kuloluhla.
Nangabe i-server ingekho ku-browser, hlola indlela yekuhlanganisa lecondzile yalomdlalo bese uhlola luhlelo lwayo. Kuntjintja emachweba emibuto lengakahlobani kungaletsa tinkinga letengetiwe.

Ngemuva kwekuvuselelwa noma kucinisekiswa kwe-Rust, i-Synix iphindze isebentise sikhatsi sekusebenta lesisemtsetfweni se-Oxide ngaphambi kwekucala kweseva.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Sebentisa i-Configure kutinkambu letivamile letilawulwa yi-Synix. Sebentisa i-configuration-file editor ku-Server Options uma ufuna kuhlola nobe kugucula luhlelo lwemdlalo.
1. Misa i-server uma ifundza lelifayela nawucala nobe uyibhala kabusha ngesikhatsi isasebenta. 2. Yenta i-backup bese ucinisekisa i-server nelifayela lelikhetsiwe. 3. Fundza linani lelikhona kanye nemibono. 4. Gucula kuphela lokulungiselelwa lofuna kukugucula. 5. Lungisa emaphutsa alomhleli bese uhlola tecwayiso takhe. 6. Gcina, vula i-server nge-Synix, bese uhlola log yekugcina yemdlalo.
TINKHUMBULO LETISEKELWE I-Synix iniketa kusetjentiswa kwe-format-aware ku-INI/property, JSON, XML, YAML kanye nalamanye emafomethi lacondzene ne-profile. Akusiwo onkhe emafayela nobe tinchubo letinemhleli lolawulwayo. Kuhlela kwe YAML kuyasekela kusetjentiswa kwetintfo letihlanganisiwe, luhlu lolunemigca, kanye nemigca yemugca munye. Tintfo letiyinkimbinkimbi te YAML letifana nema anchors, ema aliases, inline collections kanye nemigca leminyenti ayemukelwa ngaphandle kwekulondvolota.
Gcina imiculu yekuhlela, emagugu lasemukelekile, emagama emamephu kanye nemiyalo ngendlela lengiyo njengobe umdlalo ulindzele. Ungawahumushi kutsi ahambisane nelulwimi lolusetjentiswako.
KUKHONTIWA AKUSIKHO KUvivinywa Kwemdlalo Lifayela lelakhiwe kahle lingahle libe netintfo letingahambelani. Ema-Mods nobe ema-updates emdlalo angangeta tintfo umhleli langatati. Hlola kutsi lomdlalo ulayishe lelifayili lelifunekako kanye nemhlaba ngemuva kwekucala kabusha.
Nangabe lomunye umhleli nobe umdlalo ushintja lelifayela ngalesikhatsi livulekile, layisha futsi ucatsanise ngaphambi kwekulondvolota. Emafayela emdlalo angaba nemaphasiwedi nobe emathokheni lafundzekako; tibukisise bese tiyalungiswa ngaphambi kwekutihambisa.
SatisfactoryUphilile API i-Control Center yayo futsi ayihambisani nekuhlela emafayela ayo ekucamba kudiski.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Khetsa i-Configure for an existing server, nobe usebentise lifasitelo lekusungula nawusakha. Gucula kuphela tindzawo letisebenta kulomdlalo wakho.
TINDLELA LETIFUNDVWAKO KUSEKUCALENI NEKUCINISEKILE Imodi yekucala igcizelela tintfo letivamile kanye nemyalo wekusebentisa. I-Advanced mode iveta lolunye luhlelo lwekucondzisa, kufaka ekhatsi RCON leyasekelwa kanye netindlela tekwetfulwa. Kushintja kwendlela yekusebenta akucishi emagugu lagciniwe. Tinkhombandlela te-Discord tiyatfolakala kunobe ngutiphi tindlela.
LOKUFUNDZISWA LIKHASI NGALELINYE • Jikelele: Ligama leseva, umdlalo, luhlelo/lihumusho, kanye nekukhetsa i-gameplay-profile. • Kuvikeleka: Emaphasiwedi naletinye tindlela tekungena letisekelwa ngulelithempulethi. • Kukhicitwa Kwemhlaba: Ligama lemhlaba, inhlanyelo, bukhulu kanye netindlela letingasetjentiswa. • Inethiwekhi & RCON: Kusekelwa kwekudlala, imibuto, umngani/API, kanye netintfo tekuphatsa. â€¢ Kusetjentiswa kwemishini: Kwenta i-backup/kuvuselela ngesikhatsi sekucala nekulungisa lokuhleliwe. • Discord: Tindzawo tekwatisa kanye nekuhambisa tintfo. • Install & Launch: Ifolda yekuhlela kanye netindlela tekusungula letisekelwa.
Tintfo letitsite temdlalo letivaliwe ngetinhloso. Umdlalo ungaba nawo lowo mbono noma ungabi nekusekelwa kwawo; Kuphocelela tintfo letengetiwe kulomyalo akusiyo indlela lephephile.
TINKHOLO LETINE Imininingwane yesiphakeli → Imibandzela ledzingekako → Buyekeza → Gcina isiphakeli
Lokulungela kulungiswa kwemathrekhi, hhayi kulayisha nobe kufaka. Uma loluhlelo loludzingekako seluphumelele kucinisekiswa, i-Synix itawuvula sigaba 3 kute ukhone kubuyeketa kukhetsa kwakho, bese uvula i-Save Server. Kugucula luhlelo lwekukhiya Gcina futsi kute kube ngulapho kukhetfwa lokubuyeketiwe kukhonjiswa kuBuka. Kufanele ukhetse kusindzisa imphilo yakho; Kuvula i-Review akukaze kulondvolote ngalokuphelele. Fundza umlayeto losekugcineni nangabe kunalokutsite lokudzinga kunakekelwa.
Nawuhlela i-server, yekela kucala nangabe lolushintjo lutsintsana nemafayela nobe tintfo letingafundvwa nawucala. Kugcina tingucuko kuvuselela iphrofayili yayo; akucinisekisi kutsi umdlalo losatfutfuka usebentise lamagugu. Cala kabusha nge Synix uma umdlalo udzinga.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Vula i-Configure → i-Automation kwentela kutsi i-server lekhetsiwe ikhone kukhetsa umsebenti lokumele wentiwe ngaphambi kwekucala kwekusebenta.
Kusekela ngekucalisa Vumela loku kutsi kwente i-backup ngaphambi kwekutsi kusetjentiswe. Beka imphandze yekusekela nekugcina ku-Application Settings → Backups.
Kuvuselelwa kwetinhlekelele kucalisa ngekwephula luhlelo lwekusekela lolujwayelekile. Ema-backups ekucala ngekwe-othomathikhi akusiyo indlela yekugcina tintfo tekubuyisela emuva ngaphambi kwetingucuko letinkhulu.
KUSHIYELELA NGESIKHATSI Sekucala Vumela loku kutsi kwente luhlolo lwekuvuselelwa kwemdlalo ngaphambi kwekucala. Ivuselela emafayili emdlalo weserver, hhayi sicelo se-Synix.
Kubuyeketwa kwetintfo letinsha akusiso sicinisekiso sekutsi tonkhe tinhlelo letisetjentiswako tiyatilandzela. I-SteamCMD kanye nemfaki walomdlalo ngibo labatawuncuma kutsi yini ledzingekako.
I-VALIDATION NE-CUSTOM FILES (Tifayili tekucinisekisa nekwemukelwa kwemiculu) Sento se-Validate lesentiwa ngesandla singalungisa nobe silayishe kabusha emafayela alawulwa ngulomfaki. Kugcina tingucuko ngaphambi kwekuvuselela nobe kucinisekisa; ungacabangi kutsi emafayela lakhetsiwe atawuhlala angasatsintfwa.
HLOLA LIKHASI LOKULIKHETILE Gcina lokulungiselelwe bese wenta kucala lokuhleliwe. Fundza imiphumela yemsebenti wekusekela, kuvuselela nekucalisa. Kulayishwa kwemdlalo ngalokuphelele akusho kutsi sewuphumelele.
Vumela sikhala lesenele semarekhodi, lokulandziwe, emafayela esikhashana, kanye nemidlalo lefakiwe. Uma umsebenti wangaphambi kwekucala ubika kwehluleka, phenya sizatfu lesishiwo kunekutsi uvule iseva lefanako ngaphandle kwe Synix kwentela kuyendlula.

data.name: Content.CD4007BB408F0C6825C6
data.value: Vula i-Documents\American Truck Simulator\config.cfg bese usebentisa i-g_console "1". Cala umdlalo lowetayelekile we-American Truck Simulator, ulayishe iphrofayili yakho kanye nelibalave, cindzetela ~ kuvula ikhonsoli, bese ucala i-export_server_packages. Vala lomdlalo, bese uphindze ucofa ku-Start in Synix. I-Synix itawungenisa emafayela lakhicitwe ngekwetfu.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Vula i-Ready for the selected server ngaphambi kwekucala kwayo noma uma kukhona lokwehlulekile. Ihlanganisa ema-check lasekelwa ngulephrofayili, kufana nemafayili, sikhatsi sekusebenta, luhlelo, sikhala sediski, emachweba, simo senchubo, kanye nemarekhodi lafanele.
CINISEKA NGEMIPHUMELA Kulungela: Kute inkinga yekuvimba leyatfolwa ekuhlolweni lokukhona. • Kubuketa: Fundza lokutfolakele bese uncuma kutsi kukhona yini lokudzingeka kwentiwe. • Kuvinjelwa: Sombulula lenkinga lechaziwe ngaphambi kwekutsi uchubeke.
Kuba sesimeni sekulungela akusho kutsi kufanele ulungise tonkhe tintfo. Hlola lesento lesihlongotwako kanye nekucinisekiswa kwaso.
NGEMUVA KWEKULONDZISWA LIKHASI LELINTSHA I-Start yekucala ingalandza emafayela, ifake sikhatsi sekusebenta lesisekelwa, ikhiphe luhlelo, bese ilindza kutsi umdlalo ucale. Landzela sicondziso sekucala nekusebenta kanye nekuhlola kunekutsi utsatse lolokucuketfwe lokulondvolotiwe kwe-dashboard njengemdlalo lofakiwe.
Leminye imidlalo idzinga sivumelwano, kucinisekiswa, nobe kusetjentiswa kwe-in-game claiming/session setup ngaphambi kwekutsi umuntfu angenele. Gcwalisa leso sigaba endzaweni lefunwa ngulomdlalo.
Kucinisekiswa kwekuhambisana Kufaka, Kucala, Kuyekela, kanye nekubuka imiphumela yekubhalwa kwemisebenti lebonwe ngu-Synix. 'Akusakacinisekiswa' kusho kutsi kute imiphumela lebhalisiwe; loko akusho kutsi lomdlalo sewuphelelwe sikhatsi.
Umphumela we-Ready nobe kucinisekiswa lokuyimphumelelo kwendzawo akusiso siciniseko sekungena ku-inthanethi, emamodeli lanemphilo, nobe kuhambisana nawo onkhe emaklayenti. Cedza ngekuhlola lokucondzene nekuhlanganiswa kanye nemhlaba.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
I-backup ye-server lekhetsiwe igcina emafayela ku-folder yekufaka yale-server. Hlola kutsi lomdlalo uyisindzisa kuphi indzawo yawo ngaphambi kwekutsi wetsembele kuwo.
Tsatsa Sinyatselo Sekusekela 1. Vimbela i-server ku-Synix bese ulindza tinchubo tayo kutsi tiphume. 2. Khetsa lesento se-backup ku-Server Options. 3. Hlola imvelaphi, indzawo lokuyiwa kuyo, silinganiso sebukhulu kanye nesikhala lesikhona. 4. Cinisekisa bese ulindza kutsi kuphele. 5. Khetsa i-Open Backup Folder kute utfole i-archive. Gcina ikhophi yesitifiketi sayo.
LIKHASI LEKUCALA I-backup ifaka ekhatsi lifolda lekufaka, hhayi nje lifolda lelincane leligciniwe. Imidlalo lemikhulu ingadzinga sikhatsi lesinyenti kanye nekugcina lokunyenti.
Lokugciniwe ku AppData, Documents, lenye idrayivu, noma umshini lokhontiwako longumdlalo ungahle ube ngaphandle kwalelifolda. Yenta backups yato ngekwehlukana usebentise indlela yekusekela yalomdlalo.
KUKHAMBA NEKUHLONDZISWA Umtfombo lowetayelekile we-backup ngu-C:\Synix\BackupGames. Settings → Backups ikuvumela kutsi ukhetse lomunye umtfombo bese ubeka umkhawulo wekulondvolota.
Indzawo lekuyiwa kuyo kufanele ibe ngaphandle kwefolda yesiphakeli semtfombo. Kugucula imphandze yekulondvolota angeke kususe noma kususe ema-archive lakhona; hlola indzawo lendzala kute utfole emakhophi lamadzala.
Kugcina kususa ema-archive lamadzala nakwendluliwe umkhawulo lobekiwe ngesikhatsi sekwakhiwa kwe-backup. Gcina tindzawo tekulondvolota letingagucuki ngaphandle kwalendzawo yekulondvolota.
Gcina lenye ikhophi lecinisekisiwe yemhlaba lobalulekile endzaweni lehlukile. Li-disk lelihlulekile lingabhubhisa i-server kanye nema-backups lagcinwe kule-disk. I-ZIP yefolda yekusebentisa yangaphandle akusiyo i-VM legucugucukako nobe i-database.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Fundza umlayeto loliciniso we-Windows ngaphambi kwekutsi uncume kutsi yini lotawuyishintja. I-executable levaliwe, liphutsa lekufinyelela kumafayili, kanye nesikhatsi semdlalo lesilahlekile tinkinga letehlukene.
I-SYNIX angeke ifakwe nobe ivuleke Sebentisa lokukhululwe ngalokusemtsetfweni nobe liphasela lelicondzile le-WinGet ubidzz.Synix. Uma ufaka lifayela lelingekho, vala i-Synix ngekusebentisa leyo ndlela bese wetama futsi. Hlola kufinyelela kumafolda nemilayeto yeluhlelo lwekuvikela nangabe lenkinga ichubeka.
Ungasusi idatha ye server nobe ukhiphe kuvikeleka njengendlela yekulungisa jikelele.
I-SMARTSCREEN Sicwayiso seligama singaniketa lwati lolunyenti → Sebenta noma kunjalo, kushiyane ngemgomo we Windows. Kuba naloluhlobo lwekukhetsa akusiso sicinisekiso sekutsi lifayela liphephile. Ciniseka kutsi lokwatiswa kuvela emtfonjeni losemtsetfweni uphindze uhlolisise lesecwayiso ngaphambi kwekutsi uncume kutsi utawuchubeka yini.
I-SMART APP CONTROL Loku kungavimba i-app uma i-Windows ingakhoni kwakha kwetsembana lokwenele. Alikho li-app lelilinganiswa ne-SmartScreen's Run. Ungativimbeli tintfo tekuvikela i-Windows kute nje usebentise i-Synix.
Kwehluleka kwe-Antivirus nobe i-Hash Cwaninga ngalokuphelele lokutfolakale bese uyakubhala phansi. Ungacabangi kutsi sicwayiso siliciniso ngobe lelifayela libitwa ngekutsi yi-Synix. I-SHA-256 lefananako ikhombisa lelifayela lelilayishiwe; akenti kutsi kube nekwetsembana nobe kusayinwa kwemakhodi.
Bhala umlayeto locondzile kanye nendlela yekubeka tintfo ngekususa imininingwane yemuntfu. Gwema kususa tintfo letingakavami nobe kugwema kucinisekiswa kwe-hash yemfaki.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Sebentisa i-Settings → Backups kute utfumele/ungenise i-Synix ngalokuphelele. Loku kwehlukile kunekubhalisa lifolda linye leseva lelikhona.
HLOLA LOKUFANELE KUSEBENTIWE Lomkhicito wekuhambisa upakisha sihlahla lesikhulu se C:\Synix. I-server lekhetsiwe nobe emafolda langaphandle kanye nemidlalo yangaphandle idzinga kuphatfwa ngekwehlukana. Bhala phansi indlela labahambe ngayo ngaphambi kwekutsi bahambe. Tintfo letivamile te Windows tingaphindze tidzinge kubuyeketwa mayelana nendzawo lekuyiwa kuyo.
LIKHAMBI LELINGENISWA 1. Vimbela emaseva bese ucedza kulondvolota, kulayisha kanye nekugcina. 2. Khetsa kuhambisa lokufihliwe nobe lokujwayelekile. 3. Khetsa indzawo yekubhekisa ngaphandle kwalesihlahla semtfombo bese ubuyeketa bukhulu kanye netidzingo tesikhala sesikhashana. 4. Kute ukhone kutfumela imiculu nge-encryption, khetsa ligama lekuvula lelicinile bese uligcina ngekwehlukana. 5. Linda kutsi i- .synixbackup ipheleliswe bese uyayihlola.
Khetsa Indlela Lekahle Yekutivikela Kutfunyelwa lokufihliwe kuvikela liphasela futsi kusekela kudluliselwa kwetincwadzi tekungena letisekelwako ku-akhawunti ye-Windows yekuya khona.
Kuhambisa lokujwayelekile akukabhalwa ngemakhredithi. Emafayela emdlalo kanye nemarekhodi lakhona kungaveta timfihlo. Kukopisha emagugu labhaliwe lacondziswe ku-Windows akuwenti kutsi asetjentiswe kulenye i-akhawunti.
I-IMPORT 1. Cala ngekusekela idatha yamanje ye Synix. 2. Vula kulawula kwekungenisa/kuhlola bese ukhetsa liphasela lolifunako. 3. Niketa ligama lekungena lekudluliselwa kwemali uma uceliwe futsi ucinisekise lephasela. 4. Bukisisa lapho uya khona, tidzingo tema-disk kanye neticwayiso tekubhala ngetulu. 5. Vumela kulungiswa, kucinisekiswa, kanye nekutfola kugcwaliswe. 6. Hlola tindlela temaseva, emachweba, tinhlelo, tindzawo tekulondvolota, kanye nemininingwane yekungena ngaphambi kwekucala nobe ngabe yini.
Phindza ufake i-Satisfactory nangabe i-local identity yayo nobe i-protected connection ayisafanani. Gcina iphakheji yekucala kanye nedatha lendzala kuze kube ngulapho ema-server langenisiwe ayahlolwa.
Kuntjintjwa kwedatha lokwesekelwe kugcina ikhophi yalolwati ngaphambi kwekuntjintjwa. Uma kungenisa nobe kuntjintja kungaphumeleli, gcina leyo khophi kanye nemlayeto wekutfola esikhundleni sekugucula le-database lekhona ngesikhatsi i-Synix isebenta.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
I-Install & Launch icuketse lifolda leseva lelikhetsiwe kanye netindlela tekuvula letisekelwa. Gcina umyalo lokhutsatako ngaphandle nangabe uyicondza imisho yalomdlalo.
TINKHUMBULO LETIFUNDVWAKO Sebentisa i-Advanced mode uma kunetimphawu letidzingekile. Hlola tikhombo, tindlela tekusebenta kanye nemagama e-option ladzingwa ngumdlalo. i-Synix seyivele iniketa ngetimpikiswano letiphetfwe ngekusekelwa; kufaka lenye ikhophi kungabangela kungcubutana.
Ungahumushi tikhombandlela nobe ubeke esikhundleni selizinga lelisemtsetfweni lelindzelekile ngemagama lahunyushiwe. Ungalokotsi wente umyalo ube melula kuwukopisha.
Emafayela E-LAUNCH LAKHAMISELWE Kwemaphrofayili lasekelwako, Tincumo teSeva → Yakha liFayela le-Batch ubhala umyalo wekucala losonjululwe kuskripthi.
Lelifayela lingaba nemaphasiwedi lafundzekako nobe emathokheni etinsita kute likhone kusebenta ngekutimela. Gcina tintfo takho tiyimfihlo futsi utihlole ngembikwekutsi uhambe nato nobe utinike labanye.
Kusebentisa i-script ngaphandle kwe-Synix akusiniketi tonkhe tici tekusebenta kwe-Synix, kubambisana kwe-watchdog, ema-backups, nobe kulungiswa lokuhleliwe. Ungasisebentisi uma i-Synix seyivele isebenta.
KUTFUNYELWA KWABANTFU LABAHLATSIWE Lamanye emaphrofayili emdlalo acala emathuluzi awo ekufaka esikhundleni senchubo yinye leyetayelekile. Lamathulusi angadzinga imvumo leyehlukile futsi angeke asekele kuhanjiswa kwelifayela lekusungula. Landzela sicondziso salomdlalo kunekutsi usebentise lenye i-executable nobe i-wrapper.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Sebentisa luhlelo lolusemtsetfweni lwekukhulula. Kufaka ekhatsi sikhatsi sekusebenta se .NET lesidzingwa yi-Synix; Ema-server emidlalo angahle adzinge imicondvo yawo.
Khetsa Indlela Yekufaka • MSI: Tfola SynixSetup.msi, uyichube bese uvula Synix Control Panel ku-Start menu. Indzawo leyetayelekile yekusebenta kwemsebentisi ngamunye ngu %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGetSebentisa emaphakethe lafanako.Synix. Sihloko se WinGet Installation and Updates sicuketse imiyalo. • I-standalone executable: Beka i-standalone download lesemtsetfweni ku-writable folder bese uyigijima khona lapho. Kususa le-executable akusiko kususa onkhe emaseva akho.
Kutsatsa ngalokusemtsetfweni: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
Vuselela Lokusetjentiswako 1. Cedza kulayisha tintfo letisetjentiswako, kwakha ema-backup, kanye nekunakekela. 2. Vimbela emaseva akho emdlalo nge-Synix bese uvala i-Synix ngalokwetayelekile. 3. Sebentisa i-updater nobe i-installer ngendlela loyikhetsile yekufaka. 4. Vula i-Synix futsi uhlole kutsi imilayeto kanye netindlela tekungena ku-server yakho tilungile.
Uma ufaka i-EXE lendzala esikhundleni se-MSI, susa luhlelo loludzala kucala. Gcina idatha yayo leseva kanye nemafolda e-server. Ungasusi i-C:\Synix kute uvuselele loluhlelo.
Kuvuselelwa kwesicelo akuvuseleli imidlalo loyiphetse. Sebentisa i-Update yesiphakeli lesikhetsiwe kwenta loko.
Uma i-Windows ibika kuvinjelwa kwekufinyelela ngalesikhatsi ingena esikhundleni se-executable, hlola kutsi lelikhophi lelisetjentiswako alisasebenti. Ungabhali ngetulu kwesicelo lesisebentako nobe ususe idatha yesiphakeli kwentela kusebenta ngale kwemaphutsa.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
I-Synix ihlola umfutfo wemitfombolusito ngaphambi kwekwetfulwa kwentela kunciphisa ematfuba ekulayisha kakhulu. Uma kucala kwephuta nobe kuvinjelwe, fundza lenkinga yemtfombo lechaziwe.
Gcina Indzawo Yekuhlala Vumela kukhumbula i-Windows netinhlelo tekusebenta tangemuva kanye nemdlalo. Gcina sikhala se-disk lesikhona kute kwentiwe tintfo letisetjentiswako, emafayela esikhashana, tincwadzi lokulondvolotwa kuto kanye nema-backup.
Umkhawulo wememori ye-Minecraft utsintsa umdlalo/sikhatsi sekusebenta. Akusiyo imincele lecinile leyemukelekako kuwo onkhe emachinga lacalwa ngumdlalo ngamunye.
Kuhlolwa kwemitfombolusito akubeki i-server ku-container ye-CPU/RAM nobe kucinisekise kutsi i-Windows angeke ize iphelelwe yimitfombolusito. Sebentisa i-Resource Monitor kanye nesishwankathelo selibhodi le-PC kute ucondze lomtfwalo losemtsetfweni.
I-NETWORK GUARD (Umvikeli Wenethiwekhi) Loluhlelo lwekucwayisa inethiwekhi luhlola simo lesingajwayelekile sebandwidth/tintfo letisetjentiswako bese luchaza umsebenti lowatiwako we SteamCMD kwentela kunciphisa tecwayiso letingemanga.
Akusiyo i-firewall, luhlelo lwekuhlola kusetjentiswa kwetintfo letitsite nobe umsebenti wekuvikela ema-DDoS. Sicwayiso asichazi umuntfu lohlaselako nobe sifakazele kutsi kuhlasela kwenteka.
Nawutfola lesecwayiso, catsanisa lomsebenti naloko lokutsetfwe ku-Internet, ema-backup kanye naletinye tintfo lotisebentisako. Hlola emarekhodi lafanele ngaphambi kwekugucula kuvikeleka nobe kulungiswa kwenethiwekhi.

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Khetsa iphrofayili ye-Rust bese uhlola umhlaba wayo, kutati, kudlala, imibuto, kanye nekuhlela kwebalingani ngaphambi kwekucala.
ISERVER IDENTITY (Kwatiswa kwe-server) I-Synix iniketa linani le-+server.identity lelisekelwa ngule-identity leseva. Gcina tintfo letisetjentiswako kanye nemagama etintfo letehlukile kute tingetfwalani tindzawo letehlukene.
I-RUST+ Yakha i-App Port lekhetsekile leyesekelako kwentela kusita, bese ulandzela Rust yekuhlanganisa kanye netidzingo telucingo. I-endpoint yayo yehlukile kunendlela yekudlala yemdlali kanye nekuphatsa kwe RCON.
Hlola emachweba lakhiwe kahle kunekukopa umtsetfo kulesinye siteshi se-Rust. Vikela imininingwane ye-RCON futsi ungayendlulisi kute usite bantfu bajoyine.
I-VANILLA NEMOXIDE I-Vanilla isebentisa emafayili lasemtsetfweni esiseva. Kukhetsa i-Oxide kungeta luhlaka lolusemtsetfweni lolusekelwa ngemuva kwemafayela e-Steam. Kufakwa kwe-framework akukhetsi nobe kuhlolisise ema-plugins ngekwawo.
Sebentisa i-Mod & Plugin Manager's supported local workflow kwentela kutfola i-Oxide/uMod. Ema-plugin asadzinga tinhlobo letihambisanako kanye nemitfombo letsembekile.
I-Synix iphindze isebentise i-Oxide runtime lesekelwa ngemuva kwekuvuselelwa kwe-Rust nobe kucinisekiswa uma loluhlaka lukhetsiwe. Kubuyela kumafayili e-Vanilla lasemtsetfweni, shintja luhlaka lolukhetsiwe bese ucala luhlelo lwekusebenta lwe-Update nobe lwe-Validate.
Ngembikwekwenta luhlaka nobe kugucula umdlalo, gcina umhlaba, kulungiswa, kanye nemininingwane ye-plugin. Hlola kokubili lokutfoliwe kanye netingodvo te-Oxide ngemuva kwekucala kabusha; Kulayishwa kwe-framework lokuyimphumelelo akusho kutsi onkhe ema-plugins afakwe kahle.

data.value: Hlola imiculu yelayisensi ngaphambi kwekuvumela kusetjentiswa kweseva kwekucala.

data.name: Content.FC8AD725F17E1C50CF67
data.value: Leseva ifaka ekhatsi PCServer-AFFGame.ini. I-Synix igcina yonkhe ifayela lefakiwe bese ivuselela kuphela ligama leseva lelicinisekisiwe, iphasiwedi yemlawuli, kanye nekungena kwemdlali.

data.name: Content.FD78F49EF26709238B47
data.value: Minecraft Modpacks, Worlds, kanye ne Recovery

data.name: Content.FE08796B9B27C2F7036C
data.value: I-ATLAS i-server lehlanganisiwe futsi ayikhoni kwakha lamafayela ngekucalisa i-server. Sebentisa Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor kusungula nekukhipha i-grid. Kopisha i-ServerGrid.json ne-ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json ufake ku-ShooterGame leseva. Ngaphambi kwekucala i-ATLAS, gijima i-AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat bese ushiya i-Redis isebenta. Gcina iRedis iboshelwe ku127.0.0.1; ungabeki i-port 6379 ku-LAN, i-router nobe i-Internet. Umhleli: https://github.com/GrapeshotGames/ServerGridEditor

data.name: Content.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Bukisisa kutsi Synix uwakha njani umyalo losetjentiswa ekuvuleni le server.

data.name: Content.FF6EEAB0A9848FC8CD5C
data.value: I-Synix yakha i-server-generated serverconfig.xml layout lephelele bese iphatsa ligama leseva, iphasiwedi, ichweba, umkhawulo wemdlali, live, inhlanyelo, kanye nebukhulu bemhlaba. Lamanye emagugu ekudlala ahlala alungiseka ku-configuration editor.

data.name: Language.Description
data.value: Khetsa lulwimi lolusetjentiswe ngu-Synix. Imiyalo yemdlalo nemagugu lagciniwe awahunyushwa.

data.name: Uninstall.Everything
data.value: Susa i-app, ema-server lalawulwa kanye nemininingwane ye-Synix

data.name: Uninstall.Keep
data.value: Susa tinhlelo tekusebentisa i-Synix, i-cache, emafayela esikhashana kanye nemibhalo yekucala. Gcina yonkhe i-C:\Synix, emaseva emidlalo, ema-backup kanye nemafayela ekubuyisela. Gcina luhla lwetintfo letisetjentiswako kanye netilungiselelo ku SynixData\servers.json. Sebentisa loluhla lolugciniwe kanye naletintfo letisetjentiswako uma Synix ifakiwe futsi.

data.name: Uninstall.Review
data.value: Hlola lamafayela nemafolda langentasi ngaphambi kwekuwasusa. Tindzawo letikhonjiswe kutsi kufanele tigcinwe angeke tisuswe. Kukhishwa kwato kuyawuhlala kukhona. Nangabe loluhlelo lwekufaka luhluleka kukhipha, lamafayela atawususwa.

data.name: Uninstall.Confirm
data.value: Ngilondvolote konkhe lengikudzingako. Ngifuna kususa lamafolda ngalokuphelele.

data.name: Uninstall.Stop
data.value: Vala i-Synix bese uvala onkhe emaseva emdlalo ngaphambi kwekususa idatha yesiseva.

data.name: Uninstall.Changed
data.value: Emarekhodi e-server ashintjiwe. Phindza uhlole lamafolda ngaphambi kwekususa nobe yini.

data.name: Uninstall.Failed
data.value: Kukhishwa kwemanti kumisiwe. Lamanye emafayela kungenteka kutsi abesavele asusiwe. I-Synix isafakwe. Hlola leminye imiculu ngaphambi kwekutsi uphindze wetame.

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsOption
data.value: Phindze ususe ema-backups kanye nemafayela ekubuyisela

data.name: Uninstall.NoBackups
data.value: Kute ema-backups latfolwa etindzaweni letatiwako te-Synix.

data.name: Uninstall.KeptLocations
data.value: Tindzawo letigciniwe (ngaphandle kwemakhekhe lakhetfwe ngalokucacile ngetulu):

data.name: Uninstall.CloseApp
data.value: Vala i-Synix ngaphambi kwekuyisusa. Nangabe loluhlelo selususiwe, emaseva alomdlalo angachubeka asebenta.

data.name: History.Unavailable
data.value: Umlandvo bewungeke ufundvwe nobe ulondvolotwe. Hlola kufinyelela kumafolda kanye nesikhala se-disk.

data.name: History.Retention
data.value: Kugcinwa emkhatsini wetikhatsi te Synix. Kufika ku-{0} lokungena kwakamuva nge-server ngayinye. Emaphasiwedi kanye nemiyalo yekusungula ayemukeleki.

data.name: BackupHealth.Notice
data.value: Ngekubuka emafayela nemarisidi, hhayi luhlolo lolusha lwebucotfo. Ema-backups lamadzala kunemalanga langu-7 ayavetwa.

data.name: Appearance.Description
data.value: Khetsa ingcikitsi, umbala wekugcamisa nesitayela sekulawula. Tingucuko titawusebenta masinyane futsi tigcinwe ngekusheshisa.

data.name: Settings.Privacy.ActivityCount.Description
data.value: Kungakhetsi: tfumela ikhodi yeseshini lengakahleleki ku synix.info njalo ngemizuzu lengu-10 ngesikhatsi i-Synix isebenta, kufaka ekhatsi ngemuva. Kute idatha leseva letfunyelwako. Kubala kuphelelwa sikhatsi ngemuva kwemizuzu lengu-15. Ivuliwe ngekuhleleka. Ungayicima lapha.

data.name: RemoteManager.Description
data.value: Xhuma lelikhompyutha ku-akhawunti yakho kute ubone, ucale, umise, uphindze ucalise futsi wente i-backup yemaseva kusuka kuwebhusayithi ye-Synix. Kufinyelela lokukude kuvaliwe kute kube ngulapho sewukuvumile lokuchumana.

data.name: RemoteManager.Heading
data.value: Lawula le khompyutha kusuka kuwebhusayithi ye-Synix

data.name: RemoteManager.Instructions
data.value:
Ngena ku-website ufake lelikhodi. Vuma kuphela ligama lakho lemsebentisi lapha.
Gcina i-Synix ivulekile nobe incishisiwe. Kucocisana ngekuthula kulalela kungena. Imininingwane yesiphakeli ivuselelwa njalo ngemizuzwana lengu 10 ngesikhatsi ibukwa. Kuhlukanisa kuvimbela kufinyelela khashane ngaphandle kwekumisa emaseva.

data.name: RemoteManager.WaitingClaim
data.value: Silindzele kutsi i-akhawunti yakho ifake sicelo sekuhlanganiswa...

data.name: RemoteManager.CodeExpired
data.value: Ikhodi iphelelwe sikhatsi. Yakha ikhodi lensha yekuhlanganisa.

data.name: RemoteManager.ClaimFormat
data.value: Sicelo sekulawulwa kwe-akhawunti: {0} Vuma kuphela nangabe leli ligama lakho lekusebentisa.

data.name: RemoteManager.CheckFailed
data.value: Ayikhoni kubuka kuhlanganiswa. Hlola i-internet yakho.

data.name: RemoteManager.Unavailable
data.value: Angikhoni kuchumana nemphatsi we-Synix. Ngicela uphindze wetame.

data.name: RemoteManager.IdentitySoftware
data.value: I-computer identity: Windows-protected software key (TPM ayitfolakali)

data.name: RemoteManager.RemovalPending
data.value: Kucinywe kuchumana endzaweni yakini. Phindza wetame kususa uma uhlanganisiwe.

data.name: RemoteManager.LoadFailed
data.value: Kwehluleka kufaka i-pair. Kufinyelela lokukude akukagcwali.

data.name: RemoteManager.SaveFailed
data.value: Kufinyelela lokukude kukhubatekile. Tintfo tekuhlanganisa angeke tigcinwe.

data.name: RemoteManager.PairingRemoved
data.value: Kususwa kwekuhlanganiswa kwewebhusayithi. Kufinyelela lokukude akukagcwali.

data.name: RemoteManager.FinishUnpair
data.value: Phindza uhlanganise ku-inthanethi bese ucedza kususa lokuhlanganiswa lokudzala kucala.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryInstructions
data.value: Yakha i-password yesikhashana lapha. Sebentisa le-password kanye ne-2FA yakho lekhona nobe i-passkey kute ungene kulewebhusayithi. Khetsa ligama lelisha lekuvula. Nangabe i-akhawunti yakho idzinga totimbili letindlela, usatidzinga totimbili letindlela. Lephasiwedi yesikhashana ingasetjentiswa kanye kuphela. Kuphelelwa sikhatsi ngemuva kwemizuzu lengu-10. Iphasiwedi yakho yasekucaleni itawuhlala isebenta kute kube sikhatsi sekubuyiselwa.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryExpired
data.value: Kubuyiswa kwemali sekuphelelwe sikhatsi nobe kucitsiwe. Cala kabusha.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryLimited
data.value: Ticelo letinyenti kakhulu. Yetama futsi ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi.

data.name: Status.Activity.ReconnectedByPath
data.value: [SYNIX] Kuphindze kuhlanganiswe kuseva lesebentako "{0}" letfolwe kufolda yayo yekusungula (PID: {1}).

data.name: Settings.Backup.Transfer.RemoteAccessNotice
data.value: Kuhlanganiswa kwe-Remote Access akukashintji. Uma usebentisa i-remote access, hlanganisa i-computer lensha ne-akhawunti yakho ku-manager.synix.info ngemuva kwekubuyisela Synix.
